articleTitle: Revolutionizing Innovation Design and Development of Human Detection and Rescue Robot Based on Internet of Things Association
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Natural and man-made disasters pose significant threats to human life and property. The challenges of rescuing victims trapped in disaster zones are compounded by the complexities of the environment. To address this, we propose an IoT-based Human Detection and Rescue Robot (IoTHDRR). Equipped with advanced navigation and human detection capabilities, the IoTHDRR can operate in hazardous conditions, locate survivors, and provide immediate assistance. By incorporating a gesture recognition system, the robot can effectively interact with survivors and follow basic commands. Comparative analysis with a traditional GPRS-based Human Detection Robot (GPRSHDR) demonstrates the superior performance of the IoTHDRR. This research contributes to the development of innovative robotic solutions for disaster response and rescue operations.

articleTitle: MobileNet based Convolutional Neural Network for Detecting Cracks in Concrete Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Early detection of concrete cracks is crucial for structural integrity. This research proposes a MobileNet-based convolutional neural network (CNN) for automated crack detection. A dataset of 40,000 concrete images was preprocessed, augmented, and split into training and testing sets. The MobileNet model achieved impressive accuracy rates of 99.79% and 99.55% on training and testing sets, respectively. This demonstrates the potential of deep learning for efficient and accurate crack detection, enabling proactive maintenance and ensuring structural safety.

articleTitle: Enhancing Structural Health Monitoring: AI-Driven Image Processing for Automated Crack Identification in Concrete Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: One of the first signs of structural deterioration is cracks in the concrete surface, which is important for maintenance because prolonged exposure will seriously harm the environment. The highly regarded method for inspecting cracks is manual inspection. During the handwritten inspection, the irregularities' conditions are noted and a hand-drawn illustrate of the crack is created. One of the main problems on large construction sites is the degradation of structures as a result of cracks, especially in cases where inspection by hand is not feasible. Thus, an alternative called automatic image-based crack detection is suggested. The primary goal of this research work is to use artificial intelligence-based image processing techniques to identify and categorize cracks. Here, this study proposes five modules. The first module collects the dataset of crack images; the second module applies a pre-processing method to filter the data; the third module divides the data into training and testing portions; and the fourth module implements a model that uses both deep learning, such as the Mobile-net algorithm, and machine learning, such as the Random Forest algorithm, for testing and training the data. The last part is the prediction module, which forecasts whether a crack image will be positive or negative. Lastly, this study compares the accuracy score, recall, precision, loss graph, F1 score value, and algorithms for machine learning along with deep learning. The system performed better, as demonstrated by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Charging and Temperature Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: To address the critical need for advanced battery management in electric vehicles (EVs), this research study presents an innovative Battery Management System (BMS) by utilizing Arduino Nano and precision sensors. The proposed system performs well in real-time monitoring of charge and temperature, optimizing battery performance and longevity. A smart LCD interface provides drivers with essential information. This research study proposes a novel approach to enhance State of Charge (SOC) estimation by incorporating temperature coefficients into a state space battery model. This method addresses the limitations of existing techniques by accurately accounting for temperature's impact on battery performance. This research study contributes to the development of efficient and reliable BMS solutions for the growing EV market.

articleTitle: Smart Wearable Embedded Systems for Human Activity Recognition (HAR) Using Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The medical industry is currently utilizing a significant number of automated tools. The hardware is examined and used on both healthy individuals and those who have Covid-19 to capture breathing data, and a correlation has been found between them. A person's gait can be determined. This study also uses Kodular app, ESP32 module and ADXL335 Accelerometer sensor as an apparatus for detecting the changes. There are no complicated components or wiring needed for the ADXL335 accelerometer circuit, making it simple. It has a direct connection to an Arduino. The spread of these wearable gadgets increases the variety of their applications. With the development of wearable technologies that can process and store enormous amounts of health data, continuous human body monitoring is becoming more common. There are numerous technologies that enable the capture of movement among them. Accelerometers are the most frequently cited because they are already found in many devices, use little power, and cost little, theyhave been studied by researchers. and produce outstanding results. The fall detection system can be used in elderly fall detection system, monitoring the hospital patients, wheelchair person falls, etc. Finding anomalies in the large datasets that can be utilized to calculate the respiration rate is the study's aim. The designed system can be further used in many other applications where a fall need to be detected or where a fall is needed.

articleTitle: Information Processing of Electronic Medical Records Through Intelligent Smart Contracting and its Future Landscape in Industry 5.0
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Electronic Medical Records (EMRs) offer significant benefits but are vulnerable to security breaches. Blockchain technology, with its inherent security, transparency, and decentralization, presents a promising solution for protecting sensitive patient data. This research proposes a blockchain-based EMR system that employs private keys generated using the SHA256 algorithm for enhanced security. By storing medical records as bytecode, we aim to create an immutable and tamper-proof record-keeping system. This approach has the potential to revolutionize healthcare data management and ensure patient privacy.

articleTitle: An Extensive Analysis of ML Techniques for Predicting and Analysing Medical Data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The study aims to examine the effectiveness of three machine learning algorithms: Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Logistic Regression, navigating through the complex terrain of medical-related datasets. Through an in-depth analysis of three major datasets including demographics, health indicators, and assessments of Parkinson's disease, this study reveals the subtle advantages and disadvantages of each algorithm. Whereas Random Forest has unmatched flexibility in figuring out complex correlations, Logistic Regression stands out as an example of simplicity and openness. SVM struggles with computing loads and parameter complexities at the same time. This thorough investigation avoids claiming a model is supe-rior, allowing practitioners to identify the complex interactions amongst machine learning giants when it comes to healthcare datasets.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning Models with Genetic Algorithm Optimization for Enhanced Kidney Tumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Accurate and timely segmentation of kidney tumors from medical images is crucial for effective treatment and prognosis. This research study proposes a novel hybrid deep learning framework incorporating Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) for enhanced kidney tumor segmentation. To optimize model performance, Genetic Algorithms (GA) are employed to fine-tune hyperparameters and network architecture. The proposed method effectively captures both local and global image features, leading to improved segmentation accuracy compared to existing techniques. Experimental results on a publicly available dataset demonstrate the superiority of our approach in terms of recall, F1-score, and precision. This research contributes to the advancement of computer-aided diagnosis for kidney cancer.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Universal Shift Registers Using Novel Reversible Logic Gates
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Reversible logic is gaining increasing significance in diverse research areas, including quantum computing, nanotechnology, and optical computing. The exploration of reversible gates has emerged as a cutting-edge research area, driving a wave of innovative developments aimed at maximizing resource efficiency. Adders are essential in multipliers, especially in digital signal processing (DSP) applications. Reversible logic gates represent a major breakthrough in digital circuit design due to their ability to perform operations without loss. In this research work, demonstrated reversible Master-Slave D-flipflop (RDFF) and a 4×l Multiplexer (RMUX), we were able to effectively implement the design of a universal shift register. A number of essential metrics, including as garbage outputs (GO) and quantum cost (QC), provide proof that our suggested design is successful. We have achieved a decreased power consumption, a minimal quantum cost, and a reduced number of reversible logic gates and garbage outputs, all of which contribute to the accomplishment of our design. Validation and simulation of the reversible 4-bit universal shift register circuits (4-bit RUSR) were carried out in Xilinx Vivado 2022.2 software.

articleTitle: Prediction of Alzheimer's Disease by Analyzing Handwriting Dynamics Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a degenerative neurological condition that impairs everyday functioning and quality of life. Handwritten data scripts are related in the determination of Alzheimer's disease with the use of handwriting patterns, which can reveal early signs of cognitive decline and motor impairments. Changes in handwriting, such as tremors, irregularities, and slower writing speeds, can be indicative of the onset and progression of Alzheimer's, aiding in early diagnosis and monitoring of the disease. Traditionally, statistical tests or conventional classification models have been used in handwriting analysis studies. Machine learning techniques have only lately been investigated, and they were mostly used to identify Parkinson's disease rather than Alzheimer's. This research work aims to close this gap and investigate this by developing a machine learning model that uses handwriting data to categorize an individual as an Alzheimer patient. This research aims to advance the science of Alzheimer's disease prediction by examining the use of handwritten data as a unique medium for early diagnosis. PCA is one of the data preprocessing parameters that are employed, while the linear support vector classifier, random forest classifier, and XGBoost, together with their accuracy, are the model training parameters. Each participant's handwriting sample yielded 451 handwriting features, such as air_time1, disp_index1, gmrt_in_air1, gmrt_on_paper1, mean_gmrt1, etc., which are considered as the input parameters. A binary class label indicating whether a person is healthy or may have Alzheimer's disease is considered as the expected output.

articleTitle: Wireless Portable Bot Car Controlled by Brain Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research work presents the implementation of a wireless, portable bot car controlled by brain signals. This pioneering approach integrates advanced neurotechnology with the Internet of Things (IoT) and wireless technology. The proposed prototype features effective wireless connectivity, ensuring seamless communication between the brain-computer interface (BCI) and the bot car. Efficient real-time data analysis is achieved through thresholding techniques, enabling rapid and accurate interpretation of brain signals. The incorporation of hysteresis significantly reduces the risk of accidental interruptions caused by unstable sampling, thereby improving the reliability and robustness of the portable bot car. The dynamic interplay of brain signals within this designed framework holds significant potential across multiple industries, including healthcare, assistive technologies, entertainment, and automotive sectors. The user-friendly interface ensures the prototype is accessible and easy to operate, highlighting its practicality and efficiency as an IoT/embedded system-based solution. The project underscores the transformative impact of combining brain signal processing with wireless technology, paving the way for sustainable automotive and healthcare solutions with potential future applications in the field of Brain-Computer Interfaces.

articleTitle: Combining Fuzzy Logic and Reinforcement Learning for Resource Management in Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the wide spread of Internet of Things (loT) devices, edge computing plays a decisive part in meeting the computational demands of loT applications. Efficient resource allocation in such networks is essential to ensure optimal utilization of resources and meet the quality of service (QoS) necessities of loT applications. This research addresses the challenge of dynamic resource allocation in edge computing networks for loT applications through a novel hybrid AI approach, “FledegeRL.” By integrating fuzzy logic and reinforcement learning, FledegeRL aims to optimize resource utilization and enhance system performance. The proposed framework is evaluated through simulation analysis and compared with existing algorithms, including Q-Iearning, Fuzzy Logic Control, and Ant Colony Optimization, using metrics such as resource allocation accuracy, average throughput, and network overhead. The results demonstrate that FledegeRL consistently outperforms these algorithms, achieving higher accuracy, greater throughput, and lower network overhead. This highlights the potential of FledegeRL as an effective solution for dynamic resource allocation in edge computing environments.

articleTitle: IntelliAid: A Personal Assistant Chat-Bot for Enhanced Task Management
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Personalized chatbots offer a practical solution to manage daily tasks in today's fast-paced world. Leveraging AI and NLP, these virtual assistants streamline appointment scheduling, meal planning, payment reminders, and medication alerts. By continuously learning from user interactions, the chatbot provides increasingly accurate and relevant recommendations. This research explores the development and implementation of a customized chatbot, emphasizing the role of NLP, machine learning, and secure data management. The chatbot's ability to understand and respond to user needs enhances productivity, reduces stress, and improves overall well-being.

articleTitle: Global Warming Estimation Using AI/ML Techniques and its Mitigation Using Transistors
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Global warming refers to a continuing increase of temperature within the atmosphere of the entire earth. It is a big ecological threat having serious consequences prevalent in the environment. Combating this issue has been a motivation behind this research work. Here, transistor-based approaches are described for mitigating it. It has been shown that the deployment of several such units based on thermionic emission principle within a city will lead to absorption of a significant amount of heat thereby reducing global warming appreciably. Finally, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning approaches have been employed using MATLAB to estimate the level of global warming based on a secondary dataset. The developed models are able to classify global warming into three categories based on two parameters-CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentration and rise in sea level.

articleTitle: Power Management and Control for PV integrated Microgrid with Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With increasing demand for energy, sustainable development, renewable energy sources, or (RES) is an option. The integration of RES into power grid structure is quite challenging due to intermittent nature leads to solution of microgrid (MG). The proposed work is on different modes of Grid-Following to Grid-Forming operation, followed by a resynchronization to grid, solar plant curtailment, ancillary services like P&Q control, imbalance correction for improving the power sharing Capability and Grid-following and grid-forming are the two BESS operating modes that are made possible by the reduction of frequency variation between the grid and microgrid. To effortlessly re-connect the microgrid to the distribution system, a resynchronization with the grid is also carried out. MAT-LAB/Simulink is used to model the system.

articleTitle: Enhancing Lightweight Embedded Systems with Network-on-Chip Based Memory Organization Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the realm of integrated circuits (ICs), efficient memory management is pivotal for enabling high-performance computing in modern applications. With the rise of lightweight processors and the Internet-of-Things (IoT) era, there is an increasing demand for multiprocessing capabilities in ultra-low-power (ULP) embedded devices. To improve the performance of the ULP devices we propose an architecture in which an memory organization unit (MOU). MOU is introduced where network-on-chip (NoC) can provide the advantage of introducing it in existing ULP devices. Segmented paging approach is used in designing MOU architecture to provide advantage in memory utilization and fragmentation. The simulated result of the current research shows implementation of segmented paging which are varied by different valid bits for each segment when accessed by processor.

articleTitle: A Review of High Efficiency Power Converters for Electric Vehicles Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: To eliminate the need for on-board chargers and enable direct battery charging, power electronic converters are employed to convert AC supply into high-voltage Direct Current (DC). These converters are crucial for implementing advanced management techniques that regulate the charging rate and protect the battery from potential damage. This study analyses the performance of various power converters with the goal of selecting the most suitable one for Electric Vehicle (EV) applications. The primary criteria for selection include minimizing Total Harmonic Distortion (THD), maximizing power output, and achieving high efficiency. The converters include the Cuk converter, Single-Ended Primary Inductor Converter (SEPIC), Conventional Bi-directional DC-DC converters, and a DC-DC converter with a boost feature and integrated inductor. The primary research objective is to identify a power converter that supports the development of a sustainable and eco-friendly environment while meeting the performance requirements for EV applications.

articleTitle: Arduino-Powered Fingerprint Authentication for Door Access Control
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The Fingerprint Door Lock (FPDL) using Arduino with SIM800L research is designed to improve the security and convenience of door access control by integrating fingerprint recognition with Arduino and the SIM800L module. The research utilizes the reliability and flexibility of Arduino micro controllers and the GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) capabilities of the SIM800L module to offer a robust and efficient solution. In this system, a fingerprint sensor captures and verifies user fingerprints, providing precise and personalized access control. The Arduino board serves as the main controller, handling fingerprint data processing and communication with the SIM800L module through GSM technology. This setup allows for remote operation of the doorlock, enabling authorized users to lock or unlock the door from a distance using their registered fingerprints. Key functionalities of the research include fingerprint enrollment, template matching, secure data transmission, and real-time status monitoring. During the enrollment phase, users can register their fingerprints, which are securely stored in the system's database. Future scans are matched against the stored templates to either grant or deny access. The SIM800L module ensures the encrypted transmission of data between the door lock system and users' mobile devices, providing secure and dependable communication. By integrating Arduino, fingerprint recognition, and GSM technology, this research offers an effective solution for enhancing door access control systems. The combination of fingerprint authentication and remote management features delivers a robust and user-friendly method for secure access control, reducing the dependency on traditional keys or access cards.

articleTitle: IoT based Smart Irrigation System for Precision Agriculture in Greenhouse Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Water scarcity poses a significant challenge to global agriculture. This research presents a smart irrigation system that leverages IoT and cloud computing to optimize water usage and enhance crop yield. By integrating soil moisture, weather, and crop-specific data, the system develops precise irrigation schedules. Experimental results demonstrate the system's effectiveness in conserving water while maintaining or increasing crop productivity. This work contributes to the advancement of sensor-based agriculture and showcases the potential of IoT and cloud technologies in addressing complex agricultural challenges.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Stock Price Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Technological advancements have revolutionized stock market forecasting, with machine learning methods proving more accurate than traditional statistical approaches. Comparing various models, this study found that algorithms like Random Forest results in high performance in predicting Tesla's stock closing prices. These methods mitigate risks associated with investing while maximizing dividends, which are crucial for effective resource allocation and macroeconomic expansion in a country's financial market.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach to Early Plant Disease Detection and Diagnosis Using Advanced Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Early and accurate plant disease detection is crucial for sustainable agriculture. This research proposes an Ensemble Residual Sequence Net (ERSN) architecture, combining LSTM and ResNet-50, for classifying plant diseases in pearl millet. Targeting diseases like downy mildew, ergot, blast, rust, and smut, the model achieved high accuracy (94.7%), precision, recall, F I-score, specificity, and sensitivity. This innovative approach demonstrates the potential of deep learning in enhancing plant disease management and safeguarding crop yields.

articleTitle: A Novel Reversible Gate Design for Comprehensive Logic and Arithmetic Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Reversible logic is becoming increasingly important in various research fields like quantum computing, nanotechnology, and optical computing. The study of reversible gates has emerged as a promising research domain, promoting a continuous cycle of innovative trends that explore and efficiently utilize available resources. Adders play a crucial role in multipliers, especially in digital signal processing (DSP) applications. Reversible logic gates are a promising advancement in digital circuit design due to their ability to perform lossless operations. This study presents the design of a novel 4×4 reversible ASK gate and explores its applications in efficient digital circuits. The work includes the implementation of one bit adder and subtractor using the proposed gate. The proposed full adder architecture outperforms in terms of garbage count, ancilla inputs and power in comparison with the existing designs.

articleTitle: A Secure and Energy-Efficient Routing Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs)
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) can be utilized in several industries, including agriculture and the military, as part of the Internet of Things (IoT). Nevertheless, developing a robust and dependable authentication system for WSNs that can be implemented in the IoT. Because routing is done wirelessly, it is necessary to do it safely to keep a strategic distance from data loss and other attacks. When it comes to safe routing and trust in node-recognized proof, the existing frameworks present themselves as accessible options. This Proposed model called IBE-ECC, after the merge of best parameters, which is responsible for monitoring the authentication strategy that is both energy-conscious and effective. It is necessary to implement a verification methodology to provide authentication that is both efficient and safe. The approaches that are based on public keys, on the other hand, eliminate the security procedure; nevertheless, the verification process takes more resources and time. As a consequence of this, the need for authentication power consumption is regarded as the most significant limitation of this study. The purpose of this innovative technique is to provide high levels of security while simultaneously achieving energy economy and rapid authentication. Furthermore, to secure the authentication process, it decreases the size of the signature, which implies that it would speed up the verification of signatures quickly and efficiently.

articleTitle: Advanced Machine Learning Techniques for Accurate Detection and Diagnosis of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL)
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) is a form of leukemia depicted by the rapid proliferation of adolescent white blood cells (WBCs) in the bone marrow. The incidence rate of ALL is approximately 80% in children and 40% in adults. This condition disrupts the production of normal cells, causing neurological abnormalities and potentially leading to fatal outcomes. Consequently, prompt and precise diagnosis is crucial for efficient therapy and recovered survival rates. This study investigates the efficacy of various machine learning models, including XGBoost, Adaboost, LightGBM, and CatBoost, in the prediction of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL). Through comprehensive data preprocessing, feature selection, and model tuning, we assess the performance of these models' using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score metrics. Our findings reveal that XGBoost significantly outperforms the other models, achieving the highest accuracy (99.31 %), precision (95.63 %), recall (98.01 %), and F1 score (99.35%). LightGBM also demonstrates strong performance, particularly in precision and recall, making it a viable alternative. Although Adaboost and CatBoost provide satisfactory results, they lag behind XGBoost and LightGBM. This study underscores the importance of selecting advanced machine learning algorithms to enhance diagnostic accuracy for ALL, ultimately contributing to improved patient outcomes through more precise and reliable detection methods.

articleTitle: Design of Enhanced Dynamic Video Streaming Mechanism for Improving the Throughput Comparing with Ad Hoc on-Demand Distance Vector Routing Mechanism in Video Streaming Application
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Ad hoc, on-demand distance vector routing and dynamic video streaming techniques are used with the aim of increasing the throughput of the video streaming application. Two categories have been distinguished. Dynamic video streaming is the purview of Group 1, and vector routing is the domain of Group 2. The dynamic video streaming method was run with a sample size of 155, an enrolment ratio of 1.1, alpha and beta values of 0.05 and 0.5, and a 95% confidence level. It was also run with a variable number of trials. For this research, the G-power Pretest value is 85%. When it comes to wormhole prediction, the dynamic video streaming mechanism yields 1.57 throughput, while the distance vector navigation on-demand and ad hoc mechanism yields 1.76. A statistically significant difference <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{p}=\mathbf{0.008} < \mathbf{0.05})$</tex> with a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{99}\%$</tex> confidence interval exists between the two groups. Therefore, ad hoc, on-demand, distance vector routing mechanisms are inferior to dynamic video streaming mechanisms. In summary, the findings indicate that the dynamic video streaming mechanism outperforms the distance vector navigation on-demand and ad hoc mechanisms in terms of throughput.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Driven Analysis of Mental Health Indicators in Social Media Posts
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Mental stress has been a major issue among all age groups today. This is more like a stigma in the society where people don't even want to talk about it openly leading to severe health issues. Nowadays, people are deeply engaged with social media platforms for connection and self-expression of their emotions. They express all these through posts, photos, and comments. Thus, social media platforms can help in predicting the mental state and well-being of an individual. Prediction of a person's mental health can help to undertake some preventive measures. Various researchers have worked around this topic but there is no evidence of utilizing the most active web of people for obtaining the most accurate results. Machine Learning (ML) algorithms are used in this research study to identify whether a person is mentally stressed or not based on the social media data obtained from the user's post or by using a text input of around hundred words from users related to their day-to-day activities. This research study has used a decision tree, random forest, and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (referred as BERT onwards) model classifier to train models. This study has used a dataset of Reddit (a social media platform) posts text data for training the models. The primary objective is to compare the efficacy of various machine learning models in predicting mental health based on social media data.

articleTitle: IOT-Enabled Smart Crop Recommendation System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Agriculture, a foundation of India's economy, faces challenges in maximizing yield and resource efficiency. This research presents a machine learning-based system to recommend optimal crops and fertilizers based on soil quality and geographic location. By providing data-driven insights, the proposed system aims to enhance crop productivity, promote sustainable farming practices, and empower farmers to make informed decisions.

articleTitle: Smart Driving: Leveraging IoT for Automotive Innovation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) has transformed numerous industries, including the car industry, which has experienced a tremendous surge in linked and autonomous vehicles. IoT might change the auto industry by boosting safety, efficiency, and driving pleasure. IoT allows cars to gather and analyze sensor data in real time, allowing them to react faster to changing road conditions and possible threats. Vehicle performance, fuel consumption, and maintenance costs may be optimized using this data. IoT technology allows vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) and vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) connection. V2V communication lets vehicles exchange speed, position, and direction, warning drivers about possible accidents. V2I connection lets cars receive traffic congestion, road closure, and other data to help drivers pick the best path. In automobiles, IoT is used for ADAS, telematics, and predictive maintenance. ADAS technologies like lane departure warning, collision avoidance, and adaptive cruise control use sensors and data processing to increase safety. Telematics data on vehicle performance, driving behavior, and maintenance needs helps car owners and manufacturers maximize performance and cut costs. Predictive maintenance employs data analysis to spot maintenance concerns before they escalate.

articleTitle: Bitcoin Price Prediction Using Deep Learning and Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Bitcoin's growing popularity has spurred interest in understanding its price dynamics. This study investigates the relationship between public sentiment towards Bitcoin and its price fluctuations. By analyzing Facebook and Twitter data, we employed a novel approach combining deep learning and fuzzy logic. Sentiment analysis was conducted using multiple lexicons, followed by clustering and classification of reviews into positive, neutral, and negative categories. Subsequently, a two-level fuzzy logic model integrated sentiment data and Bitcoin prices to predict future prices. The proposed methodology outperformed existing models, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach in capturing the complex interplay between public opinion and Bitcoin price trends.

articleTitle: Novel Method for Bone Cancer Detection using Segmentation and Classification with CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Detecting and categorizing bone cancer plays a role, in diagnosing it and planning effective treatment in the realm of medical imaging analysis. Using CNNs (Convolutional Neural Networks) to learn hierarchical features from raw data, this paper presents a method for diagnosing and classifying bone cancer, demonstrating the powerful capabilities of deep learning techniques. When analyzing images, for bone cancer detection CNN s selective capabilities are utilized to achieve efficient results. The first step involves applying techniques such, as augmentation and normalization to enhance image quality and increase diversity, known as preprocessing in imaging. Following this a set of labeled bone images containing both benign and malignant instances is employed to construct and train a CNN structure. With practice, the CNN picks up on minor patterns and traits that point to bone cancer by automatically extracting necessary elements from the input images. The suggested approach produced results with 92.71 % accuracy, 100% precision, and 93.95% recall.

articleTitle: Ensemble Method for Network IDS Using the B-DRF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Intrusion detection systems (IDS) are crucial for safeguarding against the increasing cyber threats. This research study proposes an ensemble-based machine learning approach to effectively detect anomalies in network traffic. By employing bootstrap aggregation, random forest, and randomization techniques on the LUflow dataset, the proposed model achieves a high accuracy of 99% in identifying intrusions. This robust IDS can provide timely alerts to administrators, enabling proactive security measures.

articleTitle: Automated Defect Detection and Segregation in Dyed Fabrics Using Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study addresses the critical need for efficient quality control in textile manufacturing, aiming to enhance the production of high-quality fabric to meet consumer demands and industry benchmarks. Despite the meticulous cleaning and dyeing processes involved in fabric production, there remains a challenge in identifying and segregating defective sections, which can potentially compromise the overall quality of the fabric. To overcome this challenge, this research study proposes an innovative solution: Automated Quality Control in Textile Manufacturing, utilizing advanced image processing techniques. The proposed system employs high-resolution cameras and image processing algorithms to analyze the fabric's surface in real-time. By leveraging predefined criteria and machine learning models, the system can accurately detect and isolate flawed sections within the fabric. These criteria encompass a range of defects, including stains, discolorations, or irregular patterns that deviate from established quality standards. This approach improves quality control in textile manufacturing, providing manufacturers with a reliable and efficient means of identifying and addressing defects in fabric production. By automating the quality control process, manufacturers can enhance productivity, reduce waste, and ultimately deliver higher-quality products to consumers.

articleTitle: Retinares: An Integrated Deep Learning Framework for Diabetic Retinopathy Classification and Real-Time Severity Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a leading cause of blindness among diabetics, necessitating accurate and timely diagnosis. Current object detection-based methods often misclassify healthy retinal images, hindering effective patient care. This research proposes a ResNet-based classification framework to address this challenge. By focusing on precise classification rather than object detection, our approach significantly reduces false positives. Leveraging a Kaggle dataset, we demonstrate the model's superior performance in assessing DR severity compared to existing methods. A user-friendly Flask-based interface enables easy image upload and classification results. Our findings, evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, and Fl-score, highlight the potential of our model to improve DR diagnosis and patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Edge-Based Security Measures for a Robust Internet of Things Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Amidst the fourth technological revolution, characterized by the expanding reach of the internet and its applications, smart devices gain increasing acceptance. A proposition is presented for remotely managing household appliances via the internet, supported by local data processing to make it more secure. Utilizing the ESP32 microcontroller and Raspberry Pi 5 microprocessor enables remote appliance control from any internet-enabled location. Leveraging a local server enhances security, while Flutter serves as the development framework for the IoT application. Additionally, the local Flutter app contributes to enhancing project security measures.

articleTitle: Exploring the Creative Capacities of Generative AI: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Generative AI, a subset of artificial intelligence, is developed to redefine human creativity. By learning from vast datasets, these models can generate novel content across various domains, including art, music, and literature. This research investigates the potential of GANs, VAEs, and transformer-based models in this context. A comparative analysis of these models will illuminate their strengths, weaknesses, and suitability for different creative applications. Understanding the capabilities and limitations of generative AI is essential for harnessing its potential to augment human creativity and drive innovation.

articleTitle: Water Quality Prediction for Smart Aquaculture
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This work presents a unique hybrid approach combining different techniques for precise water quality prediction in smart aquaculture systems. The proposed model integrates the different algorithms with complex pattern recognition, resulting in a robust and efficient predictive system. Incorporating feature engineering and transfer learning enhances the model's adaptability to diverse aquaculture settings, ensuring accurate predictions of critical water parameters. Moreover, our methodology utilizes real-time sensor data, enabling proactive management of water quality conditions. Through comprehensive validation, our hybrid model outperforms existing methods, offering a groundbreaking solution for optimizing smart aquaculture operations. This research contributes to the advancement of predictive technologies, providing a novel and effective tool for sustainable aquaculture practices.

articleTitle: Enhanced Secure Communication in Wireless Sensor Networks: Quantum Key Distribution with KIRSAN Gate
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)

Key challenges include message protection and node identification, necessitating efficient mechanisms for key distribution and management, especially in large-scale networks. articleTitle: Illusion or Reality: Analyzing Sentiments on Deepfakes
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study analyses the sentiments of people concerning Deepfakes on social and non-social media channels. The findings have been described after extracting social mentions from Brand24®, an AI social listening tool. The results have been documented through the volume of mentions, discussion contexts, Social and non-social media reach, most active and influential websites, hashtags trending during the month, and lastly, source of extractions. The study's findings depict that Deepfakes is not considered a positive concept as it attracted criticism among people, which is also reflected in social and non-social media platforms. These results shed light on the perception of people about Deepfakes while providing actionable insights for all the stakeholders. The unique aspect of the study is the selection of a topic in the News in recent times for numerous reasons. The findings of the current investigation would provide abundant inferences not only to advertisers and marketers but also to policymakers and society at large. In addition, media houses and academicians would also get significant insights on the concept of Deepfakes to enrich their understanding.

articleTitle: Method for the Visualization of Architectural Structures by Means of Virtual Reality Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Computer networks have been a great help for the scaling of new technologies, communication protocols, system architecture among other ways to develop different applications, in this study a method to manage wireless networks applied to health centers is presented, where the characteristic is the exchange of information between different systems and applications such as medical images, information of clinical results, and the use of different applications. The study presents how the networks can be segmented by the type of applications, and a way to measure the bandwidth consumption by each of the networks, to evaluate their performance and to improve management, as a conclusion we present the ways how to segment the networks and how to organize to take advantage of the best performance of the network in health environments.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of DC-DC Converters Used in Electric and Hybrid Automobiles
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: DC-DC (Direct Current) converters play a crucial role in the design of Plug-In Hybrid Electric Vehicles (PHEVs) and Electric Vehicles (EV's). This study compares and contrasts different DC-DC converter topologies used in EV applications. There are two commonly used methods for DC-DC conversion: inversion followed by rectification and voltage level conversion. The multi-device interleaved bidirectional converters have proven to be the most cost-effective solution among the different converter types. It can be attributed to their high frequency, minimal losses, low number of components and impressive power output. Additionally, they are highly compatible with the development of electric vehicles. This study explores the importance of efficient power conversion tools in improving the durability and effectiveness of EV networks. In addition, the current and future research objectives in DC-DC converters are explored and specifically developed for EVs and hybrid vehicles.

articleTitle: Rainfall Forecasting Using Deep Learning and Cloud Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study introduces a new approach to rainfall prediction using deep learning and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for analyzing cloud image data sourced from diverse platforms. Traditional methods often struggle to capture precipitation patterns' complexity, necessitating advanced technologies like CNNs. The methodology emphasizes meticulous data preprocessing, including multiple discriminations, ratio adjustment, and augmentation, optimizing input data for CNNs to enhance quality, robustness, and predictive model effectiveness. A binary classification component enhances prediction accuracy and provides valuable insights into rainfall occurrence's binary nature. Using the multi-class weather dataset (MWD), this study explores weather image classification, examining dataset structure and showcasing sample images for each weather type. Two models with distinct architectures are trained from scratch, alongside a transfer learning model utilizing the VGG 16 pre-trained model. Result demonstrate promising performance across all models on the test dataset, highlighting their ability to accurately classify weather types. This study contributes to advancing rainfall prediction methodologies, offering insights into CNN application for weather analysis and forecasting, addressing critical needs in various sectors reliant on accurate weather predictions.

articleTitle: Carrer Compass: A Career Path Recommender using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the ever-expanding corporate realm, making an appropriate career choice is crucial for building a successful career. Students often face confusion due to increased choices or lack of guidance, leading to missteps in career selection. Such decisions might result in individuals working in fields unsuited to their strengths and interests, reducing overall efficiency. The proposed project highlights the need for a personalized career prediction system. Traditional methods often fall short in capturing the interests and strengths of individuals while solely depending on standard tests. This research study focuses on building a personalized career recommendation system based on the skills and interests of an individual. The project promotes the idea of dynamic and tailor-made tests for identifying suitable careers and an interactive, user-friendly mobile application using the Flutter framework. Machine Learning models like Random Forest and Support Vector Machine are employed for predicting and recommending careers. By evaluating personality traits, interests, and skills, the application will recommend a career. Continuous improvement is fostered through user feedback, ensuring the model's adaptability to changing job markets. This approach provides a comprehensive solution to challenges faced by individuals while choosing a career.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cryptocurrency Value Prediction: A Comparative Study of Novel Random Forest and K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithms for Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The effectiveness of the Novel Random Forest (RF) Algorithm for predicting cryptocurrency prices was evaluated and compared to the K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) Algorithm. Machine learning methods were used to develop the two algorithms, and a pretest power analysis was conducted using two groups with the iteration of 10 at 85% of G-power and the setup parameters are alpha = 0.05 and beta = 0.85. Hence the P value is less than 0.005 (P<0.05) there is a statistical significance (p=0.007) between these two algorithms. The Novel RF Algorithm achieved an accuracy of 87.7330%, while the KNN Algorithm achieved an accuracy of 72.1250%. When the two algorithms were compared using an independent sample t-test, the difference in accuracy was found to be statistically significant at 0.760.

articleTitle: Improved Frequency Response of Two Stage Amplifier using Cascode Current Mirror and Voltage Buffer Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In an effort to enhance the amplifier's frequency response, this study presents a two-stage design that includes a voltage buffer and cascode current mirror. The proposed design achieves a gain of 75.3 dB, a Gain Bandwidth Product (GBW) of 14.4 MHz, and a phase margin (PM) of 50°. Furthermore, it exhibits a 77.6 dB Common Mode Rejection Ratio (CMRR) and a Power Supply Rejection Ratio (PSRR) of 63.24 dB. Tanner Tool with TSMC 0.18 μm CMOS technology is used to run the simulation.

articleTitle: An Automatic ROI Detection in Ultrasound Images for Thyroid Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Thyroid cancer cases seem to be increasing rapidly across the globe. The best way to get detailed information about thyroid is ultrasound image. By analyzing ultrasound image features an expert can advise whether the nodule may be cancer or benign. Recently, artificial intelligence algorithms employed not only for efficient early diagnosis of thyroid cancer but also for over diagnosis. The paper proposes an automatic region of interest detection in ultra-sonic images using intensity and edge based segmentation. Intensity based segmentation is an image processing approach which divides an image into distinct regions based on intensity values of the pixels. Next edge-based segmentation is employed which detects edges within the image that might define anatomical shapes. For this a canny edge detector is used to identify potential boundaries of the ROI. The extracted ROI is evaluated using support vector machine algorithm to classify whether the extracted nodule features are benign or malignant. The proposed method achieves an accuracy of 98.8% and 97.4% in training and test phases respectively. The experimental results are also compared with existing literature work.

articleTitle: Scene Semantic Analysis of Display Media Images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study presents a novel scene semantic analysis paradigm tailored for display media images, focusing on improving the accuracy and efficiency of interpreting and categorizing various elements within visual scenes. The proposed method involves a detailed feature extraction process using Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) for texture features, augmented by roughness and directional properties for comprehensive analysis. Subsequently, a graph cutting algorithm with a smooth cost factor is applied for semantic segmentation. The method was evaluated on a meticulously annotated dataset of 10,000 samples. Ten sets of experiments were conducted to evaluate the accuracy of the method. The results showed a consistently high accuracy ranging from 99.13% to 99.71%, with an average accuracy of 99.36%, demonstrating the robustness and effectiveness of the method in semantic recognition tasks.

articleTitle: Eco-Friendly Solar-Powered E-Bicycle with Automatic Recharging System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The cost of fuel, particularly petrol, is increasing daily. Moreover, vehicle-related pollution in metropolitan areas and big cities is constantly rising. To get beyond these issues, an attempt must be launched for additional alternate vehicle that can save energy sources and be friendly towards nature. Once again, not all social strata can afford to buy cars, such as motorbikes, scooters, or mopeds. In light of this, efforts were being made to find a means of both helping these people who are struggling financially and offering a remedy for environmental contamination. The objective of the project is to transform a traditional bicycle into an electric bike that is both practical as well as cheap for the majority of individuals. The solar panel will also be implemented as an alternate source of energy which is renewable, for recharging the battery, thereby adopting a new eco-friendly technology of energy saving.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for Liver Disease Prediction: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: ML has been helpful in the health sector and has been on the forefront in delivering progress in health domain linked with diagnoses and patients. Liver disease is one of the pressing health issues affecting different areas of the globe and treatment depends on its accurate and timely diagnosis. This research applies four algorithms namely; LR, KNN, DT, and RF that can be used to forecast liver illness. Based on the performance measure such as accuracy, precision, recall and F-measure, their effectiveness maybe be determined. Preliminary study shows good results for all methods, with Logistic Regression and Random Forest outperforming the others. Notably, both attain 74% accuracy, with Random Forest yielding the greatest F-measure score 72%. K-Nearest Neighbours and Decision Trees perform well but may need more optimization. This study shows that ML algorithms, namely Logistic Regression and Random Forest, helps in improving liver disease prediction and thereby leading to better healthcare outcomes.

articleTitle: Role of Deep Learning in Adversarial Attacks: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Deep learning has become an effective paradigm that is impacting several fields, including decision-making systems, natural language processing, and recognition of images. Nonetheless, the growing frequency of malicious attacks presents an important barrier to the robustness and dependability of deep learning models. This research study explores how adversarial attacks use deep learning and the techniques by which malicious actors take advantage of neural network weaknesses. An overview of a variety of adversarial attacks and the most recent methods for detecting and preventing them on diverse data sets are given in this study.

articleTitle: Smart Public Transport Monitoring and Demand Analysis with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In India, the passengers, who travel through public transport are unable to find out the available buses on the route. It is important to provide consumers with live location and departure information for buses to ease their travel. It might be challenging for those waiting for a bus at the bus stop to know the status of the particular bus on that route when there is a delay in the vehicle due to traffic or other issues. There are some systems which is costly and does not predict number bus required. The aim of this research study is to develop an embedded system that can display the current location of the selected bus and passenger count in real time. This will make it much simpler for individuals who need to plan their travels by providing them with real information about the bus's status through an application, and it will also use simple machine-learning algorithms to calculate the number of buses needed for that particular route with the account of the demand of each hour in a day and also to have a less system power consumption by the ML modal trained.

articleTitle: Risk Prediction in Financial Transactions Using IoT Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The Internet of Things is a network of appliances and other items that can communicate and distribute data; as a result, Internet of Things are equipped with actuators, sensors, microelectronics, software, and connections. IoT devices, to put simply, share data over wired or wireless networks. Inventions of IoT have endless possibilities that can make a huge difference in the world. IoT is having the most effect on business since has altered not just how various corporate processes are conducted, but also how the economy is managed. Big data and IoT help optimize operations, reducing costs, enhancing productivity and improving lives. Globally, financial institutions and banks are coming up with fresh, creative approaches to quickly assimilate big data analytics for every step of the process in with the intention of maximizing efficiency. Numerous previous studies mostly concentrate on risk assessment along with big data analytics together in the banking industry; nevertheless, might not particularly address the difficulties posed by cross-border transactions. The purpose of the proposed study is to close this gap by focusing on the particulars and bringing up the approach of big data analytics for risk assessment in cross-border transactions.

articleTitle: Predicting Flight Delays and Error Calculation Using Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Flight delays are a significant concern in the aviation industry, causing inconvenience for passengers and financial losses for airlines. Predicting flight delays accurately can help mitigate these issues by allowing both airlines and passengers to proactively manage schedules and resources. The delay might depend on weather, crew management, and resource planning. Existing prediction methods often lack accuracy or rely on historical data and statistical models, which may not capture the complex interactions and patterns present in flight operations to predict delays. This study proposes a novel approach for flight delay prediction using advanced machine learning techniques and tools. Specifically, machine-learning classifiers, such as Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Decision Tress, are employed to analyze a comprehensive live streaming dataset comprising various incorporated factors like flight operations, weather conditions, air traffic congestion, and aircraft performance. Proposed model is trained on a large dataset encompassing diverse routes and airlines and has achieved an accuracy of 95% in predicting delays by outperforming existing methods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Interactive Storytelling in Virtual Reality through Hand Gesture Recognition Systems for Film and TV
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Virtual Reality (VR) technology has revolutionized the entertainment industry by providing immersive experiences that transcend traditional boundaries. This paper explores the use of hand gesture recognition systems in VR environments to improve user interaction in film and TV works. The system uses advanced computer vision techniques for real-time hand gesture recognition, allowing users to navigate, interact, and control virtual content. By mapping gestures to specific actions, users gain control over their virtual experiences, creating more engaging and personalized storytelling. This technology opens new possibilities for narrative exploration, allowing directors and creators to develop interactive narratives that respond to the audience's gestures. This research study discusses about the technical aspects of a hand gesture recognition system, including algorithms, feature extraction methods, and Virtual Reality hardware integration. The convolutional neural network (KNN-KSVM) model's accuracy is compared to other models, showing an upward trend of 98.77%. The technology's impact on storytelling, cinematography, and audience engagement in film and television production is also explored.

articleTitle: An Optimized Deep Convolutional Neural Network Approach to Detecting Ovarian Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The ovaries are essential for the functioning of the female genital system. The significance for these limited glands lies in their role of synthesizing female sex hormones or female genital cells. The paired, endocrine, ovoid glands are located on either side of the womb and are linked to the ovarian ligament. Ovarian cancer can result from various sources, but it can be identified by multiple approaches, including the utilization of a technique called convolutional neural network. This study investigates the utilization of CNN for the classification of ovarian cancer tumors, as well as other approaches to address this issue. This study examines and compares different machine learning algorithms, such as K Nearest Neighbor (KNN) and the Support Vector Machine, to detect ovarian cancer. Upon evaluating various techniques for detecting cancer, it quickly became evident that a certain Deep Learning methodology, specifically the Deep CNN, yielded the most favorable results. The application of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNN) has led to a significant improvement in the accuracy of predicting cancer of the ovary and its subtypes, achieving a remarkable accuracy of 96%. This surpasses the accuracy of 83.3% attained by Support Vector Machines (SVM) and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithms.

articleTitle: Climacteric Defective Sapota Identification using Machine Learning-A Novel method in Segregating Latex Oozing and Rot using Augmented Images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Climacteric fruits, such as Sapota, are susceptible to post-harvest losses if not managed optimally. Manual inspection for fruit quality is time-consuming and prone to errors. To address this, we propose an image-based approach for classifying Sapota fruits into good, latex-oozed, and rot categories. The methodology involves sequential image filtering (Median, Bilateral, and Gabor) for enhancement, followed by marker-based morphological updated watershed segmentation to isolate fruit regions. Non-Parametric Naïve Bayes (NPNB) classification achieves a high accuracy of 98% in distinguishing fruit conditions, outperforming Support Vector Machine (SVM) and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) methods. This research offers a potential solution for improving fruit quality assessment efficiency and reducing post-harvest losses.

articleTitle: EMOWELL: Emotional Well-Being Web Application for Better Understanding Using NLP Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the digital age, the need for comprehensive emotional well-being platforms has become increasingly evident. EMOWELL, utilizing the MERN technological stack and the advanced BERT model, addresses this need by offering a holistic approach to emotional self-reflection. Designed with modern users in mind, EMOWELL integrates advanced features such as mood tracking, meditation exercises, and journaling, all enhanced with sentiment analysis, to provide robust support for emotional health. The implementation of EMOWELL is supported by robust security measures and a commitment to continual improvement, ensuring the platform's effectiveness in promoting emotional resilience and sustained user engagement. Empirical findings highlight the EMOWELL's potential as an efficient tool in digital health solutions, marking a significant stride towards wellness and emotional intelligence in the technology driven society.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques Utilization for the Analysis of Tooth Disorders
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Dental informatics is a developing area of research apparent in ever-expanding healthcare sector. Oral health information is the key and alarming area. Getting awareness and useful data from complex, various and diverse sources is one of the biggest hurdle to the transformation of the health care system. Recently, advances in deep learning technologies have made it possible to develop new efficient frameworks for creating comprehensive learning models from complex data. This research study attempts to investigate the most current findings about the application of deep learning methods to treat oral dental conditions such as oral cancer, periodontal disease, cavities, and pulpitis. This study recommends thorough and insightful frameworks for regular dental diseases that can be interpreted in a way that is advantageous to oral health care.

articleTitle: Prediction of Vehicle Carbon Emission Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The automotive industry is a major contributor to carbon emissions, posing a threat to the environment and human health. This research explores the potential of machine learning for predicting vehicle CO2 emissions. It utilizes a comprehensive dataset encompassing diverse factors like vehicle type, engine specifications, driving patterns, and environmental conditions. Feature engineering and model training with various algorithms like linear regression, decision trees, and neural networks are employed. The findings demonstrate the effectiveness of machine learning in predicting emissions with high accuracy, offering valuable insights into influencing factors. The developed models empower the automotive industry to manage emissions more efficiently, contributing to climate change mitigation and a more sustainable future. This study highlights the potential of machine learning in addressing critical environmental challenges.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Item Recommendation System for Surplus Item Sharing System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The world is filled with full of love and care. Everyone wants to support others, due to lack of time and resources we are unable to support each other. In this paper, we developed system called Share2Care. It wants to make it easy for people to help each other in their communities. The main thing is some people have extra stuff, and others really need things but can't afford them. It's a simple and friendly system where people can share surplus items with those who could use a hand. The idea is to build a community where we care for each other. It's not just about helping people; it's also about reducing waste, like old gadgets, books and clothes. This system helps people share excess items with those who are in need. People can use this system without any cost. It also explores the integration of an AI model, specifically Model-Based Collaborative Filtering through Matrix Factorization (MBCF), to enhance performance. This model recommends products based on the user's past behavior, ensuring reliable and trustworthy suggestions for users. Overall., this research study outlines the architecture, working principles, advantages, and limitations of the Share2Care system.

articleTitle: Interaction of Intelligent Vehicle-Machine System Based on Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study focuses on enhancing the interaction between intelligent vehicle-machine systems and users through gesture recognition technology. The research investigates several key areas, including advanced image sensor utilization, novel gesture recognition algorithm design, and efficient interaction implementation. Specifically, high-quality image sensors are used to capture images necessary for accurate gesture recognition. A two-step gesture recognition algorithm, including hand segmentation and action recognition, is proposed to improve accuracy and efficiency. In addition, an efficient gesture control methodology is developed to seamlessly integrate user commands into the vehicle-machine interface. Experimental results based on 2,000 sets of gesture data demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed model in recognizing various gestures. Specifically, the proposed model achieves recognition rates of 99% for sliding gestures, 98% for clicking gestures, 99% for long-press gestures, and 98% for double-click gestures, outperforming existing models. The results underscore the potential of gesture recognition technology to improve human-machine interaction in intelligent vehicles.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Solar Power Forecasting Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The research focuses on the development of a solar power forecasting system using machine learning techniques, with a primary focus on the intricate task of accurately predicting solar power generation. Drawing from historical data, the research employs various machine learning algorithms, including K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Gradient Boosting Regression Trees (GBRT), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Multiple Layer Perceptron (MLP) to achieve highly precise forecasts. The proposed method includes data pre-processing and including techniques such as standardization and normalization. This ensures that the data is in an optimal state for utilization in machine learning models. This research study highlights the importance of data quality, as well as the reliability and availability of data from external sources, emphasizing their pivotal role in enhancing the accuracy of solar power predictions. This study utilizes data preprocessing, thorough model evaluation, and data visualization techniques for comprehending data patterns and results.

articleTitle: Cloud Computing's IoT based ThingSpeak, NodeMCU for Weather Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this research work, a cloud-based Internet of Things (IoT) system for weather monitoring in real-time is presented by integrating the ThingSpeak platform, the ESP32 microcontroller, and several sensors, such as rain, soil moisture, and temperature sensors (DHT11). The ESP32 acts as the central hub, integrating sensors and wireless connectivity for data acquisition and transmission. Data collected is securely stored, visualized, and analyzed on ThingSpeak, enabling remote monitoring and decision-making. The system's modular design allows easy expansion and customization, accommodating additional sensors or functionalities. Leveraging cloud computing, this IoT solution offers scalability, accessibility, and data sharing for applications like agriculture and environmental monitoring. With efficient data processing and transmission, even in resource-constrained environments, and collaboration features through thingSpeak, this research contributes to advancing cloud-based IoT systems for weather monitoring.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based (DRLB) Optimization for Autonomous Driving Vehicle Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This comprehensive study presents a novel DRLB assisted path planning (PP) algorithm for the autonomous driving (AD) vehicles with the novel designed deep reinforcement learning (DRL). The proposed algorithm addresses the challenges faced by traditional path planning methods, such as large Q-table sizes, high computational complexity, and convergence problems. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on predefined environment maps or potential field methods, the proposed algorithm uses DRL to learn optimal paths in dynamic and complex environments. The algorithm uses a grid map representation for environmental modeling, where obstacles are enclosed in rectangular frames to ensure path accuracy and safety. Additionally, integrating an artificial potential field approach (APFA) helps guide the vehicle to the target while avoiding obstacles. The algorithm uses a novel Q-learning algorithm to approximate the value function between the vehicle state and action, which enables efficient path planning. The algorithm is visually evaluated through extensive simulation tests, demonstrating its effectiveness and superiority over traditional methods from the perspectives of the accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Natural Language Processing (HNLP) for Model Transformation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Model-to-model transformations involve converting one type of the model into another. This can be used in many ways for various reasons, considering model performance with particular deployment platforms. This paper introduces a Hybrid Natural Language Processing (HNLP) model to visualize model-to-model (M2M) transformation. The proposed HNLP combines Sub-word Embedding (FastText), Encoder-Decoder Architecture, and Attention-based Seq2Seq. The proposed approach focused on processing standard text into meaningful information. Subword Embeddings with FastText retain grammatical aspects by demonstrating words as n-grams, which enhances the interpretation of out-of-vocabulary phrases and unusual word structures. The Encoder-Decoder Architecture translates input sequences into symbolic representations that can be used for various NLP tasks. The Attention-based Seq2Seq method extends this approach by constantly focusing on vital regions of the input sequence during decoding, improving the model's capacity to provide accurate and contextually appropriate outputs. By combining these techniques, the HNLP model enhances sequence transformation quality and gives a more interpretable and visual path for understanding how input transformations occur between models. This visualization capacity is crucial for debugging, model improvement, and understanding the inner workings of complicated NLP systems. Experimental results show that the HNLP model performs well in various NLP tasks, demonstrating its promise as a reliable tool for practical applications and theoretical investigations into model-to-model transformations.

articleTitle: Conjunctivitis Eye Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Conjunctivitis, or pink eye, is an inflammation of the eye's thin, transparent membrane, causing redness, irritation, swelling, and discharge. Recent research integrates deep learning techniques in ophthalmology to aid in diagnosis. However, algorithmic bias remains a critical challenge, potentially which can adversely affect the outputs of artificial intelligence systems. Bias in training data can lead to inaccurate diagnoses in healthcare outcomes. This project employs deep learning methods to address the diagnostic challenges of conjunctivitis while considering and mitigating algorithmic bias to ensure equitable and accurate results.

articleTitle: Federated Multiobjective Convolution Neural Network Architecture for Enabling Efficient Iterative Intrusion Detection Mechanism to the Cloud Services
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
