abstract: Cloud environment and its paradigms are exploring in large extent and revolutionizing the various industries and common peoples with multiple dynamic features and identical functionalities to gain significant prominence. Regardless of its numerous benefits, cloud providers suffers from the security challenges due to digital extortions. Particularly many solutions has been employed using machine learning approaches to detect intrusion and cryptographic techniques for privacy preserving of the cloud user but still many challenges exist due to abnormal activities of the attackers by injecting the large attack vector. In order to mitigate those challenges, a new federated deep learning architecture entitled as federated multi-objective convolution neural network architecture is proposed in this article. It is highly capable of handling large attack variant and its vectors along managing the data privacy challenges of the user information. In this work, Cloud Intrusion Detection Dataset which contain the knowledge and behaviour based audit data collected from the cloud user in real time and CIC-IDS2018 dataset is extracted from the Canadian Institute of Cybersecurity which incorporate data traffic to the cloud services. Initially these dataset were preprocessed through Z-score normalization method for data outlier reduction and data normalization. Preprocessed data is employed to particle swarm optimization which is considered as feature selection method to determine the optimal features for anomaly detection. Selected Optimal feature is employed to multi-objective convolution neural network to detect and classify the multiple attack propagating to the cloud server. Convolution Neural Network generate the feature map for various attacks characteristics which is computed as features in convolution and max pooling layer. Further those feature map is classified in fully connected network using softmax function. Experimental analysis of the proposed architecture is carried out on mentioned dataset to identify the significance of the proposed approach in resource utilization and processing time and performance analysis of the proposed model outperform other state of art architecture on the cross fold validation. Finally current architecture achieves 98.9 percent accuracy on basis of the cloud security.

articleTitle: Forecasting Price Prediction for Vegetables and Fruits Using Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Unpredictable fruit and vegetable prices create significant challenges for farmer livelihoods. This research proposes an innovative approach using recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to predict both minimum and maximum prices. By analyzing historical market data, these models can forecast potential price ranges, empowering farmers to make informed decisions about planting, harvesting, and sales strategies. This enhanced foresight helps farmers navigate market volatility and improve income stability.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Detection Using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs)
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) present significant public health challenges, highlighting the need for developing accurate and reliable predictive models for early detection and intervention. This study analyzes the application of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to develop predictive models for heart disease using diverse patient datasets. Four GNN architectures are investigated-Graph Attention Networks (GAT), Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN), GraphSAGE, and Graph Isomorphism Networks (GIN)-to leverage their ability to capture intricate relationships in patient attributes and clinical features. Patient graphs are constructed from heterogeneous data sources encompassing various parameters, and the GNN models are trained and evaluated for heart disease prediction. Findings demonstrate promising performance across all GNN architectures, highlighting the potential of GNNs in facilitating personalized healthcare and improving cardiovascular risk assessment and disease management strategies. To evaluate the model's prediction skills, a thorough analysis of confusion matrices and model performance measures, such as accuracy, recall, specificity, and Fl-score, is also given. The study underscores the potential of GNNs in healthcare analytics and contributes to the advancement of predictive modeling for cardiovascular risk assessment and disease management.

articleTitle: Detection of Malicious URLs using Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The rise of mobile devices has driven real- world activities online, exposing users to the growing threat of malicious URLs that can compromise network security by distributing malware, launching phishing attacks, and causing data breaches. This paper proposes using logistic regression, a powerful binary classification tool, to differentiate between malicious and benign URLs. By extracting and analyzing features such as character sequences, suspicious keywords, and specific subdomains, the logistic regression model can identify patterns indicative of malicious intent. Although effective, logistic regression's assumption of linearity between features and maliciousness poses a limitation, as cybercriminals employ complex strategies that may avoid detection. Therefore, while logistic regression offers interpretability and initial success, enhancing this approach with advanced machine learning techniques could provide deeper insights and more robust protection against cyber threats.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis for Software Fault Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The growing complexity of software systems poses significant challenges to error prevention, underscoring the importance of automatically predicting errors in software modules. This enables developers to optimize their use of limited resources. Concerns about anticipating software bugs and vulnerabilities have long been prevalent among software developers and the technology industry. Traditionally, identifying software errors required expertise or a deep understanding of the application's problematic modules. This research study has introduced a machine learning-based predictive model for software defect evolution, designed to facilitate uninterrupted software operation. The study has also evaluated the model's efficacy using established criteria such as accuracy, precision, recall, specificity, and F1 measures. The research findings demonstrate outstanding classification performance, ranging from 98% to 100%, achieved using SVM across three error datasets, as assessed by the F1 score. This study offers valuable insights for software researchers and practitioners, equipping them with automated decision-making capabilities to select appropriate tasks for their specific applications.

articleTitle: Differentiating Leek Diversity: CNN and XGBoost in Three-Group Categorization
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Diversity is one of the distinguishing features of agriculture in India and leeks are being grown in different parts of the country. The market segmentation and accurate categorization of leek varieties are imperative in the implementation of the right pricing strategies as well as the performance of efficient agricultural practices. The objective of this research is to classify the Indian leek into three groups namely Tadorna, Titan, and Megaton through a combined model of CNN and XGBoost. The dataset includes a complete set of leek images, Moreover, the images were preprocessed to maintain the same size and normalize the pixel intensity, as well as performing image augmentation. The CNN model successfully obtained detailed features on the leek images including distinguishing characteristics of the varieties. These features above were then used in the XGBoost classifier to sort the leeks into the three predefined categories. The integrated CNN-XGBoost model reached the probability of accuracy of 95.8%, although it was slightly lower than the ensemble model of CNN and XG boost, which recorded an accuracy of 91.2% and 88.7%, respectively. The hybrid also performed better in terms of accuracy in all categories as well as the precision, recall, and Fl measure of the model.

articleTitle: Assessing BER Reduction in VLC Systems Using Advanced QAM Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Visible Light Communication technology uses visible light to wirelessly transmit data, providing advantages such as high bandwidth and immunity to electromagnetic interference. With the growing demand for higher data rates, optimizing modulation schemes is crucial. This study focuses on the reduction in Bit Error Rate (BER) achieved by using 256-QAM (Quadrature Amplitude Modulation) compared to 128-QAM in VLC systems. The success rate achieved with 256 QAM is 0.98, compared to 0.96 for QPSK modulation. Implementing the proposed 256 QAM model significantly reduces the Bit Error Rate compared to the 128 QAM model in VLC systems. This advancement towards achieving a lower BER represents a substantial improvement in the overall quality of the system's output.

articleTitle: Robotic Surveillance Monitoring for Land and Underwater Security
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study presents design, installation, and testing of an amphibian surveillance robot that can function well in both aquatic and terrestrial settings. To detect surveillance and monitoring duties, the robot combines sophisticated propulsion systems, durable sensory apparatus, and autonomous navigation capabilities. This study discusses about the challenges in creating transition mechanisms and the solutions created to improve durability and mobility in challenging environments. Initial field trials show the robot's effectiveness in security and environmental monitoring applications.

articleTitle: Asphalt Roadside Flatness Detection Based on Laser Sensing Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Smoothness assessment plays a key role in evaluating the quality of asphalt concrete pavements, which has a direct impact on vehicle comfort, safety, and pavement longevity. This study presents a novel approach to asphalt pavement smoothness detection based on laser-sensing image processing. The proposed method uses advanced image processing algorithms to extract relevant features indicative of flatness from high-resolution images acquired using laser sensing technology. Key steps include image pre-processing, laser sensing image processing model construction, and performance evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, which consistently outperforms existing techniques in detecting flatness with an average accuracy of the 98.89%. Statistical analysis confirms the superiority and consistency of the proposed method, highlighting its potential for real-time road surface monitoring and maintenance.

articleTitle: Intelligent Vehicle Management System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Recent days there are more and more accidents occurring in and around our cities. Additionally, people do not adhere to the government-mandated speed limits in different locations (for example, a school zone has a lower speed limit but a highway allows for a higher speed limit). In order to decrease the number of occurrences, effective data analysis and possible infrastructure development are needed. We also need the traffic laws to be improved. The proposed system uses an Internet of Things (IoT) device that limits vehicle speed in accordance with zones and rules. After receiving the signal from the primary device, a second device mounted to the vehicle lowers its speed in response to it. To determine if the rider of a two-wheeler is wearing a helmet or not, infrared sensors can be used. This system deploys alcohol detectors and checks seat belts. These seat belt sensors can determine if a person is buckled up or not. When these are automatically broken, the proposed system manages the vehicles by either stopping or not starting to implement intelligent vehicle management to reduce road accidents. The role of IoT in this system is crucial as it enables real-time data collection, processing, and enforcement of traffic regulations, thereby significantly reducing accident rates and improving overall road safety.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model for Parkinson's Disease Detection Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Parkinson's Disease (PD) poses challenges in early diagnosis due to its subtle initial symptoms. Voice analysis offers a non-invasive approach to potentially overcome this hurdle. This study investigates the application of machine learning algorithms to classify PD based on speech recordings. By pre-processing data through discretization, this study aims to enhance the performance of these algorithms. The research findings suggest that this approach holds the potential for developing an effective screening tool for PD, facilitating early detection and intervention.

articleTitle: Real Time Cattle Health Monitoring and Early Disease Detection Using IoT and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Efficient cattle farming demands robust livestock management for optimal health and productivity. This study introduces comprehensive framework for real time cattle monitoring and early disease detection. It employs LoRa communication IoT devices, machine learning algorithms and a mobile application. LoRa based sensors on cattle collect real time health data. This data is transmitted seamlessly over long distances. It is sent to a cloud platform for processing. The proposed framework utilizes machine learning algorithms. It focuses on the Subspace k-Nearest Neighbors (kNN) classifier. This has been validated through a comparative analysis of 10 classifiers. Subspace kNN consistently outperforms others. It accurately classifies diseases earlier. Intricate early detection algorithms notify livestock managers through a mobile application. This enables timely intervention. This allows for proactive healthcare measures. The proposed framework offers multifaceted benefits. These include proactive disease management improved livestock welfare, reduced economic losses and enhanced overall farm productivity. The mobile application provides intuitive visualization and alerts. This educates farmers with actionable insights. By integrating LoRa IoT, cloud computing mobile application and Subspace kNN classifier, this system offers scalable and effective solution for real time cattle monitoring. This holistic approach streamlines monitoring. Equipping farmers for proactive decision making. It fosters a healthier more productive livestock environment. Subspace kNN's consistent accuracy justifies its selection. It contributes to sustainable and efficient cattle farming practices.

articleTitle: A Review on the Integration of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly influential in health care, offering potential enhancements in diagnosis, patient care, and treatment therapies. By utilizing large datasets and sophisticated algorithms, AI assists healthcare professionals in making informed decisions, including resource allocation. For effective and safe use, professionals require adequate training and education in these technologies. AI also allows patients by improving their understanding of health conditions and providing customized solutions for diagnosis and treatment. However, concerns about data privacy, security, and ethical use are dominant. Companies must ensure that patient data is protected from breaches and misuse and is not exploited for identification or control purposes. Additionally, there are ongoing debates about the transparency, and accountability of AI systems in healthcare. This study highlights the necessity for enabling stringent regulatory frameworks to ensure these technologies are used ethically and responsibly, increasing the trust and reliability in their application within the healthcare sector.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Driven Exploration and Stages Classification of Liver Cirrhosis: A Comprehensive Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Liver cirrhosis, a progressive liver disease, necessitates accurate and timely staging for optimal patient management. This study proposes a novel approach combining exploratory data analysis (EDA) with machine learning (ML) to enhance liver cirrhosis classification. By leveraging clinical and laboratory data, EDA will identify key predictors of disease progression. Subsequently, KNN, XGBoost, Random Forest, and Gradient Boosting algorithms will be applied to classify disease stages with precision. The integration of EDA and ML aims to improve risk stratification, treatment decisions, and overall patient outcomes in liver cirrhosis management.

articleTitle: Stock Data Prediction and Visualization using Advanced Learning and Dash Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The modern financial market faces the challenge of identifying an effective approach for predicting stock market prices and making informed investment decisions. The stock market is a complex, transformative system, and long-term investments are crucial. However, evaluating shares and calculating basic company values is challenging. This research work presents a comparison of machine learning-aided algorithms for predicting future stock market prices and analyzing market behavior. The method accurately analyzes supervised algorithms and compares the best ones for predicting future stock market prices. The market is influenced by factors like economics, making market analysis and forecasts crucial for informed decision-making and maximizing investment returns. The research work presents a new method for visualizing and predicting products using Dash, a Python framework for web applications. The methodology involves acquiring historical stock data from reliable sources and preprocessing it to extract relevant features. This data is then integrated into a user-friendly dashboard for interactive trend exploration and future stock price forecasting. The dashboard offers interactive charts, analyses, and correlation matrices to understand stock data structure while using advanced learning techniques like ARIMA and LSTM networks for accurate forecasts. Forecasting aids in making informed decisions and reducing risk in volatile markets. It integrates features into a user-friendly dashboard, helping investors overcome trading complexities and achieve financial objectives. However, there's a need for more predictable and efficient algorithms, making them accessible and interfaced.

articleTitle: A Smart Vehicle Monitoring System Using Real-Time Data Processing and Advanced Sensor Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The “Smart Vehicle Monitoring System” presents a comprehensive solution for enhancing road safety and user authentication in the realm of modern transportation. This system integrates advanced technologies to monitor crucial aspects of vehicle usage, ensuring both the rider's safety and the vehicle's safety. The core functionalities encompass monitoring the usage of safety gear such as helmets and detecting alcohol consumption. User authentication is achieved through a combination of fingerprint recognition and Radio-frequency identification (RFID). This multi-layered approach ensures that only authorized individuals can operate the vehicle. The proposed system further extends its capabilities to monitor essential vehicle parameters, including tire pressure and fuel levels. In the event of an accident, a vibration sensor is employed to swiftly detect impact, triggering an alert system through GSM communication. This timely notification ensures prompt assistance and emergency response. Wireless communication plays a vital role in the system, with the helmet connected to an Arduino Mega via the ESP protocol. This acilitates real-time data exchange, allowing for seamless integration of various components. To enhance user interface and information dissemination, the system utilizes an LCD to present real-time status updates. Additionally, the integration of a GPS module enables the sharing of live location data, contributing to improved navigation and overall safety. In conclusion, the Smart Vehicle Monitoring System not only prioritizes the safety of the rider but also addresses authentication concerns and provides a holistic approach to vehicle monitoring. Through the amalgamation of cutting-edge technologies, this system aims to redefine the standards of safety and security in contemporary transportation.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Overview on Data Augmentation Techniques for Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A significant number of recent advancements in Deep Learning have significantly benefited from training sets that are both larger and more diversified. Nevertheless, the collection of huge datasets for medical imaging continues to be a challenge due to issues around privacy and the expenses associated with labelling. Through the use of data augmentation, it is feasible to significantly increase the quantity and variety of data that is accessible for training purposes without actually collecting additional samples. Data augmentation techniques span from straightforward changes like cropping, padding, and flipping to more complicated generative models. These transformations are surprisingly powerful despite their apparent simplicity. Different data augmentation procedures are likely to function differently depending on the nature of the input and the visual task that is being performed. As a result of this, it is probable that medical imaging calls for particular augmentation algorithms that are capable of producing believable data samples and enabling the successful regularization of deep neural networks. This paper reviews different data augmentation techniques.

articleTitle: An Efficient DDOS Attack Detection in Software-Defined Networks Using Enhanced Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Software-defined networking (SDN) offers enhanced control over network infrastructure through a central controller, but it remains vulnerable to security threats like DDoS attacks. This paper proposes an automatic attack detection system for SDN, comprising pre-processing, feature selection using Adaptive Walrus Optimization Algorithm (AWaOA), and classification using the enhanced long short-term memory (ELSTM) model. Pre-processing eliminates redundant and missing data, while feature selection optimizes the important features for classification. The ELSTM model then classifies traffic as malicious or legitimate. Performance evaluation includes metrics like accuracy, precision, and recall to assess the effectiveness of the proposed approach in detecting and mitigating DDoS attacks in SDN environments.

articleTitle: Internet of Things (IOT) based Smart Nebulizer System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The prevalence of asthma and other respiratory diseases is increasing due to continuous inhalation of contaminated air. To address this issue, an IoT-based smart nebulizer has been developed with advanced features to aid individuals suffering from chronic pulmonary conditions. Nebulizers are typically used to deliver medication as a mist to patients with respiratory diseases. The proposed smart nebulizer incorporates a high-efficiency jet motor capable of nebulizing 500 ml of air per cycle at a rate of 15 respiratory cycles per minute. It also includes a respiration rate sensor and IoT sensors to monitor patients' respiratory flow during nebulization. This technology is physician-friendly, enabling healthcare providers to remotely set and control the nebulizer's flow rate. The developed IoT-enabled smart nebulizer utilizes Wi-Fi for data transmission and reception, allowing real-time analysis and monitoring of patients' respiratory patterns. This innovation offers a more efficient and controlled way to manage respiratory treatments.

articleTitle: DSA Proficiency Tracker: Personalized Problem Solving and Performance Insights using ReactJS
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Data structures and algorithms play a vital role in the software industry for several reasons. They are fundamental building blocks that help organize and manage data efficiently in software applications. Many students face problems related to selecting problems and tracking their daily performance. To overcome this issue, we need to build a website using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and ReactJS. This website displays scores from different coding platforms like HackerRank, Codechef, LeetCode, etc. Based on the scores, we can suggest problems to the user. Additionally, the website will provide users with personalized insights and recommendations tailored to their individual performance metrics. This includes identifying areas of strengths and weaknesses, suggesting relevant problem sets, and offering resources for improvement. Through this platform, users will have access to a comprehensive toolkit for enhancing their data structures and algorithms proficiency, ultimately empowering them to excel in the competitive landscape of software development.

articleTitle: AI-Enabled DDoS Detection and Mitigation in the Software Defined Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Traditional networks typically employ a decentralized control plane, while Software Defined Networking (SDN), a dynamic networking space, adopts a centralized control system. SDN has many benefits, including precise control, optimized routing, and efficient resource management, making it well-suited for data-centric networks. Despite these benefits, SDNs are susceptible to traffic attack, and the development of robust detection and mitigation strategies. Addressing the challenge of attack with Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) in SDN environment. This research proposes an OpenFlow-based detection approach for mitigation within the control plane. And employs a specific SDN DDoS attack dataset that incorporates unique features. When it comes to DDoS attack detection, deep learning and machine learning models are used for classifying these attacks. The outcomes reveal that a Neural Network demonstrates good performance among the algorithm used on this dataset, achieving an accuracy of 99.4%. Subsequently, the controller takes action blocking the malicious host, employing the addition of blocking rules to the switches.

articleTitle: A Review of Automatic Speaker Verification Systems with Feature Extractions and Spoofing Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Automatic Speaker Verification (ASV) technology is gaining traction in various applications due to its reliance on a unique and natural biometric identifier: a person's voice. This review provides a comprehensive analysis of ASV systems, exploring their core functionalities, underlying principles, and potential benefits. It examines the enrollment and verification processes, where speaker voiceprints are created and compared for user authentication. The review then delves into feature extraction techniques, crucial for differentiating genuine and spoofed voices. Common spoofing attacks like replay attacks and voice mimicry are discussed, along with feature analysis methods for spoof detection. Achieving high accuracy, precision, reliability and security in Automatic Speaker Verification (ASV) systems, particularly in the presence of spoofing attacks, involves a combination of robust feature extraction techniques, advanced machine learning models, and effective anti-spoofing strategies ASVSpoof dataset is used for this research. The study concludes by highlighting ongoing challenges and future directions in ASV research, emphasizing the importance of security, fairness, and continuous advancements in this evolving field.

articleTitle: LSTM with Ensemble ML Algorithms for Sentimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Sentimental analysis can give the prediction about the emotion of the user by considering the text conversation. But still, its struck with the lower accuracy. Hence, the study proposed a novel approach to improve the prediction accuracy. In this research study, Machine learning algorithms are studied carefully with the sample experiments. The proposed approach combines the LSTM with ensemble ML algorithms to do sentimental analysis in the product review. Ensemble ML algorithms includes SVM, KNN, Random Forest. Then LSTM is implemented with the ensemble ML algorithms to improve the accuracy.

articleTitle: IoT-Enhanced Automatic Child Detection System for Cars
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The increasing number of heatstroke-related fatalities among children left in vehicles highlights the urgent need for an effective preventive solution. This paper presents an innovative control system that detects the presence of children in the rear seats of vehicles and promptly alerts their parents. Unlike traditional systems that either invade privacy through camera use or generate frequent false alerts due to pressure sensors, our approach leverages IoT technology combined with advanced sensors and Arduino components to accurately identify children and differentiate them from inanimate objects. This system aims to reduce false alerts, protect privacy, and provide a reliable means of preventing heatstroke deaths by ensuring timely notifications to parents. By addressing the critical issue of child safety in vehicles, this solution offers a significant improvement over existing methods.

articleTitle: Sapota Quality: Bruise Detection and Shelf Life Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The shelf life and consumer appeal of sapota, a tropical fruit, are influenced by fluctuations in its freshness and flavor over time. Apart from classifying bruises, this study looks into the application Using thermal imaging to estimate the shelf life and identify maturity of sapota. This research study intends to predict the shelf life of the sapota, maturity of the sapota and bruises detection for this we collected dataset using fluke thermal camera of 60 sapota fruits, each day for 5 days in order to capture the life cycle of sapota from unripe to ripen state. The weights are monitored for further analysis. Further, a seperate dataset is collected for bruise detection by intentionally damaging the fruit for bruise detection part. The dataset consists of ripen and unripen images together with the number of days that have passed since the photo was taken, along with weights on particular day. For these tasks, various convolutional neural networks CNN ResNet, VGG16 and MobileNet are used. In terms of ripeness classification, shelf life prediction and sapota bruise detection, the efficiencies of the models are assessed and accuracy we got is 93 percent for the best model. These findings suggest that the thermal imaging in combination with deep learning techniques for non-destructive quality Evaluation of sapota fruit may assist in reducing food waste.

articleTitle: Advanced Sensing and Actuation Health Monitoring Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: To address issues including lack of time and access to care, we introduce a novel solution advanced Sensing and Actuation Health Monitoring Robot. This mobile healthcare robot lets users check vital indicators in real-time thanks to its sensors, which include temperature, heart rate, spO2 oximeter, and arterial blood pressure. It also incorporates an ultrasonic sensor to detect impediments while moving, enabling safe mobility. With an emphasis on user-friendly accessibility, our robot removes obstacles to timely health assessments and enables people to perform thorough health exams at their convenience. Personalized identification is ensured by the integration of RFID technology, and smooth movement is made possible by servo motors. This study demonstrates the efficacy of the developed robot in improving patient care, enabling remote monitoring, assuring safety, and lessening the workload of health care providers through an extensive literature review and creative technique. With the successful deployment of this moving medical technology healthcare robot, a new era of patient-centered, data-driven medical services might be ushered in and health care delivery could be revolutionized.

articleTitle: Utilizing the Prophet Model for Time Series Based Stock Price Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Time series analysis and forecasting play a crucial role due to their extensive application across various practical domains. Time series data represents a sequential order or collection of data points depicting the values of a variable at regular time intervals. The stock market is widely regarded as one of the most intricate financial systems, comprising numerous components or stocks, whose prices fluctuate significantly over time. Stock market forecasting aims to reveal the trends within the market as they evolve. All investors in the stock market strive to maximize returns on their investments while minimizing associated risks Due to the high sensitivity and rapid changes in stock markets, the primary objective of stock-trend prediction is to devise innovative approaches that can anticipate stocks leading to substantial profits. A statistical model capable of predicting Indian stock prices will be constructed using time series data from the Indian stock market. In our study, we utilize daily stock price data from a prominent company listed on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) of India.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Sentiment Analysis of Pharmaceutical Reviews
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In today's digital era, where the internet is a treasure trove of information, shaping various aspects of our life including the research field. Exploring the vast amount of information that can be accessed online, this research delves into the area of sentiment analysis, specifically concentrating on assessments of pharmaceutical sourced from multiple websites. This study incorporates various features like users' health condition, drug ratings and intake dates with the objective of interpreting drug users' sentiments through their feedback. We carefully analyzed the data using method like descriptive statistics and data visualization followed by testing various machine learning model such as Light GBM model, Random Forest Classifier, and LSTM Model and we found the accuracy ranging from 90% to 95.7%. We used the dataset from the UCI machine learning repository with over 161297 reviews and 7 features. Since the reviews didn't have sentiment labels we came up with the new method, we assigned sentiment labels on the ratings given by the user either positive or negative. This helped us uncover the hidden sentiment in the reviews. Overall, this research study highlights how people feel about drugs and its impact on experience and treatment outcomes.

articleTitle: Voice Assisted Smart Blind Stick
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The concept of Smart Blind Stick develops an innovative electronic aid designed for blind individual, particularly in the detection of obstacles during navigation. The proposed system uses an Arduino UNO platform to provide artificial vision and real-time object detection abilities, mainly focused on sound-based assistance to enhance the independence of blind persons. The main idea behind this research is to challenge the level of flexibility that sighted people experience. The focus was given for creating a smart assistive device which includes object detection, artificial intelligence and integration of GPS module through Arduino Uno. The system integrates ultrasonic sensors, with auditory feedback providing information both static and dynamic, thereby allowing visually impaired persons to navigate independently. The objective is to provide a cost-effective and efficient navigation and obstacle detection device that presents artificial vision, helping independent mobility for the visually impaired in various environmental situations.

articleTitle: Fetal Congenital Heart Disease Detection Using Firefly Segmentation and Decision Tree Classification Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Identifying congenital heart disease (CHD) during the fetal stage is challenging, making it difficult to detect in its early phases. CHD can be slightly visualized in ultrasound scan during pregnancy which will make some serious effects to infants after child birth. CHD detection using machine learning algorithm is proposed in this work which will identify birth defects in early stages and thus the medical experts can take necessary decision in right time. Firefly algorithm for image segmentation and decision tree classifier for CHD detection is used in this work. After conducting the validation and testing of the proposed methodology, several measures are available to evaluate the effectiveness of the classifier, such as the precision of the input data, precision of given value, recall of data, and F1 score value. These measures are important in assessing the effectiveness of the classifier's ability to make accurate classifications. These metrics offer insightful data about how effectively the classifier perform in terms of accurately classifying instances and handling various error types. An F1 score of 87.88%, accuracy of 88%, precision of 88.78%, and recall of 87% are obtained using the suggested approach. Collectively, these measures evaluate how well the classifier performed in correctly identifying the data. When compared to the existing methodology, the proposed method yields improved classification results.

articleTitle: Focusing & Implementing Long Term Projects by using Agile Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Agile project management lets cross functional areas and make the entire team to work and make sure to split the entire project into pieces and focus on solving the problems and making the entire team to deliver their features in short phase. This makes each team to execute their delivery promptly without any obstacles and give more frequent updates to the customer which in turn makes client happy. A continuous improvement from each team makes to deliver a big project quickly and if there is any additional updates (changes) from business, it may be considered without disturbing the existing flow. In few situations, if a project is in mid phase and if any new resource started his development activity and client asking for multiple tasks in the current sprint then it will be a problematic situation to overcome. This paper focus on those situations and discuss how to make sure to overcome this and give a best approach for the immediate multiple request from client.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Micromachined Antenna for 60 GHz Millimeter-Wave Applications with Wet Etching Process using Inset-Fed Technique and Substrate Removal Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study investigates the simulation and modeling of a microfabricated antenna designed to operate within the millimeter-wave spectrum at a frequency of 60 GHz. The antenna configuration proposed in this work is simulated on a gallium arsenide substrate with a dielectric constant 12.9. A unique aspect of this design is incorporating an angled side wall with a 54-degree inclination from vertical., which is achieved through a simulated wet etching process. The compact antenna dimensions of 2.1 mm x 2 mm make it suitable for integration into miniaturized devices. The simulations were performed utilizing the High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) software, which is a computational electromagnetics tool for analyzing and designing complex RF and high-speed components. The antenna design employs an inset-fed technique to facilitate impedance matching and efficient power transfer. Additionally, a substrate removal technique was simulated to enhance the maximum gain. The simulation results demonstrate excellent performance, with the antenna attaining a maximum gain of 6.24 dBi, an exceptional return loss of -74.55 dB, and a voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) of 1, indicating near-perfect impedance matching. These simulated results highlight the potential of this micromachined antenna design for a range of applications within the millimeter-wave frequency band, such as high-speed wireless communications, radar systems, and imaging devices, subject to successful fabrication and real-world testing.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Forecast, Treatment, and Diagnosis of Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Deep learning, a subset of artificial intelligence, is revolutionizing cancer research by unlocking insights from complex biological data. Leveraging neural networks, researchers can analyze vast datasets to identify patterns and predict disease progression. Applications span genomics, transcriptomics, methylation, and histopathology, enabling the integration of diverse data types for comprehensive cancer understanding. This review explores the potential of deep learning in cancer diagnosis, treatment planning, and prognosis prediction. While promising, challenges such as data accessibility and model interpretability hinder widespread adoption. Addressing these limitations is crucial for realizing the full potential of deep learning in precision oncology.

articleTitle: Explainable AI in Healthcare: Enhancing Transparency and Trust in Predictive Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Explainable AI in healthcare brings transparency and trust to predictive models, empowering doctors and patients to understand decision-making processes. Validating models against clinical expertise improves accuracy and addresses ethical concerns. Real-life examples include detecting lung cancer nodules and predicting sepsis. The future holds enhanced diagnosis and treatment strategies, improved patient engagement, and deeper insights into algorithmic decision-making.

articleTitle: DeepText: Pioneering the Future of Text Classification with Innovative Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Text classification is an extremely vital task in Natural Language Processing, and it is utilized in many different applications. As there is increase in number of complicated documents there is need for deeper comprehension of machine learning techniques which will be able to identify text in various application. Text classification can be used to organize large amounts of unstructured data. Text classification witnessed remarkable advancements through the application of deep learning techniques. These techniques can be used in various classification tasks through which the strengths and weakness could be analyzed. The study analyzes different text classification methods with wide range of datasets which is applicable for the classification tasks. The advantages and limitations of text classification techniques with different datasets are listed out in order to identify the best technique out of all the available techniques.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of DC-AC-DC High Frequency Converter in MATLAB/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: High-frequency converters are being used more nowadays for their isolation in nature along with their efficient controllable output voltage. These converters can be related to the choppers, which are DC-DC converters. A combination of an isolated High-frequency transformer and chopper results in High-frequency converters. These converters are typically used to rectify power factor or reduce output voltage ripple in order to improve system efficiency for any connected load. The current study covers a DC-AC-DC single-stage converter using a high-frequency isolated transformer to reduce output voltage ripple, which may be suited for DC applications such as SMPS and EV and the results have been presented in the form of graphs and tables.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Enabled Blockage Detection in Micro-Irrigation System by Using Drones
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Drip irrigation systems, while efficient in water usage, often suffer from clogged emitters, leading to crop loss. To address this challenge, a drone-based solution is proposed. Equipped with image processing capabilities and controlled by loT, the drone can identify clogged emitters and potentially clear obstructions. Additionally, the system can collect salty water from the irrigation system, contributing to overall water management. This integrated approach aims to optimize water utilization, enhance crop yield, and mitigate the impacts of water scarcity in agriculture.

articleTitle: Microcontroller-Based Line Successor Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The line successor robot is a mobile device that moves along the designated black or white path on the surface. It is intended to follow the predetermined path on its own. The proposed setup explains how an Arduino UNO microcontroller and infrared sensors are used to operate a line follower robot. This robot is intended to travel along a predetermined route. In order to save labor costs and time spent on building sites, schools, colleges, and other organizations, this paper covers the usage of Arduino-powered line follower robots in numerous fields. These robots can be used to convey necessary items.

articleTitle: IoT based Smart Voice and Gesture Controlled Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The voice and gesture-controlled wheelchair introduces a new solution for the mobility of physically challenge ones. With the help of both voice command control and gesture control the wheelchair helps the person to navigate easily trough their life with ease and precision. By combining the three modes of control that are manual, gesture and voice control, the user can easily interact with the wheelchair without any difficulty. All the three modes of commands will be given through the app with the help of mobile. The wheelchair can be connected through Bluetooth with the mobile and the inputs will be given from the mobile phone through the application that is already installed in the mobile phone. The commands will be given through the mobile phone and the command will be transferred with the help of Bluetooth module connected to microcontroller. The required command will be executed with the help of microcontroller which has a set of command codes uploaded in it.

articleTitle: Automatic Framework for the Detection of Fish Aggregation in Acoustic Images Using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Fish aggregation is a critical component of marine ecology and fisheries management, yet traditional detection and monitoring methods in acoustic images are labor-intensive and time-consuming. This work presents an automatic framework to detect fish aggregations using advanced deep learning techniques. The framework starts by training the dataset with the U-Net architecture, focusing on softmax layer training for network estimation and feature extraction based on the fishes' length and width. The input includes images of various fish sizes, such as small and moderate fish. The initial pre-processing of these images involves spatial domain techniques (resizing, brightness adjustment, and RGB to grayscale conversion) and frequency domain techniques (noise removal using filters like median, Gaussian, and Canny edge). To extract the segmented region, methods like the Association for Computing Machinery (ACM), K-means, and Multi-Informational Fusion Network for Sea-Land Segmentation are considered, with ACM being used for feature extraction based on the region of interest. K-means is applied for binary segmentation. Experiments conducted on the dataset demonstrated the framework's effectiveness, achieving high accuracy in detecting fish aggregations.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Characteristics in Bushing Under Dry and Wet Configuration
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The unwanted condition known as partial discharge (PD) shortens the lifespan of power system equipment and permanently damages it. PD typically occurs in defect locations like voids, cavities, cracks, and joints. In most cases, PD does not result in an abrupt breakdown. It is possible to assess the damage caused by a discharge based on the type of discharge, such as electrical treeing, surface or internal discharge, corona, etc. PD noise reduction PD indicators and diagnosis The two main fields of study in the analysis of PD are sources. For power apparatus to operate safely and to be monitored for malfunctions, the PD signal must be measured and identified. Transistor bushings are insulators that make it easier for a current-carrying, energized wire to pass through the grounded transformer tank. Draw-lead bushings are also referred to as bushings with built-in conductors, such bottom-connected bushings, or bushings with holes for a separate conductor to be drawn through the center of the bushing. Bulk or solid type and capacitance-graded (also known as condenser type) bushing construction are the two main varieties. The low voltage winding(s) of a transformer's solid bushings is often encased in an epoxy or porcelain insulator. Transformer high voltage windings employ capacitance-graded bushings since they are made for higher voltage ratings. Transformer asset owners place a high value on bushing quality because they are frequently cited as one of the main reasons for transformer failures. Typical bushing failure modes include a damaged tap connection, corrosive sulfur, and moisture infiltration. Electrical field testing provides information on the integrity of the bushings.

articleTitle: AI-Based Nutritional Assessment for Object Detection and Food Quantification
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Global health concerns like obesity, diabetes, and other diet disorders have been identified by modern scientists, risking health concerns globally. Significant advancements in automated food calorie computation are achieved with image recognition technology and nutritional data. Visual attributes of food item classes are determined using a deep learning technique with a caloric information dataset. Rapid and accurate nutrition monitoring is offered with this instrument having accuracy and efficiency. A wide range of applications of data for nutritionists and healthcare professionals are also obtained apart from calorie tracking of people. Poor eating habits of chronic disease risk can be minimised by nutritional choices using “food calorie estimation automation”. Dietary goals and a healthy lifestyle can be achieved by integration which acts as an alternative to favoured meals. For promoting preventative healthcare practices significant advancement in nutrition management assisted technology is studied. Because of its precision, efficiency, and user-friendly interface, this groundbreaking technology is set to become a critical tool for anyone seeking to manage their diets and establish healthier lifestyles.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Med Vault - Biometric-based Medical Record System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The “Med Vault - Biometric Based Medical Record System” is an innovative solution proposed in this research study to streamline medical records management using biometric technology. Despite its promising concept, several aspects need improvement. Firstly, the reliance on biometric authentication raises privacy and security concerns. Although biometrics provide a convenient way to verify identity, they are not foolproof. Hackers could potentially gain access to sensitive medical information by bypassing or manipulating the biometric authentication process. Therefore, the developers of Med Vault must invest in robust encryption and security measures to protect patient data. Additionally, the system's effectiveness heavily relies on widespread adoption by healthcare providers. Without universal implementation, patients may still face challenges when accessing their medical records across different healthcare facilities. It would be beneficial for Med Vault to partner with major healthcare organizations and incentivize them to integrate this system into their existing infrastructure. Furthermore, while Med Vault claims to improve efficiency by reducing paperwork and administrative tasks, it fails to address potential issues related to data entry errors or incomplete records. The accuracy and completeness of medical records are essential for providing quality care, and any system aiming to revolutionize record-keeping should prioritize these aspects. In conclusion, while the “Med Vault - Biometric Based Medical Record System” presents an exciting opportunity for improving medical record management, significant areas require attention before its widespread implementation can be considered successful. Addressing privacy concerns, ensuring universal adoption among healthcare providers, and prioritizing the accuracy and completeness of records will be key factors in determining its long-term viability as a solution for efficient medical record management.

articleTitle: Enhanced Cloud Security Through DNA-based Authentication for Data Storage and Transactions
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Cloud computing has experienced rapid growth, yet data breaches and unauthorized account access continue to be significant threats. Traditional cryptographic authentication methods, although mathematically complex, often fall short in computational security. This research study integrates deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) computing to enhance cloud security through biological authentication protocols, making it suitable for widespread use. This study introduces a DNA-based cryptographic key system that exploits synthetic DNA's dense information capacity. This system integrates biochemically secure DNA signatures with current cloud architectures, providing multi-factor authentication (MFA) and encrypted access to sensitive data and transactions. The DNA cryptography protocols developed offer robust defense against common attacks, such as password leaks. Additionally, the inherent massive parallelism in biochemical reactions supports efficient processing of authentication requests, even under heavy cloud workloads.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation for Improving the Performance of Raga (Music Genre) Classification Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The ability to identify the ragas (music genres) of Indian musical compositions is considered to be a rare talent or gift among musicians and music aficionados. It would take years of rigorous training and exposure to various ragas for elevating an ardent learner of music to such levels of expertise. Machine learning supported raga identification systems try to mimic this cognitive ability of an ace musician to recognize the patterns or signatures of ragas so that the ragas of music compositions can be identified. In this work, the audio samples obtained from the flute concerts of a legendary flutist were analyzed for recognizing the ragas. First a convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm based raga classification system was developed with mel-spectrogram as input which yielded an accuracy of 52.4%. When this system was revamped with the techniques of data augmentation, the classification accuracy was substantially enhanced to 83%. This system can be made more versatile by incorporating more ragas in the corpus, by including signals from musical instruments other than flute and by incorporating signals from vocal concerts and also musical renderings set on different sruthis (tonic).

articleTitle: Enhancing Named Entity Recognition using Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Named Entity Recognition is crucial in Natural Language Processing for identifying and classifying entities within text. This paper presents a comparative analysis of three deep learning models: Feedforward Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks, and Convolutional Neural Networks for Named Entity Recognition(NER) tasks. Within the Feedforward Neural Network category, Multi-Layer Perceptrons(MLP) were utilized. For Recurrent Neural Networks, the analysis included simple RNNs, Long Short-Term Memory networks (LSTM), and Gated Recurrent Units (GRU). Evaluated on standard Named Entity Recognition datasets, the models demonstrated significant improvements in accuracy, achieving the highest performance. This study highlights the strengths and limitations of each model, providing valuable insights for future Named Entity Recognition research and applications.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning-Random Forest Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) pose a significant global health challenge. Early and accurate diagnosis is crucial for effective treatment. This research focuses on developing a robust classification system for CVDs using machine learning techniques. This study proposes an enhanced Random Forest (RF) model optimized for big data environments and explore the potential of CNN-based classification. By leveraging medical imaging data and employing these advanced algorithms, we aim to improve the accuracy and efficiency of CVD diagnosis.

articleTitle: Microbial Image Data Enhancement Framework with Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study presents a comprehensive framework for enhancing microbial image data using a deep learning algorithm to improve the quality and analysis of microscopic images. The framework includes a deep learning-based image de-noising algorithm, an image anti-blurring algorithm, and an edge enhancement algorithm. The image de-noising process utilizes an iterative learning mapping function to progressively approximate actual noise distribution, resulting in clearer images with reduced noise. The image anti-blurring algorithm employs GAN-based methods to adjust and correct blur information caused by sample movements or lens jitter. The edge enhancement technique uses the Sobel operator to extract and enhance edge features, thereby improving the visual clarity and detail of microbial images. To evaluate the performance of the framework, a diverse database of 1,000,000 microbial images was constructed using the Google image search engine. The effectiveness of the approach was evaluated using three key parameters: Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index (SSIM), and Model Classification Accuracy (MCA). Experimental results show significant improvements in all metrics, with the proposed methods achieving an average PSNR of 29.0 dB, an average SSIM of 0.923, and an average MCA of 85%. These results highlight the potential of the proposed framework to improve image quality and accuracy in microbial image analysis.

articleTitle: Object Localization Using Deep Neural Network with Pytorch
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study delves into object localization within computer vision, addressing its critical role in applications such as robotics and medical image analysis. It explores various methodologies, including bounding box regression, which utilizes region-based and anchor-based approaches. The report evaluates deep learning models for object localization, such as Faster R-CNN, YOLO, and SSD, detailing their strengths and limitations. Applications across autonomous vehicles, surveillance systems, medical imaging, and augmented reality are examined, highlighting tasks like object tracking, scene understanding, and semantic segmentation. Challenges such as occlusion, scale variation, and computational complexity are also discussed. Furthermore, the study surveys current research trends and upcoming advancements in object localization, such as multi-object tracking, instance segmentation, and 3D object localization, highlighting their potential impact on future developments in the field.

articleTitle: Real-Time Implementation of an Automated Student Attendance Monitoring System with Computer Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Computer vision and the Internet of Things have led to significant advancements in student attendance monitoring. In this work, an innovative system has been designed to facilitate real-time, automated student attendance tracking in educational environments. Utilizing face recognition algorithms and IOT. The aim of the system is to optimize attendance management in educational institutions. IoT-connected, high-resolution cameras are strategically positioned across classrooms to capture visual data for analysis. By utilizing advanced computer vision algorithms, the system identifies and tracks students in real time, facilitating precise and efficient attendance monitoring. Student Faces are detected using a Haar cascade classifier and recognized using the LBPH (Local Binary Pattern Histogram) Algorithm. Then, Histogram data is checked against an established dataset. If a Match is found, the device automatically labels attendance. The Integration of IoT helps in seamless data transmission, storage and ensures accessibility and analysis of attendance records by administrators and educators. The primary objective is to offer an intelligent, automated solution for attendance management, that will significantly reduce manual workload and enhances accuracy. This system addresses the limitations of conventional attendance-taking methods, which are often laborintensive, error-prone, and time-consuming.

articleTitle: An Unsupervised Learning Model Investigation for Data Inaccuracies in Comparison with Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Solar energy, a crucial renewable resource, demands accurate forecasting for efficient grid integration. This study employs unsupervised machine learning techniques to predict solar power generation using a five-year dataset. Data preprocessing, including imputation and feature reduction, was conducted to enhance model performance. Autoencoder, Mean Shift Clustering, and DBSCAN algorithms were applied, with performance evaluated using RMSE, R2, MAE, and MAPE metrics. Comparative analysis revealed DBSCAN as the superior model, achieving an accuracy exceeding 70%. This research contributes to the advancement of solar power forecasting and grid management.

Author Keywords: Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise

articleTitle: Smart Fire Digital Twin Scene and Multi-Terminal Collaboration: A Systematic Design
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Digital Twin technology has emerged as a critical tool in various fields, integrating multidisciplinary data to construct virtual models that reflect physical entities throughout their life cycle. This study explores the application of digital twin technology in the context of intelligent fire protection systems, emphasizing the need for a systematic design approach to ensure compatibility, stability, and efficiency. Through a comprehensive examination of hardware-software integration, data processing, fault tolerance, and real-time monitoring, this study outlines a systematic approach to the design of intelligent fire protection systems. Furthermore, the implementation of a digital twin scene and multi-terminal collaboration is elucidated, highlighting the five-dimensional structural model and the role of virtual space. The proposed system is subjected to simulation and systematic verification, demonstrating its effectiveness in real-time data collection, modeling performance, and decision support. This research provides valuable insights into the systematic design and implementation of intelligent fire protection systems using digital twin technology.

articleTitle: Row-wise Hamming Code for Memory Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The increasing vulnerability of memory devices to errors due to smaller transistor sizes, larger densities, and lower operating voltages raises the demand for efficient Error Correcting Codes (ECC) in memory systems in contemporary applications. Effective ECCs are essential for preserving system dependability and data integrity, particularly in mission-critical applications including data centers, aircraft, medical equipment, and automotive systems. ECCs have dramatically improved data integrity and system reliability across fields such as telecommunications, cloud computing, and automotive technology. The “Row-Wise Hamming” leverages an optimized row-wise encoding and decoding mechanism that significantly reduces redundancy. In comparison to current ECC systems, the proposed Row-wise Hamming coding methodology optimizes memory dependability by reducing power consumption, area, and maximum delay by 40 %. The results from experiments establish the superior computational overhead performance of Row-Wise Hamming ECC, hence establishing it as a highly favorable solution for modern memory dependability issues.

articleTitle: A Literature Review on the Detection of Mental Illness
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: One of the most frequent psychological disorders is depression. The major challenge is a quick and accurate diagnosis of the condition. Self-reporting surveys are the tools that medical professionals utilize to develop a diagnosis. These tests were created by looking at various depressed symptoms. The effectiveness of conventional approaches is, however, adversely impacted by things like societal stigmas. Due to general ignorance and societal stigma, these mental health conditions are costly to detect clinically and frequently go untreated. Presently, using social media websites for expressing and interacting with one's thoughts, emotions, and sentiments is the preferred method of communication. The aim of this study is to assess several methods for non-clinical, predictive early identification and diagnosis of depression, self-harm, and suicide thoughts in online social network material. This study will help for future researcher work.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of 2D Convolution using Diverse Adder – Multiplier combination
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study gives a comparative analysis of two distinct multiplier-adder combination, a Vedic multiplier with Ripple carry adder (VMRCA) and a Wallace tree multiplier with Kogge stone adder (WMKSA), applied in the context of 2-dimensional convolution operation. The proposed work aims to assess the performance metrics such as the number of LUTs (Look Up Tables), Power, and Delay associated with each architecture. The Vedic Multiplier, rooted in ancient Indian Mathematics, and the Wallace Tree Multiplier, which offers parallel processing for improved efficiency are utilized here. Through comprehensive evaluation and experimentation, this paper provides insights into the trade-offs between these architectures, providing valuable inputs for their usage in the field of High-performance computing applications, Image Processing, and Convolution operations. The entire software simulation is performed on Xilinx ISE and prototyped on Xilinx Spartan 6 FPGA board.

articleTitle: Analysing the Performance of IRS-Aided Short-Packet Rate-Splitting Multiple Access System with Correlated Superposition Coders for Multi-User Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Rate-Splitting Multiple Access (RSMA) and Intelligent Reflecting Surface (IRS) have emerged as versatile and potent models for modern 5G wireless networks. This research work proposes a new multi user communication framework by using RSMA and IRS for enabling synchronized transmission to multiple users. In the proposed system, the Base station (BS) intends to establish wireless communications with a remote RSMA users via different IRS equipped with several reflecting components. In the considered system model, the concept of rate-splitting (RS) will be used at the Base station (BS) In the base station (BS) setup, every user's The message is split into two parts: a shared common segment and a private segment. The common segments from all users are encoded together into a unified stream using a universally shared codebook, while private messages are individually encoded into private streams for each user. The channel between the Base Station (BS) and IRS is modeled as a Rayleigh flat fading channel. The IRS provides instantaneous Channel State Information (CSI) feedback in terms of Signal-to-Interference-Noise Ratio (SINR). Hence, the SINR at IRS (first hop-link) will be computed initially and it will be periodically send to BS. Then, BS sorts the received CSIs (SINR) in increasing order of magnitude from the lowest CSI to the highest CSI. The proposed Partial IRS Selection method will select the RIS that provide the highest SINR for the first hop in the Base station and the Relay station. Hence, the Base station will be communicated with the RSMA user by using one of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N$</tex> available RISs as an intermediate link.

articleTitle: Efficiency Improvement in Solar Cells: Comparing Single Junction and Tandem Photovoltaic's by Varying Anti-Reflective Coating Thickness
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study explores the efficiency comparison between a single-junction photovoltaic cell and a tandem photovoltaic cell by varying the thickness of the anti-reflective coating using the nano-Hub simulator. In this research, we have collected 40 samples from single-junction and tandem photovoltaic solar cells. The study separates the solar cells into two groups: Group 1, consisting of single junction solar cells with 20 samples, and Group 2, consisting of tandem solar cells with 20 samples. To find the better solar cells, we have used statistical tool. Based on the concept of statistics the computations use G-power 0.8, with alpha set at 0.05 and beta at 0.2, ensuring a 95% confidence interval. From the study, we found the efficiency of the tandem cell is greater (i.e., 62.89%) than that of the single junction cell (i.e., 55.38%). The simulation study shows a p-value of 0.02, indicating statistical significance at a level less than 0.005. The research findings show that adjusting the thickness of the anti-reflective coating leads to superior performance in tandem solar cells compared to single-junction solar cells.

articleTitle: Facial Recognition Authentication in Electoral Processes using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Elections serve as the basis of democratic governance by offering people the power to elect their Delegates. Upholding the integrity and trust worthiness of these election procedures is vital in preserving democratic values. This work is dedicated to reinforcing the trust through the implementation of progressive technology to safeguard the duplicity of the voting process. The initiative focuses on bolstering the security measures within electoral systems by harnessing advanced facial recognition technology. Leveraging Raspberry Pi a compact computing solution paired with cameras, the aim is to authenticate voters' identities accurately. To achieve this, we utilized the FaceNet model from DeepFace library, which in comparison with other models, was found to have a greater accuracy of 99.63%. Facial recognition integration is a proactive measure to deter fraudulent practices, particularly voter impersonation, during election processes. The primary objective is to establish an electoral system characterized by security and trustworthiness. Facial recognition technology in this context seeks to validate each vote's legitimacy and ensure it corresponds to the rightful voter. This approach aims to instill confidence in the electing process, providing a fair-minded and dependable system aligned with democratic principles of honesty and transparency.

articleTitle: Design of a Deep Learning-Based Autonomous Vehicle Environmental Perception and Decision-Making System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Advances in computing power and sensor technology have propelled substantial advancements in autonomous vehicles, particularly in high-precision positioning, environmental perception, and intelligent decision-making. This study introduces a novel deep learning-based environmental perception and decision-making system for autonomous vehicles aimed at mitigating the challenges encountered in current studies. The proposed system employs advanced machine learning algorithms and deep neural network technology to rapidly and accurately adjust to a variety of intricate driving scenarios. The system integrates a range of sensors, encompassing cameras, radar, and Lidar, to thoroughly detect objects in the vehicle's environment and enhance driving safety and efficiency. Detailed methodologies, encompassing sensor fusion techniques and model construction, are delineated. Simulation results attest to the system's efficacy in precisely perceiving the environment and making astute driving decisions. Through the comprehensive analysis, the proposed system demonstrates superior adaptability, generalization capabilities, and performance relative to traditional rule-based control methods, thereby offering significant potential for enhancing the safety and efficiency of autonomous driving.

articleTitle: In-Depth Exploration of the Advantages of Neural Networks in English Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Machine translation, an emerging field in artificial intelligence, has attracted considerable attention from academia and industry. This study presents an in-depth investigation of the advantages of neural networks for English machine translation. The study first reviews state-of-the-art neural network models and proposes an innovative methodology for efficient neural network-based machine translation. The proposed approach includes text semantic understanding, a neural network-based translation algorithm, and the use of deep belief networks (DBFs) for feature extraction. The study conducts experiments using a data-set consisting of 3000 pairs of corpora from the different repositories, including historical documents and online resources. The study evaluates the translation performance of our proposed model against popular translation tools such as Google and Baidu. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our proposed model in terms of translation quality.
