articleTitle: The Impact of Deep Belief Networks on the Early Diagnosis of Parkinson's Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: PD, or Parkinson's Disease, is a neurodegenerative disorder that commonly disorients movement abilities. Hence, correctly identifying this disease at its early stages is essential for appropriate treatment. The conventional diagnostic methods are usually not able to accurately identify the early signs of Parkinson's disease (PD) as they depend on the visible symptoms and the patient's self-reports. The study suggests deploying a deep belief network (DBN) method, considered a highly advanced machine learning algorithm, which is more of a memory structure capable of learning deeply and hierarchically. Their study implied the use of a DBM model for a diverse data set of 500 PD subjects suspected to have disease in its early stage. The dataset contains medical records, speaking analysis, audio recordings of subjects, and biometric monitoring. The model was trained using a two-phase training approach. The first phase is an unsupervised pre-training process to learn general characteristics. The results were very encouraging: the DBN model achieved an accuracy of 93%, yielded a sensitivity of 90%, specificity of 93% and AVC of 0. 7. 97. The performance of these measures was better than that of the ordinary diagnostic methods, which had an accuracy of 85%, a sensitivity of 80%, a specificity of 85% and an AVC of 0.85.

articleTitle: Low-Cost System to Characterize the Biomechanics of the Horse Using Video Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this study biomechanics of the Peruvian Paso horse is analyzed, this horse is characterized by having three types of gaits, the walk, the trot and the gallop. The paso horse is characterized by its body structure and the shape of its flat gait, evidenced by the particularity of the movement of its limbs, which gives the sensation that it is dancing. The study presents a low-cost method for the registration of the movement, based on passive sensors, which works in conjunction with a recording system, where the movement of the horse is recorded and with it the markers, which were located on the right side of the horse, the markers are located on the right knee of the right leg, a second marker on the right arm, a third on the back, a fourth on the buttock, a fifth on the hip and a sixth on the belly. As a result, the study presents the movement of each of the markers to analyze and create a movement pattern of the Peruvian Paso horse.

articleTitle: Smart Drive Safe: Harnessing CNN for Enhanced Traffic Sign Recognition and Voice Alerts
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Traffic signs secure their safety on the roads and the protection of others around them; everyone must be aware of traffic signs and other aspects of road safety. Traffic sign detection is a highly relevant computer vision problem that forms the basis of numerous applications in sectors like the automotive industry. Between classes, traffic signs differ widely in terms of colour, shape, and the use of pictograms or text. The project's classification of traffic signs in an image into various categories is based on a deep neural network model. IoT devices that capture traffic signs and notify users of them are used to build a model.

articleTitle: Analyzing Loan Approvals Through Supervised Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The main goal of this research work is to apply supervised machine learning algorithms to forecast loan acceptance. The data-set comprises 500 instances with 13 features including socioeconomic attributes and credit history of loan applicants, with the target variable indicating loan approval status. Twelve distinct supervised machine learning algorithms are the subjects of performance comparison. The models are evaluated based on test accuracy scores, precision and F1 Score. Furthermore, utilizing visualization methods like confusion matrices and heat maps to acquire adequate understanding of the model's performance and pinpoint possible areas for enhancement. The test results offer insightful information on how well different machine learning algorithms predict loan acceptance, thereby aiding financial institutions in making informed decisions and mitigating risks associated with lending practices.

articleTitle: Secure EEG: Secure Seizure Prediction using Encryption and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research work introduces a pioneering methodology for predicting seizures by leveraging Electroencephalography (EEG) data in individuals diagnosed with epilepsy. The proposed system combines machine learning algorithms with data encryption techniques to enhance both prediction accuracy and data security. For seizure prediction, LSTM was employed due to its adaptability to varying sequence lengths and capacity for real-time processing, positioning it as a potent tool that holds promise for early prediction, enabling timely intervention and potentially enhancing overall patient well-being. To ensure data privacy, Fernet encryption is employed to encrypt model parameters and test data. The encrypted model demonstrates promising results in seizure prediction accuracy during evaluation, achieving an accuracy score of 97%. Furthermore, the integration of encryption techniques ensures the confidentiality of sensitive EEG information, meeting stringent data security standards. This novel approach presents a robust framework for accurate seizure prediction while addressing critical concerns regarding data privacy in healthcare applications. The obtained results contribute valuable insights into the model's ability to accurately discern between seizure and non-seizure states, crucial for assessing its practical utility in real-world

articleTitle: Re-Thinking of a Transformer on Real Time Text Information
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The field of text prediction systems faces a dual challenge of improving accuracy, enhancing user experience, Learning from large and complex data. Existing Natural Language Processing (NLP) methods often fall short in delivering precise prediction. To address these challenges, we propose an innovative approach integrating Deep Learning techniques, notably a sequential model, with the Django Framework and user interface technologies. The proposed system aims to enhance text prediction accuracy by training information from huge corpus, thus generating domain-specific predictions. Central to our approach is the utilization of backpropagation in Deep Learning, enabling precise fine-tuning of the predictive model. By providing a web-based interface, users can seamlessly interact with the system, while backend Deep Learning operations ensure efficient and accurate results. The proposed system aims to leverage the capabilities of the sequential model in Deep Learning. By extracting knowledge from thetrained information from corpus, the sequential model predicts and generates the next n user-specified words. The proposed approach improves the text prediction accuracy and enhances user experience by ultimately advancing applications in various domains.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Decline in Face-to-Face Communication Due to Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Face-to-face communication is distinguished by the ability to observe the other person during a conversation, enhancing the effectiveness of information transmission through body language and facial expressions. This study examines the impact of technology on face-to-face communication by quantifying individuals' use of cell phones and other digital devices. The research employed field observations and a questionnaire survey to gather data. Findings indicate that while technology facilitates various forms of communication, it also contributes to a decline in face-to-face interactions. More than 63% of respondents prefer online communication over in-person conversations, highlighting a significant shift towards digital interaction. This paper discusses both the positive and negative effects of technology on communication, emphasizing the need for a balanced approach to maintain meaningful interpersonal connections.

articleTitle: Gesture Control System Using Computer Vision Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The purpose of the introduction of the gesture control technology was to close the gap between the physical and virtual worlds. Under the direction of mathematical algorithms, human interaction can converse with the digital world. Proposals and implementations of numerous algorithms and techniques have been made in an attempt to realize the objective of gesture recognition and digital world communication. Accelerometers and other devices can be used to track movements. This research work focuses on building and implementing a desktop computer using a webcam, a laptop running Windows 10, and the PyCharm program. In order to comprehend human expressions and facial expressions in response to commands, this project demonstrates technological advancements in computer vision, machine learning, and sensor technologies. This allows to easily power a variety of electronic devices, including game consoles, smart homes, smartphones and cars. With the use of gesture control systems, users can communicate with smart homes through freely interacting or easily understood motions, doing away with the need for more conventional physical controllers like remotes or Smartphone apps. This enables the user to wave hand in front of the computer or laptop to control specific functions. The main motive is to reduce the cost and increasing reliability by reducing the hardware usage. To be responsive and smooth, the system uses a mix of hardware and software, including IoT devices, machine learning algorithms, and in-depth cameras.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Automated Public Lighting System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The proposed energy efficient automated public lighting system combines the utilization of an array of sensors, control mechanisms, and Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity to develop an intelligent and energy-efficient outdoor lighting solution. The proposed system incorporates a solar panel, NodeMCU controller for Internet of Things (IoT) functionality, LDR sensor, LCD display, LEDs, L298N IC for motor control, and an ultrasonic sensor. This study has three primary research objectives: Energy conservation through dynamic LED light dimming, Automatic ON/OFF functionality based on ambient light levels and an intelligent dip system that optimize the solar panel's tilt angle to optimize solar energy absorption. Further, the ultrasonic sensor is used for enabling object detection, which then allows the system to adjust brightness levels based on the human presence or vehicle detection.

articleTitle: Implementing TACH-O-MATIC for Real-Time Bicycle Speed and Distance Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A portable tool to measure the revolutions per minute (RPM) of rotating objects is being proposed by the Digital Tachometer initiative, with a specific focus on bicycle tires. RPM is calculated by using an Arduino board with a Hall sensor to detect disruptions brought on by a magnet fastened to the spinning tire. This system, which is installed on the tire of the bicycle, has an LED display that shows real-time RPM data. It also has a speed-sensing alarm that sounds to notify users when the RPM rises above a preset threshold. The project could be improved by adding data logging for performance tracking, investigating alternate power sources, implementing wireless connectivity for data transmission to a smartphone app, and enhancing the user interface. By improving cycling conditions and promoting environmentally friendly transportation options, the project's overall goal is to increase the use of bicycles.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Event Driven Brain Teaser Using Node.js
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Node.js has emerged as a powerful platform for building scalable and efficient backend applications. This research study provides a comprehensive overview of Node.js development, encompassing its core concepts, asynchronous programming paradigms, and essential tools. This study analyzes the fundamentals of Node.js, including event-driven architecture, asynchronous operations, and package management using npm. Database integration is explored through popular ORMs like Mongoose and Sequelize for MongoDB and MySQL, respectively and also highlights the significance of authentication and authorization using Passport.js and JWT. To ensure application quality, effective testing and debugging strategies using frameworks such as Mocha, Chai, and Jest are also reviewed. By combining these elements, developers can create robust and high-performance Node.js applications.

articleTitle: Road Object Detection Using Yolov8
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The presence of objects on the road is a critical concern, particularly in the context of road traffic safety and the development of modern intelligent transportation systems. Accurate detection of these objects is essential for traffic management, self-driving vehicles, security cameras, surveillance systems, and road management, among other applications. This research study presents an in-depth study on road object detection using the YOLOv8 deep learning architecture. Proposed methodology leverages YOLOv8's single-pass processing for fast and accurate detection of moving and non-moving objects on roads. Experimental results demonstrated YOLOv8's superior performance with an accuracy of 0.96, precision of 0.96, recall of 0.97, and mAP of 0.92, outperforming previous YOLO versions and other models like SSD and RCNN. The low GIoU loss of 0.44 indicates better bounding box predictions. This research restates the importance of deep learning and computer vision for road object detection and proposes future directions including model optimization, dataset expansion, real-world testing, system integration, and continuous learning to enhance YOLOv8's robustness and applicability in dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Enhanced Traffic Sign Recognition System Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A Safe navigation requires that the vehicle will be able to detect the road edges and obstacles while respecting the road signs. Sometimes It is a critical domain with a significant impact on driverless vehicle navigation by interpreting both permanent and temporary road signs. This field, which includes Traffic Sign Detection and Classification makes up a comprehensive recognition system critical for autonomous transportation. This research work focuses on the exploration and refinement of Traffic Sign Recognition, particularly concerning its deployment on portable devices. While prioritizing real-time responsiveness, the model's accuracy in detecting traffic signs is updated. The model developed in this study performs exceptionally well, with an accuracy of 92.5%. The experimental results validate the efficacy of the network in successfully classifying traffic signs. This research study presents a streamlined and high-performing Traffic Sign Recognition model for portable devices with exceptional accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score and validation through rigorous experimentation, thereby proving its suitability for real-world deployment in unmanned driving scenarios.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Lung Cancer Detection: Exploring CT Scan Image Analysis with Multiple Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study introduces an innovative deep learning framework tailored for the classification of chest CT scan images, with a focus on aiding the diagnosis of respiratory ailments, including tuberculosis, lung cancer, leveraging cutting-edge convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The methodology encompasses rigorous data preprocessing, augmentation, and model fine-tuning to optimize performance during the training process. A suite of strategic callbacks is employed to facilitate convergence and mitigate overfitting. Empirical findings highlight the model's accuracy in distinguishing among diverse respiratory conditions, showcasing its potential as a valuable tool for early disease detection in clinical settings. This research contributes to the burgeoning field of medical image analysis, promising enhanced patient care through informed medical decisions using algorithms such as VGG 16, ResNet-50, Inception-V3, MobileNet-v2. The study underscores the importance of algorithmic selection in medical imaging analysis and paves the way for future advancements in this critical domain.

articleTitle: Solar Powered Mechanized Drip Irrigation System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Two innovative technologies, automated dripping irrigation systems and solar tracking systems, are pivotal in promoting efficient resource utilization and sustainable development The efficient utilization of water resources is crucial in agricultural practices, particularly in regions facing water scarcity. Drip irrigation systems have emerged as a sustainable solution to optimize water usage in agriculture. However, conventional drip irrigation systems often suffer from inefficiencies due to static positioning of the irrigation components, leading to uneven water distribution and wastage. This is an innovative approach to address these challenges by integrating a solar tracking system with automated drip irrigation technology. The system proposed adjusts the position of solar panels dynamically to optimize energy capture throughout the day. This ensures a consistent power supply to the drip irrigation system. Moreover, sensors and actuators are integrated into the irrigation components for real-time monitoring and control of water distribution, which is based on soil moisture levels. By merging solar tracking technology with automated drip irrigation, the system aims to improve water efficiency, decrease energy dependency, and optimize crop yields.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of C Compilers: Evaluating Operator Precedence and Associativity in Compilers
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Operator precedence and associativity are fundamental concepts in the C programming language that govern the order of evaluation of expressions. Understanding these principles is essential for writing correct and efficient C code. The paper also discusses potential pitfalls and best practices for leveraging these concepts effectively. This research paper aims to compare three popular C++ compilers, namely Turbo compiler, Dev C Compiler, and online compilers (programiz, onlineGDB), with respect to their handling of operator precedence and associativity in C. Through a series of experiments and analyses, we will examine how these compilers interpret complex expressions and their impact on code execution. This study will provide insights into potential differences and implications of using different compilers, thus aiding developers in making informed decisions when choosing a C++ compiler for their projects.

articleTitle: Vehicle Accident Detection and Reporting System using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The rising number of vehicles on the road has led to a concerning increase in accidents, as reported by the Indian Government's Ministry of Road Transport and Highways. In many cases, prompt medical assistance can save lives. While numerous solutions exist to address this issue, most are limited to two-wheelers. In contrast, this research study presents a vehicle-independent solution that employs sensors to detect accidents in any vehicle type, making it highly effective and cost-efficient. The proposed model automatically identifies and report accidents in real-time, enhancing the road safety. It utilizes advanced sensors and communication technology to promptly notify emergency services and relevant authorities for timely response and assistance.

articleTitle: Optimization Techniques for Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces in 6G
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The new age digital services and applications, deeper penetration of smartphones, billions of devices getting associated to internet has increased the hunger for high-speed data. This demand will keep exploding, rise exponentially as the days progresses ahead. In order to satisfy the soaring data traffic demands, communication has evolved all the way from 1G to 5G i.e. from first generation to fifth generation. After a span of few years, there will be a migration to sixth generation (6G). Several innovative techniques are expected to be part of 6G, though the specifications are not yet laid out. In this paper, several research areas of 6G are discussed like artificial intelligence, Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS), Quantum communication, channel estimation. Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces have a very prominent role to play in 6G. A survey of most recent works found in literature is done and the challenges involved in deploying RIS, future research outlook in RIS has been discussed.

articleTitle: Rational Quadratic Gaussian Process Regression Approaches for Identification of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient in Biotin Tablets Using Hyperspectral Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Hyperspectral imaging is a technique that offers detailed chemical or compositional information that is generally not accessible through standard imaging methods like intensity or color imaging based on light reflection, transmission, or emission. Machine-learning techniques are often used to interpret hyperspectral imaging data. On the other hand., determining the amount of active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) present in biotin tablets by sample destructive techniques such as high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC). An effective, computer-aided model is necessary to accurately determine the API content of biotin tablets. The study used a non-invasive method called hyperspectral imaging to examine the unique properties of the biotin capsules. The Rational Quadratic Gaussian Process Regression (RQ-GPR) analysed the spectral parameters obtained from the hyperspectral image. The major performance metrics derived by RQ-GPR are being contrasted with those generated from advanced regression techniques. The results demonstrated that RQ-GPR exhibited a superior performance with a R2 value of 0.99., root mean squared error (RMSE) of 1.5184., mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.1636 and mean squared error (MSE) of 2.3056. in predicting the API content from the hyperspectral imaging data of biotin tablet. The findings indicate that hyperspectral imaging is a rapid., non-invasive., and precise method for estimating the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) content of pharmaceutical medications.

articleTitle: Smart Refrigeration System with Proactive Inventory Management
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The proposed system leverages the power of the internet-of-things (loT) and sensor fusion technology to monitor the conditions and status of stored food items, empowering users to make learned decisions and minimize waste. The proposed solution integrates advanced sensors, including gas sensors, weight sensors, and RFID readers, to collect comprehensive data on food inventory levels, expiry dates, and potential spoilage risks. A microcontroller processes this data, analyzing the information and triggering alerts and notifications through a user-friendly SMS interface. Additionally, the system incorporates a ChatGPT API integration, providing personalized recipe suggestions considering the available ingredients, reducing the reliance on additional purchases, and promoting creative meal planning. The project aims to reduce household food waste considerably, lowering the impact on environment and promoting sustainable practices. The SMS-based user interface offers convenience and accessibility, enabling users to receive inventory updates, expiry alerts, spoilage warnings, and recipe suggestions directly on their mobile devices.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Performance of Novel Logistic Regression over Linear Regression Algorithms for Predicting Fake Job with Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study tries to detect fake job advertisements online using Novel Logistic Regression and compares its accuracy with linear regression. Data collection and model training are essential steps. This study includes two groups and employs Novel Logistic Regression and linear regression machine learning methods. Each set comprises 10 samples, totalling 20 samples. An 80% G power value is used for SPSS computations. The factors under consideration are confidence interval (CI) and significance level (alpha). Linear regression and innovative logistic regression models were used to analyse susceptible persons on the internet. Novel logistic regression achieves a higher accuracy rate of 97.92 % compared to the 94.88% accuracy rate of linear regression. A measurement that is accurate, with a mean value and a standard deviation of ±1 at the very least. A statistically significant result was obtained from the t-test due to the fact that the t-value was lower than the significance level of 0.05 (0.002). The analysis and comparison of fraudsters in employment scam is identified and the proposed Novel Logistic Regression outperforms linear regression. The proposed Novel Logistic Regression algorithm obtained an accuracy of 97.92%.

articleTitle: Exploring LLM and Neural Networks Towards Malicious Prompt Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Atthe forefront of the Artificial Intelligence Revolution is the Generative AI domain which is making splashes in generation of new content from existing Large Language Models. Large Language Models (LLMs) are flexible, effective tools with many uses. On the other hand, they can be tricked by devious provocation. This work explores the detection of fraudulent prompts intended to produce false or damaging outputs using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. During this study we analysed the LTSM model against a neural network model. We found a 91.69% accuracy for the LTSM model and a 92.52% accuracy for the simple neural network. However, the simple neural network had a higher F1 score of 0.73 compared to the LTSM score of 0.69. We found that the standard neural model is more efficient at identifying harmful user prompts. Our research highlights the need for taking into account various architectures of models to reduce the risk of malicious prompting in language learning models.

articleTitle: Classroom Safety Warning Platform Based on Video Abnormal Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study presents a classroom safety alert platform that utilizes video-based abnormal behavior detection. The system employs a novel continuous video understanding scheme and a dual-channel hierarchical relational modeling recognition network (DCHR_MRN). The methodology addresses limitations of traditional sliding window techniques by using a dual-queue approach to improve real-time performance and accuracy in continuous action recognition. The DCHR_MRN network utilizes a multi-task learning framework for feature extraction, instance/joint feature decoupling, and dual-channel hierarchical relationship modeling, culminating in accurate posture decoding. A bagging-based ensemble learning algorithm is used for action classification, which improves the model's generalization and prediction accuracy. The system was tested on a dataset of 5,000 classroom videos, divided into training and test sets. The results show a high accuracy rate of 99.34% in detecting abnormal actions, significantly outperforming existing models. This research demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed platform in enhancing classroom safety through advanced video action recognition techniques

articleTitle: Anomaly Network Traffic Detection of Wireless Network System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Network traffic anomaly detection is a current topic in network security. Based on unsupervised learning, this paper constructs a Model for Detecting Irregularities in Network Data to solve the problems of high dimensions of abnormal traffic. Among the prevalent threats to network security, anomalies stand out as a significant menace, capable of causing system mal-functions and impeding proper network functionality. Detecting these anomalies is imperative for ensuring the uninterrupted operation of networks. While DL and ML algorithms have showcased their potential in detecting network anomalies, their efficacy remains relatively uncertain. This research study performs a detailed analysis of the algorithms (Isolation Forest and Local Outlier Factor) using the datasets to assess the ability to identify the network anomalies. This study proposes a thorough analysis of various applications of deep learning and machine learning, with the goal of enhancing network security.

articleTitle: An Alternative Migration Methodology for Preserving Obsolete CNC Program Control Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The evolution of Industrial age from Industry 3.0 to Industry 4.0 has marked the replacement of Punched tapes equipped Numeric controllers with program control units (PCU) integrated Computerised Numeric Controllers (CNC). In the every walk of industrial operations, CNC machines are used for carrying out various types of machining operations such as facing, milling, cutting, trimming, robotic arm movements and so on. Owing to the fast pace evolving semiconductor and computer technology, the CNC program control units, are also subjected to constant up gradations, owing to non availability of maintenance support globally. This renders additional economic burden on the industrial operations and management. Thereby, this study presents an effective method to overcome the aforementioned limitation for CNC controllers operation and management. Siemens make, Sinumerik controller of 840D Power line family has been studied in this research study. Concept of Distributed Numeric Control, Server Client architecture, Industrial Ethernet, RS 232, RS 485 protocols are the major outlines of the proposed methodology. The obsolete PCU 20 and PCU 50 controllers are implemented and results are validated during the dry run operations of CNC machine responsible for solid stage launch vehicle rocket preparation.

articleTitle: Low Power MAC Using Modified Booth Encoder
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research presents a novel, low-power, high-performance multiplier architecture that integrates a Modified Booth Encoder (MBE) with a Spurious Power Suppression Technique (SPST). Multipliers are critical components in digital systems, and optimizing their power efficiency and speed is essential. The MBE reduces partial product generation, improving speed and power consumption. To further enhance power efficiency, we introduce an SPST to eliminate unnecessary power dissipation caused by spurious transitions. The proposed design incorporates modules for MBE, SPST, partial product generation, and accumulation. Experimental results demonstrate the significant power reduction achieved through the combined use of MBE and SPST, making the proposed architecture suitable for power-constrained digital signal processing applications.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Model-Based Neural Network Framework for Diabetic Foot Ulcer Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Diabetic Foot Ulcer (DFU) is a severe complication of diabetes, frequently resulting in amputation and having a significant impact on patients' quality of life. Early and accurate DFU classification is essential for prompt and efficient therapy. This study introduces an innovative neural network framework that utilizes deep learning techniques to categorize DFU based on thermograms. The proposed framework employs the pre-trained EfficientNet-B0 deep learning model, well-known for its exceptional performance in image classification tasks. The framework underwent training and assessment using a dataset sourced from Kaggle, consisting of 1866 colored images. Among them, 890 images depict plantar thermograms with negative DFU, whereas 976 images depict foot thermograms with positive DFU. The proposed framework demonstrated a higher accuracy of 98.71, outperforming previous approaches by a wide margin. The findings demonstrate the ability of deep learning to categorize DFU, paving the way for the development of automated testing techniques to assist healthcare practitioners in the timely identification and treatment of this incapacitating ailment.

articleTitle: AgriInnoConnect Pro: An IoT-Based Agricultural Automation System with Firebase Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: AgrilnnoConnect Pro is an advanced agricultural automation system designed to enhance irrigation efficiency and overall farm management through IoT technology. Using MIT App Inventor, Telegram, Arduino IDE, and Firebase Console, it provides a user-friendly interface for farmers. Key hardware includes soil moisture sensors, DHT11 sensors, a 12V motor, a solenoid valve, a step down transformer, Smart Fencing, and AC switches. The system operates in automatic and manual modes. In automatic mode, the ESP32 micro controller monitors soil moisture and autonomously controls irrigation to optimize water usage. In manual mode, users can control the irrigation motor via a mobile app. Telegram bots enable remote operation of the solenoid valve and electric fencing, enhancing farm security. Additionally, the system upgrades conventional devices to smart ones using AC switches, broadening automation capabilities. AgriInnoConnect Pro aims to improve farm productivity and resource management, addressing the critical need for sustainable water conservation and providing a comprehensive solution for modern farm management. The integration of smart technologies in AgriInnoConnect Pro ensures precision farming practices, promoting efficient resource allocation and sustainable agricultural development.

articleTitle: Enhancing Advertising Efficiency: A Framework Utilizing Image Saliency Detection Algorithm for Intelligent Propagation Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study presents an innovative framework for intelligent ad delivery optimization based on image saliency detection algorithms to improve the efficiency of ad delivery. We begin with a comprehensive review of saliency detection methods, enhancing in the introduction of a novel approach that combines deep learning and sparse coding for accurate saliency detection. The resulting framework seamlessly integrates eye-tracking data and sentiment analysis to optimize ad placement and content personalization, ultimately increasing user engagement and satisfaction. Real-world deployment results highlight significant improvements in user engagement and click-through rates. In particular, the experiments yielded compelling metrics, including a maximum F-measure of 0.8192, a minimum Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.3687, and an Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.8934, confirming the framework's effectiveness in improving ad delivery performance.

articleTitle: DC-DC Converter Based DC Motor Controlling for the Charging of Electric Vehicle Using ANFIS
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This article describes how to use an adaptive neuro-fuzzy interface system (ANFIS) to charge an electric vehicle's system with the use of a DC motor and DC-DC converter. One of the topics covered in the article is the charging of electric vehicles. The two main issues with the charging system are an inadequate level of charge and an incorrect voltage profile. The DC-DC converter in the suggested system is located between a DC voltage source and a DC motor. It is switched on and controlled using both vector control and ANFIS. When comparing ANFIS to vector control under no load and full load conditions, it is found that ANFIS results in lower voltage variation and better SOC.

articleTitle: Cyber Security Management through User Testing of E-Commerece Website - A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Software testing is crucial for ensuring software quality, including security. This research presents a case study examining manual and open-source tool-based security testing of an e-commerce website. By applying various testing techniques, the study aims to identify potential vulnerabilities and assess security measures at different development stages. The findings will contribute to developing effective security testing strategies for web applications.

articleTitle: Pothole Detection and Enhanced Road Safety Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The “Pothole Alert and Detection” system integrates with live Google Maps, offering real-time pothole detection. When a pothole is detected, it sends email reports for prompt maintenance, enhancing road safety and infrastructure management. The proposed system utilizes technology to proactively address road hazards, ensuring smoother and safer travel experiences. The deterioration of road infrastructure, particularly the occurrence of potholes, poses a significant challenge for urban transportation systems. Potholes not only disrupt the smooth flow of traffic but also contribute to safety hazards and increased maintenance costs. In this study, we use machine learning techniques to present a novel method for pothole identification and categorization inside road networks.

articleTitle: Elephant Detection and Bee Frequency Deterrence System Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Human-elephant conflicts have become a growing concern worldwide, leading to significant economic losses, property damage and even loss of human life. Traditional methods of elephant deterrence, such as physical barriers and manual monitoring, have proven to be ineffective and resource-intensive. The present study proposes the design and implementation of an “Elephant Detection and Bee Frequency Deterrence System” that utilizes Artificial Intelligence models running on a Raspberry Pi to detect the presence of elephants in real time and trigger the playback of a deterrent sound. The system aims to provide a practical and scalable solution to the problem of human-elephant conflicts, with the potential to be deployed in various regions affected by this issue. Through the integration of artificial intelligence based elephant detection and advanced audio generation techniques, the proposed system demonstrates a comprehensive approach to mitigating the impact of human-elephant interactions, contributing to the preservation of elephant populations and the well-being of the shared ecosystem.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Image Processing System for Monitoring Patients in Intensive Care Units in Hospitals
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Intensive care centers are the units where patients who need exclusive care for their recovery are located, whose lives depend on medical equipment, which provides oxygen to keep patients alive, because they cannot breathe for themselves. Their own means. For the care of these patients, there are special places, special nurses and special equipment, which ensure the continuity of life of the patients who are hospitalized. This research work presents a low-cost system for monitoring these intensive care centers, through the use of cameras and an embedded computing system that has the power to analyze up to 6 cameras for each unit, as well as a graphic processor. In order to analyze the videos, and to be able to provide help to the nurses who are caring, the intention is that the patient is monitored, when he makes a movement he can activate an alarm, so the nurse can come to his care.

articleTitle: Coin Detection by an Improved Convolutional Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The coin detection in vending machines is a crucial task for ensuring accurate and efficient transactions. In this work, an improved Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) approach for coin detection is introduced. The CNN model has been trained with the images of various types and sizes to recognize and classify these coins accurately. CNN architecture leverages its ability to extract relevant features from coin images, enabling it to detect coins regardless of orientation and lighting conditions. A promising result has been attained in terms of coin detection accuracy and speed, making this approach for real-time applications in vending machines. This research contributes to improving the reliability and efficiency of vending machine transactions, reducing errors, and enhancing user experiences. The CNN-based coin detection approach holds significant potential for various vending machine applications, from beverage dispensers to ticket kiosks, and can be adapted to accommodate different coin denominations and currencies.

articleTitle: Unmasking Deep Fakes: Detecting Low-Quality Forgeries through Unseen Artifacts
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The spread of deepfakee-technology is a danger to the veracity of multimedia material, since it may be used to manipulate people's identities or spread false information. Low-quality forgeries continue to be difficult to detect because of their subtle artifacts, which elude traditional detection approaches. This is true even while deep fake detection algorithms have made significant progress in identifying high-quality forgeries. This research work presents a unique method for identifying hidden elements in low-quality forgeries, which may be used to uncover deep fakes. The proposed approach, which makes use of sophisticated machine learning algorithms and computer vision techniques, is centred on locating and taking advantage of distinctive artifacts that are introduced throughout the deep fake production process. This study provides a thorough analysis of these artefacts and show how well they can distinguish between real multimedia material and poor-quality deep fakes. The proposed technique is effective in properly detecting low-quality forgeries of photos, videos, and audio recordings. These findings are based on experiments conducted on a variety of datasets. Additionally, the proposed method's resilience is assessed against the cutting-edge deep fake creation techniques and emphasize its practical benefits in preventing the distribution of false information.

articleTitle: Stock Market Prediction using ARIMA and Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The current stock market scenario is highly volatile and prone to sudden changes. The market is in such a state due to factors such as the pandemic, conflicts between nations, and the ongoing recession. Many indices worldwide are down from their all-time highs, yet the market also exhibits signs of potential growth, albeit prolonged. In such a situation, traders and investors must carefully consider their goals and the risks they are willing to take. This is where stock market prediction techniques could prove to be the determining factor in making suitable investments. These techniques provide recommendations based on market predictions derived from machine learning and text classification models. An interactive dashboard can provide insights for short-term trends and news classification based on market-related news, along with features like delivering live news, heatmaps, and fundamental analysis.

articleTitle: ShareRoute: Mobile Application for PickUp & DropOff Services
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Addressing the growing challenges of urban transportation, this research proposes a ride-sharing application to optimize resource utilization and reduce traffic congestion. By connecting passengers and drivers seeking similar routes, the platform aims to increase vehicle occupancy and reduce carbon emissions. Key features include GPS-powered matching, real-time driver location tracking, and secure OTP-based authentication. A user-friendly interface and fair cost-sharing mechanisms enhance the overall user experience. This approach offers a sustainable and efficient alternative to single-occupancy vehicles, contributing to improved urban mobility and environmental sustainability.

articleTitle: Predictive Maintenance of a Metro's Air Compressor
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A Metro air compressor turns power into potential energy by compressing and storing air in a tank. When the pressure reaches its limit, the compressor shuts down, storing the compressed air until it is needed for various uses. Early prediction enables proactive decision-making, which helps to avoid unfavourable outcomes before they occur. It also optimizes resource allocation to ensure efficiency and effectiveness across several processes. The proposed method is a machine learning-based strategy for predictive maintenance of a metro train's air compressor. The MetroPT -3 dataset was used, which includes parameters for pressure, temperature, motor current, air intake valves, and so on. Seven analogue and eight digital signals. The technique entails data preprocessing, anomaly identification using an exclusion forest classifier, training multiple machine learning models, and integrating the chosen model with the rest of the system. Gradient-boosting models outperformed linear models in terms of accuracy, but they were slower to compute. They conclude that predictive maintenance benefits metro compressors and has the potential to revolutionize equipment maintenance in general.

articleTitle: Optimizing Receiving Transformer Capacity Assessment Decision-Making Through Strategy and Implementation of Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Optimization of receiving transformer capacity assessment is critical for ensuring reliable power supply while minimizing outage losses and managing investment costs. In this study, we present a novel approach to optimize the receiving transformer capacity assessment decision making by implementing an ant colony algorithm. Through rigorous experimentation and data analysis, this study demonstrates the effectiveness of our proposed methodology. The adaptive ant colony algorithm, integrated into the decision framework, efficiently navigates through the decision space and provides optimal solutions for transformer capacity selection. In addition, we conduct a comprehensive analysis of the factors influencing transformer capacity selection, including location requirements, overload capacity, and ability to withstand accidental overloads. The experimental results show that higher average annual load growth rates correlate with higher total investment costs for distribution transformers, accompanied by a lower risk of high power outage losses. Conversely, lower average annual load growth rates result in lower total investment costs, but carry a higher risk of significant power outage losses. This study contributes to the advancement of decision-making strategies in power systems and provides valuable insights for optimizing decisions regarding the evaluation of distribution transformer capacity in dynamic energy landscapes.

articleTitle: Predicting Wheat Yield Using Sequential and Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Estimating yield and monitoring agricultural practices are crucial for ensuring local and global food security. Almost every region or country is somehow facing loss of yield due to change in climate and other conditions, it is essential to recognize the yearly variability in agricultural production and its link to meteorological conditions. If it is possible to forecast the accurate yield on time, it will surely help in the food maintenance as well as in the development of the country in the field of agriculture. Numerous factors are responsible for the crop of growth like quality of soil, temperature affect, pesticides used, rainfall measures and how the implantation works and manages on the agricultural land. In this study, we are using metrological parameters for prediction of yield with its accuracy. The effectiveness of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNN) and Sequential Neural Networks (SNN) for predicting wheat yield is investigated in this research. We use a strong dataset that includes yield records from the past, climate information, and multi-temporal satellite imagery. While DCNNs collect spatial characteristics from satellite imagery, sequential models-such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks-capture temporal connections in climatic patterns. The Sequential model yields an R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> value of -0.11, while the Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) achieves a significantly improved R2 value of 0.216. The observed loss is 0.0260, with a mean absolute error also at 0.0260. The DCNN demonstrates an accuracy of 90.00% and an R2 value of 0.216, indicating its superior performance compared to the Sequential model.

articleTitle: Elevated Learning based Secured Phishing Website Identification Methodology using Artificial Intelligence Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Phishing attacks pose a huge threat for online security and therefore need advanced detecting techniques in order to mitigate the damages it causes. This paper introduces a sophisticated model for the detection of phishing websites, named the Blended ResNet-EfficientNet Model (BREM), which unifies the advantages of the ResNet and EfficientNet architectures. To address this challenge, BREM uses the rich hierarchical pattern recognition ability of ResNet-50 and the practical feature extraction capability of EfficientNet-B3 to achieve classification performance in phishing detection. On overall assessment BREM outperforms both traditional machine learning models and standalone deep learning model with an accuracy of 96%, precision at 94%, recall of 95% and FI score of 94.5%. These same authors validate the high specificity (97 %), negative predictive value (95 %) and Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.92 further underlining the robustness and reliability of BREM. This approach does not only improve the accuracy of detection, but also provides much better security against phishing campaigns. In the near future research directions such as real-time deployment, more experiments on different feature sets, adversarial robustness, transfer learning from heterogeneous datasets, model learning models and pattern recognition. They are able to draw from an immense amount of data and address minor deviances, which allows AI's better discrimination of real versus false websites, therefore increasing user cyber protections and preventable breaches [3] [4]. At the heart of securing phishing websites identification is making use of powerful AI capabilities to scan and recognize phishing convincingly. This AI utilizes different methods - natural language processing (NLP), image recognition and behavioral analysis - to keep an eye on things happening to web content and its design. Behavior analysis tracks user-interactions and web behavior to detect for abnormal operations, which could be considered potential phishing [5] [6]. The layered infrastructure of this approach makes it nearly impossible for a phishing attack to slip through unnoticed. Nterpretability and scalability would significantly extend BREM towards a more effective model for dynamic and large-scale environments.

articleTitle: MANET: A Secured and Logical Routing Protocol Development Over Mobile AdHoc Networks for Intelligent Data Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Mobile Ad hoc Networks (MANETs) present unique challenges and opportunities due to their decentralized and dynamic nature. This research study explores key security mechanisms and communication protocols essential for the effective functioning of MANETs. The Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) is highlighted for its robust encryption capabilities, ensuring data confidentiality through a symmetric key approach that balances strong security with efficient real-time application performance. Authentication protocols, specifically digital signatures and Hash-based Message Authentication Codes (HMAC), are crucial for verifying communication integrity and authenticity, preventing unauthorized access and identity spoofing. Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDPS) are examined for their role in maintaining network security by detecting anomalies and known attack patterns in real-time, achieving a detection accuracy of 96.4%. These systems enable proactive threat mitigation, enhancing the network's resilience. Additionally, the paper discusses the importance of selecting appropriate routing strategies-proactive, reactive, or hybrid-to optimize network performance and resource utilization, adapting to MANETs' dynamic conditions.

articleTitle: A Novel Machine Learning Strategy for Anomaly Identification Scheme in Wireless Sensor Networks Using Supervised Training Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Anomaly detection in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN s) is critical for maintaining the integrity and reliability of various monitoring systems, especially in agricultural settings. The core of this study is the development of a hybrid anomaly detection model, SVM-RFNet, which integrates Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forests (RF), and Neural Networks (NN). By applying noise reduction techniques, such as smoothing algorithms, the data quality is significantly enhanced, resulting in cleaner and more stable datasets. Feature engineering, including temporal trend analysis and Principal Component Analysis (PCA), further refines the dataset by extracting and selecting the most informative features. This model combines the strengths of each method, leveraging SVM's robustness in high-dimensional data, RF's ensemble learning capabilities, and NN's ability to learn complex patterns. The SVM-RFNet model achieved an impressive accuracy of 96%, demonstrating its efficacy in real-time anomaly detection. The paper concludes with a discussion on future research directions, including the integration of advanced deep learning techniques and the development of self-healing networks, which promise to further enhance the capabilities and applications of WSN s in various domains.

articleTitle: A Logical Appliance of Deep Learning Methodology for an Intelligent Parking System for Smart Cities Using Internet of Things Association
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this work, a novel Intelligent Parking System (IPS) for Smart Cities to improve large-scale urban parking management using Internet of Things (IoT) and Deep Learning techniques is proposed. The system is based on several sensors, cameras, and RFID readers that come together to provide an accurate real-time measurement of the occupation of parking spaces. Using the ImageNet database and utilizing a three-layered deep neural network with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for image processing, and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) for predictive analytics, it delivers an accuracy rate of 95%, consuming only 300 milliseconds to the completion. The data is sent to a single cloud server using NodeMCU modules that update and back up the data regularly. A mobile application serves as the interface to the system for users who can check available spaces from anywhere, book space and pay for parking. The integration advanced AI methods not only optimizes the use of parking space and minimizes traffic congestion, but also helps to building smart urban environments sustainably. Future possibilities such as deeper integration with controlled vehicles, greater interoperability with other smart city components as well as dynamic pricing and customized user experiences have the capability to take urban mobility to the next level.

articleTitle: Advancing Patient Care for Autonomous Saline Level Alert System with Cloud-Based Isolation Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This work presents a novel method for improving patient care by creating a self-sufficient system to detect saline levels using an Isolation Forest Algorithm (IFA) hosted on the cloud. Standard practices for checking saline levels in IV infusion systems often include human intervention, which might cause important discrepancies to go undetected for longer periods of time. It presents a system that uses machine learning to identify aberrant saline levels in real-time, improving patient safety and relieving healthcare providers of some of their workload. The IFA, a powerful anomaly detection tool that works particularly well with high-dimensional data like that produced by intravenous infusion devices, is at the heart of our strategy. It gains scalability, flexibility, and real-time processing capabilities crucial for early alerting in clinical settings by implementing our algorithm on the cloud. Extensive testing and validation with both synthetic and real-world datasets prove that our suggested approach reliably and effectively detects abnormal saline levels with few false alarms. By providing healthcare practitioners with prompt alerts of possible infusion anomalies and allowing proactive action to avert adverse events, the autonomous saline level alarm system has major implications for patient care. The technology provides smooth interaction with current healthcare infrastructure by moving computing duties to the cloud, which eliminates the need for extra hardware and maintenance burdens.

articleTitle: An IoT based Voice Assisted Smart Residential Appliance Control Mechanism using Intelligent Node MCU Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The idea of a gadget operated by a remote or switch is today considered antiquated. This is the technology of the future. The article presents a novel approach of managing smart appliances with voice commands, which is referred to as Voice Assisted Smart Appliance Control (VASAP). In order to assess the efficacy and performance of the suggested system, it is compared against the traditional GPRS Assisted Smart Appliance Control (GPRSSAC). An Android app requires the user to speak commands. Voice instructions may be recognized and transmitted to the system using this program. These commands are decoded by a receiver and decoder, which then send them over a serial connection to the Arduino controllers. The system's software and hardware are developed in accordance with this plan, and the system's wireless communication technique, which integrates Wi-Fi and RF (radio frequency), is also established. The systems functional needs inform the design of two sets of control schemes-one for voice control and one for button control-with the goal of making the system more compassionate. For the voice control solution to work, the user must first read out from the smart terminal the control instructions that have been pre-programmed into the system's voice library. Once the recognition is confirmed, the user will be able to command their household appliances. Under the key control scheme, smart terminal keys are used to operate household appliances. In order to collect and store audio, verify family members, and recognize voice commands, the upper computer uses an algorithm that was studied in this study. The lower computer collects environmental information in real-time and wirelessly controls home facilities. Upon startup, family members are asked to confirm their voice commands. Following this, the system uses real-time environmental information and the results of voice command recognition to formulate a control command. Through the serial port, the command to operate the associated home equipment is sent from the top computer to the lower computer. Under controlled laboratory settings, the system is examined and evaluated. In addition to authenticating family members, the test findings demonstrate that the technology can operate home amenities using voice commands and instantaneous fashion data on the environment.

articleTitle: Protecting Vulnerable Road users using IoT-CNN for Safety Measures
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The increasing number of road accidents involving Vulnerable Road Users (VRUs) highlights the urgent need for innovative safety solutions. This study proposes a novel approach that leverages IoT and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) technologies to enhance VRU safety. By deploying IoT sensors on vehicles and infrastructure, the proposed model can accurately track VRU locations and environmental conditions in real-time. A CNN-based model is developed to robustly detect and classify VRUs under various traffic scenarios, with continuous improvement through learning. The integration of IoT and CNN enables real-time communication and timely warnings, facilitating proactive interventions to prevent accidents. Experimental evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed system in improving VRU safety. This research offers a promising solution for reducing road accidents and creating safer urban environments.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Models for Understanding Audience Sentiments in Movie Tweets
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study explores the application of deep learning models for analyzing audience sentiments in movie tweets, aiming to provide a comprehensive understanding of audience reception. Leveraging Twitter data collected using Tweepy and supplemented with web-scraped content via BeautifulSoup, the study employs advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. Text preprocessing using SpaCy ensures standardized input for subsequent analysis. Sentiment analysis utilizes RoBERTa, an advanced deep learning transformer model known for its robust performance in NLP tasks. RoBERTa effectively classifies tweets into positive, negative, or neutral sentiments, leveraging its contextual understanding to interpret nuanced language expressions prevalent in social media discourse. Simultaneously, RoBERTa is employed for emotion detection, identifying emotional states such as joy, anger, sadness, and more, crucial for gauging audience emotional responses to various aspects of movies. This dual-analysis framework provides detailed insights into audience reactions, facilitating a nuanced evaluation of movie reception across diverse demographic segments. Additionally, the study explores aspect-based sentiment analysis to delve deeper into specific movie attributes like plot, acting, and special effects. Visualizations using Plotly enhance the interpretability of sentiment and emotion distributions over time, supporting informed decision-making in the entertainment industry.

articleTitle: Empirical Evaluation of Internet of Things Assisted Fire Fighting Robotic Design Based on Intelligent Sensors Association
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research work presents the design and implementation of an Internet of Things (IoT) assisted fire fighting robotic system based on intelligent sensors association. The system integrates various components including intelligent sensors for detecting fire, smoke, temperature changes, and gas emissions, Arduino microcontrollers for data processing and control logic execution, Wi-Fi communication modules for remote monitoring and data exchange, and actuators for physical motion and manipulation tasks. Through the integration and coordination of these components, the firefighting robot achieves autonomous capabilities in detecting, localizing, and responding to fire incidents effectively. The intelligent sensors, including the MQ-2 Gas Sensor, TMP36 Temperature Sensor, MQ-7 Carbon Monoxide Sensor, and MLX90614 Non-Contact Infrared Temperature Sensor, provide real-time environmental data inputs to the Arduino Uno microcontroller, which interprets sensor readings, executes decision-making algorithms, and orchestrates responses. Leveraging bidirectional Wi-Fi connectivity facilitated by the ESP8266 Wi-Fi Module, the system enables remote monitoring and data exchange, empowering operators with situational awareness for informed decision-making. Actuators such as DC Gear Motors and SG90 Micro Servo Motors translate digital commands into mechanical motion and manipulation, enabling the robot to navigate through fire-affected environments, manipulate fire fighting tools, and execute precision fire fighting maneuvers. This abstract presents a comprehensive overview of the IoT-assisted fire fighting robotic system, highlighting its autonomous capabilities, integration of components, and potential for enhancing fire fighting efficiency and safety.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Empowered Osteoporosis Prediction: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Osteoporosis is an illness of the bones. Numerous studies have been conducted on the multi-factorial condition known as osteoporosis and fracture of bone as its clinical outcome. A bone condition called osteoporosis arises when bone mass and mineral density decline or when alterations occur to the composition and integrity of bone. In this research work, diverse machine learning algorithms like Logistic Regression (LoR), Gradient Boosting Classifier (GB), Decision Tree Classifier (DT), Naive Bayes (NB), K Neighbors Classifier(KNN), Ada Boost Classifier(AB), Random Forest Classifier(RF), Support Vector Machine Classification(SVC), Voting Classifier(VC) and Stacking Classifier(SC) have been used to predict osteoporosis. Various metrics have been employed such as Accuracy, MCC, F1- Score, FNR., NPV, Sensitivity, Specificity, Precision and FDR. The performance of the Gradient Boosting Algorithm was found to be the best with a testing accuracy of 0.9284 and it can be used to predict Osteoporosis with reliability.

articleTitle: An Efficient and Cost Effective Systematic Ventilator Design Using Internet of Things with Smart Sensors Association
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study outlines the fundamental components and functionalities crucial for the design and implementation of a cost-effective ventilator system, emphasizing the pivotal role each element plays in ensuring efficient ventilation while maintaining overall cost-effectiveness. The ventilation unit, serving as the core component, is comprised of essential sub-components such as the motor, fan, valves, and tubing, which collectively facilitate the delivery of controlled airflow to the patient's airways. The controller, functioning as the system's central nervous system, orchestrates the operation of various components based on inputs from sensors and user-defined settings. Meanwhile, smart sensors, including airflow, pressure, oxygen concentration, and patient condition sensors, provide real-time feedback to the controller, enabling dynamic adjustment of ventilation settings to optimize patient care. The integration of IoT technologies allows for remote monitoring, data collection, and analysis, extending the system's capabilities beyond clinical settings. Additionally, a user-friendly interface empowers healthcare professionals to monitor ventilation parameters, adjust settings, and respond to alarms effectively, thereby promoting patient safety. By adopting a systematic approach and leveraging advanced technologies, the proposed methodology facilitates the development of cost-effective ventilator systems that meet clinical standards and address the increasing demand for critical care equipment in healthcare settings.

articleTitle: An Exploration of Deep Learning-Based Object Detection and Classification in Yakshagana Imagery with YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The Indian theatrical genre known as yakshagana has its roots in the coastal districts of Karnataka and parts of Kerala. With a distinct style and shape, it is a colorful fusion of dance, music, conversation, clothing, makeup, and stage tactics. This research uses YOLOv3, a cutting-edge object detection framework, to recognize people and crown jewelry in order to tackle the problem of identifying Yakshagana characters. Yakshagana, a traditional Indian theatrical style, is distinguished by its distinctive and ornate headdresses and costumes, which complicates automated identification. In order to do this, three classifications were taken into consideration: “person,” “yedekattu,” and “kireeta”. A carefully annotated dataset was used to train the model, which allowed it to capture all of the fine characteristics of these classifications. With a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 93.83%, our method showed impressive accuracy. With the improvement of picture identification and classification technologies, deep learning approaches have the ability to preserve and promote cultural heritage, as demonstrated by this high accuracy.

articleTitle: Survival Analysis with Cox Proportional Hazards Model in Predicting Patient Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Survival analysis is crucial for understanding the factors that influence patient outcomes across time. The objective is to predict the outcomes of patient survival under various circumstances using the Cox Proportional Hazards Model. The main objectives are to assess the model's predictive ability and to determine the impact of different parameters on survival lengths. As a result of these efforts to enhance clinical prediction models, patient treatment strategies that are personalized to each person's individual risk profile will be improved. Integrating diverse patient data and evaluating the importance of various elements might improve insights into therapy success and prognosis accuracy. Improved healthcare delivery and individualized medical treatments are possible outcomes. This approach brings attention to the use of advanced statistical techniques in medical diagnosis and decision-making, which may improve patients' quality of life and raise their chances of survival. Age range: 58–72, stages: 1–4, comorbidities: yes (1, no), Karnofsky score: 60–90, follow-up: 12–30 months, confidence interval: 0.2% to 10.3%, hazard ratio: 0.8-3.5, p-value: 0.08-0.67, according to the Patient Survival Analysis Dataset, Stage-Specific Cancer Survival Analysis Dataset.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning Approaches for Improved Thyroid Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Thyroid disease is a broad term for any medical disorder that impairs the thyroid gland's ability to generate enough hormones. It is not limited to any particular age group; it can strike anyone at any time. Detecting thyroid diseases usually includes blood tests, which can be difficult to interpret due to the large amount of data required for accurate predictions. To find the best algorithm for predicting thyroid risk, this study examines different Transfer Learning (TL) methods. The dataset utilized for this work was sourced from the machine learning repository at the University of California, Irvine. The distribution of thyroid class labels in this dataset is highly imbalanced. To address this, sampling techniques are used to balance the dataset. Transfer learning models like AlexNet, Inception, and MobileNet are employed. All models achieve an accuracy rate of 97%. Upon comparison, AlexNet demonstrates the highest accuracy among the three models. The research shows that proper preprocessing and data balancing can improve thyroid detection efficiency.

articleTitle: Recent Gas/Odor Sensor Array Signal Processing Trend for Model Nose: A Mini Review
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The study of merging artificial intelligence and the processing of gas and odor sensors' data is known as artificial olfaction or model nose. Gas/odor sensor data is formed by sensor response modalities that produce signature patterns that represent a particular response of a gas/odor sensor. It can be difficult to analyze the particular objective by using drift-affected gas and odor sensor data and trying to gain hidden insight from the model nose. The classification and quantification of gas and odor sensor signals is significantly challenging in model nose tasks and plays a vital role in careful sensor signal processing. The application of data-driven tactics for utilizing the outcomes of the model nose for higher performance is quite challenging. The gas/odor sensor signal processing aims to provide salient features as per the application area, in addition to achieving high accuracy. The recent sensor signal processing methods for the model nose were reviewed. The dataset, response modalities employed, trade-offs associated with each technique, and classification and quantification techniques were all covered in the article. At the end, it is demonstrated that there is a significant challenge and an open research area regarding the improvement of sensor signal processing techniques, such as raising accuracy and sensitivity values and being practical in using model noses efficiently.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Security Systems in Cloud Computing using Cryptography Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Delivering computing resources over the internet has seen a paradigm shift towards cloud computing. However, there are serious security risks because cloud environments are distributed and shared. Intelligent Security Systems (ISS) that use cryptographic techniques are now necessary to overcome these issues, such as data confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity; this study developed an ISS for cloud computing, concentrating on cryptographic techniques. The RSA-OAEP (Optimal Asymmetric Encryption Padding) and X.509 algorithms are combined to create the ISS and further cover a variety of cryptographic methods, emphasizing their functions in protecting cloud-based systems, including encryption, digital signatures, and key management. It also looks at improving security systems' threat detection and response capabilities by integrating artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms like Grubbs' Test. In addition, several issues and potential paths for intelligent security systems in cloud computing are examined, highlighting the necessity of ongoing study and development to remain ahead of developing cyber threats.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Vulnerability Tools Analysis for Security and Control in IT Environment and Organizations
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study analyzes the potential of integrating OpenVAS, Wireshark, Nmap, and Metasploit for comprehensive vulnerability analysis and assessment in IT environment and various public and private organizations.
