Open VAS serves as a robust vulnerability scanning platform, while Wireshark monitors network traffic for potential threats. Nmap identifies open ports and vulnerabilities, and Metasploit facilitates ethical penetration testing. Together, these tools empower organizations to proactively pinpoint and address security weaknesses, strengthening defense against cyber threats. The paper advocates for consistent deployment within a unified vulnerability management strategy, contributing to a proactive and effective approach in safeguarding against cybersecurity challenges.

articleTitle: A Review on the Role of IoT in Smart Agriculture with Reference to Efficiency, Sustainability and Precision Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Agriculture is changing into a more sustainable and productive sector as a result of the fusion of modern technologies, especially the Internet of Things (Io'T), with traditional farming methods. This shift, dubbed “Smart Agriculture,” rethinks how farmers conduct cultivation, managing resources, and sustainability by using the power of online access, data analytics, and automation. A network of linked systems and gadgets that gather, transfer, and evaluate real-time data forms the basis of smart agriculture. With previously unheard-of precision and efficiency, farmers may now remotely track and supervise a variety of aspects of their farming activities thanks to this connectivity. The transformative influence of IoT on productivity, sustainability, or precision farming highlights the need for it in agriculture. A crucial element of smart agriculture is precision farming, which entails exact management of resources like pesticides, fertilizers, and water as well as real-time data processing. This study examines the ways in which integrated geospatial technologies, weather forecasting, and IoT -driven automation and actuation support productive and sustainable farming methods. The emphasis on aquaculture monitoring also draws attention to the wide range of uses for IoT in agriculture that go beyond conventional crop growing. The crucial part that IoT plays in meeting the growing need for food production on a worldwide scale while using scarce resources. Precision farming, management of water, and crop monitoring are made possible by Internet of Things technologies including sensors, drones, or automated machinery. These apps support environmental sustainability in agriculture, improve resource efficiency, and enable data-driven decision-making. This research work goes into more detail on the fundamental components of smart agriculture, such as sensor technologies, infrastructure connectivity, automation, data transfer, acquisition, and integration with geospatial technology.

articleTitle: Optimizing Synergy in Deep Learning for Accurate Diabetic Retinopathy Identification and Staging
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Millions of people with diabetes suffer from diabetic retinopathy (DR), the primary cause of vision loss in human beings. Early detection and precise staging are essential to manage and treat DR effectively. In recent years, deep learning (DL) approaches have demonstrated encouraging results in automating the staging and detection of DR from retinal images. Developers have designed many existing systems to detect and classify DR images based on their staging. The proposed approach, also called a novel method, increases the detection rate regarding affected regions. Various architectures such as Residual Networks (ResNets), Attention Mechanisms, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) improved the performance of the proposed approach by obtaining significant data from retinal images. Transfer learning mainly transfers the disease and standard patterns from the training to testing models. An additional advantage of the proposed approach is that it combines advanced preprocessing and feature extraction techniques. The preprocessing technique reduces the noise and filters the images without losing the pixel quality. The feature extraction helps extract the essential patterns from the input DR images that help detect the affected regions. Experimental analyses were applied using two publicly accessible datasets, such as the Kaggle DR dataset and Kaggle Fundus images, which contain various retinal pictures with different levels of DR severity. Comparing our results against state-of-the-art methods, we find considerable identification and stage accuracy increases.

articleTitle: Automated Pneumonia Classification Using DensePneumoNet in Chest CT Scans
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: “DensePneumoNct” is a specialized deep learning algorithm designed for accurate and efficient detection of pneumonia from CT chest images. Leveraging the DenseNet architecture within TensorFlow, this algorithm demonstrates superior performance across critical metrics including accuracy, recall, precision, and F1 score. The implementation utilizes the ImageNet dataset, preprocessed to ensure standardization and resizing, optimizing input uniformity for robust model training. The DenseNet model architecture features dense blocks and transition layers, fostering strong feature propagation and effective downsampling of feature maps. Hyperparameter tuning, including a learning rate of 0.001, a batch size of 64, and training over 100 epochs, enhances model convergence and performance refinement. Training enhancements such as early stopping and learning rate scheduling further stabilize model training and prevent overfitting. Evaluation on a validation set showcases “DensePneumoNet”'s capability to distinguish COVID-19 pneumonia, viral pneumonia, and healthy lung tissues with unparalleled accuracy. Comparative analysis against ResNet-50, Inception-v3, SqueezeNet, and LeNet confirms DensePneumoNet's superiority in all evaluated parameters, affirming its efficacy for critical medical imaging tasks. “DensePneumoNet” represents a significant advancement in pneumonia detection, poised to enhance diagnostic accuracy and clinical decision-making in medical settings.

articleTitle: Optimizing IoT Device Networks with Edge Computing to Address Latency and Bandwidth Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The enormous interconnected devices or the ‘Internet of Things' are one of the main concerns when it comes to dealing with the network latency and bandwidth. Regular cloud computing offerings are limited because of the relatively large latency and the high amount of bandwidth needed to send data to central points. This research study is focusing on the utilization of the edge computing for managing the challenges concerning the IoT device networks. Edge computing is a form of data processing that is done closer where the data is generated thus reducing latency issues and the bandwidth consumed in the system. The novel architecture that has been suggested entails utilization of edge devices where the processing tasks are offloaded from the cloud; descriptions of the simulations that have been run to analyze the proposed architecture as well as the result that show significant enhancement on the latency and bandwidth. The presented results reveal that edge computing can be used to improve the efficiency of the IoT network and its applicability across different domains.

articleTitle: Federated Learning for Secure and Privacy-Preserving Medical Image Analysis in Decentralized Healthcare Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The need for safe and effective ways to manage private patient information has grown in tandem with deep learning algorithms in medical image analysis. Preserving patient privacy while utilizing collective intelligence for accurate diagnostic models is difficult in decentralized healthcare systems when medical data is disseminated across many organizations and locations. This study suggests a federated learning architecture to analyze medical images in decentralized healthcare systems safely and privately. The suggested method uses federated learning concepts to enable several healthcare organizations to work together in training a deep learning model, all while keeping patient data private. Regarding data privacy and security, each institution handles things on its own. Medical image analysis can benefit from developing strong and precise deep learning models through federated learning's decentralized model training approach. The federated learning framework uses differential privacy measures, secure communication protocols, and advanced encryption techniques to guarantee privacy and security. During the training of the model, these safeguards protect sensitive medical data. The study also investigates how the privacy-preserving features of the suggested system might be improved by using federated averaging and homomorphic encryption. Various healthcare institutions' real-world medical imaging datasets are used to evaluate the federated learning system experimentally. The results show that the method can achieve centralized model performance levels while keeping data private and secure with 98.6% accuracy. Model convergence, communication overhead, and computational efficiency are other consequences of federated learning examined in the paper.

articleTitle: Product Reviews Based Sentimental Analysis by Feature Extraction and Classification Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Sentiment analysis and opinion mining are two of the most popular domains for evaluating and extracting insights from text data from various sources, like Facebook, Twitter, Amazon, and so on. It is essential for giving companies the ability to actively work on refining their company plans and thoroughly understand what customers have to say about their offerings. This research proposes novel technique in product review based sentimental analysis by online reviews data feature extraction with classification using machine learning model. here the input has been collected as online review data and processed for noise removal and normalization. Then, this data features are extracted and classified using graph recurrent component analysis with support Bayesian fuzzy neural network (GRCA-SBFNN) for detection of the user sentiment for the reviewed product. the experimental analysis has been carried out for various online product review dataset in terms of training accuracy, average precision, area under the curve (AUC), F-1 score and recall. The proposed technique Training accuracy 98%, Average precision 97%, AUC 91%,Recall 96%, F-1 SCORE 92%.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Networks for Dermatology: CNN-GAN in Multi-Class Skin Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Skin diseases are common today, and proper diagnosis is critical to treating them safely. This research paper presents a novel approach for classifying skin lesions into five categories: Melanoma, Nevus, Seborrheic Keratosis, Actinic Keratosis, and Basal Cell Carcinoma through the analysis of images that incorporate Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN). Specifically, CNNs integrated into the proposed CNN-GAN model contribute to feature extraction and classification, and GANs inoculate the approach to circumstances where labelled data is scarce. The proposed model achieved an overall accuracy of 89%, significantly outperforming baseline models, followed by the traditional CNN with (83 %) accuracy, then SVM with (78 %) accuracy, and subsequently by Random Forest with (80%). Precision, recall, and F1 scores for each class demonstrate the model's robustness. In terms of using DPM with different thresholds, the results for each of the skin lesions were: Melanoma (Precision: 88%, Recall: 85%, F1-score: 86. 5%), Nevus (Precision: 90%, Recall: 92%, F1-score: 91 %), Seborrheic Keratosis (Precision: 87%, Recall: 89%, F1-score: 88%), ROC curve analysis supports the conclusion that the proposed CNN-GAN model is better in terms of discriminative capacities, with AUC values statistically significantly higher than those of the baseline model for all classes. These results enthuse the use of GANs for data augmentation coupled with CNNs for classification, which improves accuracy and stability. Using a combination of labelled and unlabeled data should have a wide array of practical applications in other medical imaging domains, where access to large annotated datasets is limited. The CNN-GAN model is promising for dermatological practice since it provides an opportunity for genuine, automated, and relatively efficient differentiation of skin lesions, leading to better treatment outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhancing SVM Classification of Meningitis with Feature-Adaptive Adagrad in CSF Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Meningitis, a condition characterized by a serious inflammation of the meninges, necessitates timely diagnosis to get the best possible results for the patient. An examination of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) continues to be an essential method for detecting meningitis. The study examines the capacity of Support Vector Machines (SVM) enhanced with the Adagrad algorithm to enhance the precision of meningitis classification by using CSF data. This study investigates the effectiveness of Adagrad in improving the performance of Support Vector Machines (SVM) for predicting meningitis. Two Support Vector Machine (SVM) models were created in this study to examine the effects of optimization strategies. The objective of this comparison was to assess if the use of Adagrad might enhance the precision of the Support Vector Machine (SVM) in a research study. Both models are trained using a dataset that includes labeled CSF analysis findings, which are classed based on whether meningitis is present or absent. The assessment of the testing dataset and training dataset was conducted using measures such as accuracy, sensitivity (the ability to properly detect meningitis), and specificity (the ability to accurately identify non-meningitis). Though Support Vector Machine (SVMs) is a well-established tool for performing classification tasks like meningitis prediction, this research explores how the Adagrad algorithm can optimize SVM performance. By dynamically adjusting learning rates, Adagrad can potentially help the SVM converge faster to a better solution, leading to more accurate meningitis diagnosis from CSF analysis. The effectiveness of this approach depends on the quality and relevance of the features extracted from the CSF analysis. Choosing informative features is crucial for both SVM and Adagrad to perform well. The influence of Adagrad optimization on the model's capacity to reliably identify meningitis based on CSF variables may be examined by comparing the results. Healthcare providers may use these models to adopt early and more efficient techniques for managing meningitis. In this research proposed SVM algorithm with adagrad. It easily handles complex data and identify patterns. The proposed model utilizes Support Vector Machines (SVM) with the Adagrad optimization technique to reach a high accuracy rate of 94.78% in distinguishing between instances of meningitis and non-meningitis.

articleTitle: Smart Water Leakage Alert System for Residential Buildings
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Water shortages have increased in recent years due to overpopulation, climate change, aging water facilities, and water leakage due to damaged pipes. The issue is not the volume of water leaking, but rather the time it takes to notice and fix the problem. Water delivery systems are necessary for the sustainable use and conservation of water resources. This summary provides a concise overview of systems for managing water, their importance and key components. Effective water management requires application of practices, technologies and procedures that ensure efficient collection, treatment, distribution and storage of water for various purposes. In order to eliminate water scarcity, minimize pollution, prepare for the effects of climate change, enhance the wellbeing of ecosystems and communities, water delivery systems are essential. By managing water resources effectively and implementing sustainable practices, societies can guarantee a consistent water supply for the present and upcoming generations. In the present work, prototype model is developed and it consists of a surface sensor installed in the water tank, a microprocessor to read and evaluate the data. A sensor is used to monitor and control the level of water in the tank. Using the level sensor, the system initially determines how much water is in the tank, and based on the water level, the water is pumped into the tank accordingly. The goal of the planned work is to develop a real- time prototype to detect water leaks in pipes, updating the information to ThingSpeak server and send an SMS to the customer, alerting the person to take up the preventive measure as a priority.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Predicting Customer Churn: Analyzing Sequential, Random Forest, and Decision Tree Classifier Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Predicting customer churn is vital for businesses aiming to retain their customer base and enhance profitability. This study investigates the effectiveness of three prominent machine learning algorithms Sequential, Random Forest, and Decision Tree Classifier in forecasting customer churn. Utilizing a dataset encompassing historical customer information such as demographics, transaction records, and interaction patterns, we preprocess the data by addressing missing values, encoding categorical variables, and scaling numerical features. Subsequently, each model is trained on the processed dataset, and their performance is assessed using accuracy as the evaluation metric. Our findings demonstrate promising predictive capabilities, with the Sequential model achieving an accuracy score of 94%, followed by Random Forest with 92%, and Decision Tree Classifier with 91%. Additionally, we conduct a comparative analysis of these models, focusing on interpretability, computational complexity, and robustness. While the Sequential model excels in predictive accuracy by capturing temporal dependencies in sequential data, Random Forest and Decision Tree Classifiers offer simplicity and interpretability, catering to scenarios where model transparency is paramount.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Classification Methods for Prediction of Lung Cancer Images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Cancer, a disease with a devastating impact on lives, is often brought about by a confluence of hereditary disorders and other aberrant changes. Cancer is a sickness were body cells multiply too quickly. The brain and lymph nodes are among the organs where lung cancer may spread after starting in the lungs. Lung cancer changes depending on a number of medical factors and geographical places. The study presents a comparative study for lung cancer detection by CT (Computed Tomography) images, encompassing data collection from LIDC-IDRI (Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative). Through data collection, preprocessing, and splitting. Deep learning (DL) models including GoogleNet, AlexNet, CNN, and FocalNet are employed for classification. In comparison to the other models that were evaluated, FocalNet exhibited exceptional performance according to F1-score, accuracy, precision, and recall. It achieved outstanding scores of 99.81 %, 99.78%, 99.36%, and 99.56%, individually. The results of this study demonstrate that FocalNet is an effective method for computer-aided identification of lung cancers. Furthermore, this study highlights the potential value of FocalNet in clinical practice for the purpose of improving lung cancer detection and management. This study offers valuable insights into a development of efficient computational frameworks for medical image analysis, particularly in oncology diagnostics.

articleTitle: Exploring Dual-Module Approaches for Sentiment Analysis in Call Recordings
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The system entails the development of a sentiment analysis system consisting of two integral modules aimed at analysing audio recordings of calls. The first module predicts sentiment-positive, negative, or neutral-by converting speech to text using speech-to-text APIs and subsequently applying machine learning algorithms including Random Forest, Naive Bayes, SVM, and Logistic Regression. The second module employs audio processing techniques utilising Librosa for feature extraction and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for emotion recognition. The system facilitates comparisons between the results obtained from both modules for call recordings. Users, starting with system administrators, can choose between two options: browsing for uploading pre-recorded audio files or live recording. In both scenarios, the system executes sentiment analysis and emotion detection, presenting results derived from speech-to-text and audio processing analyses.

articleTitle: Development of a Library for Image Processing Using Openmpi and Openmp
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Nowadays, in the different areas of knowledge, there is an increase in the amount of information needed to process, reason why many solutions have been generated for the implementation of high-performance computing, these available solutions depend on many factors, from the use of available different architectures. This research work presents a method for the configuration of a low-cost solution for the implementation of asolution based on HPC, using the OpenMP and OpenMPI libraries. The processes necessary for the implementation of programs to exploit these two libraries that are used in the application of parallel programming are described. As a result, the study presents the application of the methodology using file compression, which was implemented Huffman's algorithm, the results demonstrate the optimization in parallel work working with OpenMP and OpenMPI libraries, which allows working with all processors available in the different computer architectures that are available. The study indicates the mode of use and application of the methodology described.

articleTitle: Optimizing Style Recognition Algorithm for Digital Art Images Using Large Language Models (LLMs)
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In today's era of big data, images have usurped text as the primary content of the Internet, and style analysis of artistic images has emerged as a key area of computer vision research. This study explores the landscape of image style recognition, with a particular focus on digital art images, by harnessing the power of Large Language Models (LLMs). Traditional methods of image style classification, which rely on quantitative standards and image processing techniques, often fall short when faced with complex image content. To address this, personalized classification approaches using unsupervised learning have gained traction, offering flexibility and improved efficiency. In particular, deep learning-based methods have revolutionized fashion style analysis, enabling more accurate recognition and classification through feature extraction. This study proposes a robust style recognition algorithm that utilizes LLMs and ResNet networks to achieve superior performance in digital art image analysis. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model, which outperforms traditional approaches such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Support Vector Machines (SVMs) in terms of accuracy. This highlights the potential of advanced deep learning techniques in capturing complex image style features.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Cloud-Based Applications with Cloud Analyst
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Cloud computing changed the way data is accessed and stored, as well as providing the ways of implementing applications through internet. It aims at identifying fundamental units like IaaS, PaaS and their consequences. Nevertheless, new opportunities also draw essential risks, the main of which is associated with cloud security. To overcome these challenges, the present research focuses on the six fundamental components of cloud security and cannot tackle the issues. Cloud Sim is a framework developed for cloud computing environments and the development entails modeling and simulation of behaviors under certain conditions with respect to performance, scalability and resource utilization. Results indicate that geographic distance presents the extent by which the service quality lowers with larger distance between the user base and the data center or server. The performance metrics shows the average response time of 301.85 ms for User Base 1 located in Europe, and 50. 2 ms for User Base 2 in North America, and 200. 80ms for User Base 3 located in Australia shows that geographic location plays a vital role in ensuring that the latency is as less as possible. Furthermore, in the current study, the load balancing is done across the multiple data centers, and this is controlled by different service brokerage policies thus improving the quality of the services offered. These strategies ensure optimization of the workloads in a way that they assign virtual machines optimally in every data center. Secure also continues to be emphasized, and talks about its solutions and strategies, as well as best reference models from the world market, including NIST, ISO, and CIS

articleTitle: Explainable Machine Vision Techniques for Fish Disease Detection with Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Fish disease detection is crucial for maintaining the health and sustainability of aquaculture systems. Traditional methods of disease identification in fish often rely on manual observation, which can be inefficient and susceptible to humanly made mistakes. In recent years, machine learning techniques, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have shown promise in automating the detection process. However, the performance of CNNs can be limited by their reliance on fixed-size input images and their inability to capture long-range dependencies. In this work, five deep learning models such as the CNN, DenseNet121, ViT, VGG16 and VGG19 models are proposed to study their performance on our dataset using accuracy as the major evaluation metric. First, exploratory data analysis is carried out to understand the features and classes of our dataset, then preprocessing steps are carried out to resize them to a standard size, normalized the pixels as well as augmenting all classes to increase on variations of images for each class, to create a dataset balance for all classes. Then the dataset are splitted into training and validation sets and also extracted feature from images using VGG16 so as to capture the underlying dependencies in them. We trained all of our models on the training set then finally evaluated them to get their performance. The study implements deep transfer learning to all our models to improve the models' predictions and also solve the problem of poor generalization. Finally three different Explainable AI (XAI) techniques on each of the models and these include LIME, Grad-CAM and integrated gradient to gain an understanding on which exact features did the models base on to make predictions. Further more we investigated which XAI technique works better for each model. In our future prospects, more XAI techniques such SHAP and Layer-wise backward propagation are annalysed and also carry out our research together with engagements from domain experts to guide us on which evaluation metrics perfectly suit this sensitive study area.

articleTitle: Elliptic Curve Cryptography: Protecting Healthcare Data in the Digital Age
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This work focuses on increasing the security of user data in hospital management systems through encryption. The primary goal is to protect patient information and staff records by implementing advanced encryption and access control techniques. Using robust cryptographic algorithms and best practices, this work ensures that sensitive data can only be accessed and decrypted by authorized individuals. The implementation aims to mitigate the risks of data breaches, unauthorized access and data integrity issues and ultimately strengthen data protection and patient privacy in healthcare facilities. This work aims to address key challenges in health information security, including the risk of data breach, unauthorized access and data integrity. By implementing robust encryption measures, the hospital management system will provide patients, medical staff and administrators with a higher level of data protection and privacy. Overall, this research study aims to improve data security, maintain patient confidentiality and ensure compliance with privacy regulations, ultimately increasing the trust and efficiency of healthcare institutions in managing the user data.

articleTitle: Application of BERT Model for Unsupervised Text Classification using Hierarchical Clustering for Automatic Classification of Thesis Manuscript
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Many current studies on natural language processing (NLP) depend on supervised learning, which needs a lot of labeled data. This is not practical for large classification tasks. This research presents an unsupervised approach to automatically classify unlabeled theses using a BERT-hierarchical model. This technique combines BERT, an open-source machine-learning tool for NLP, with divisive hierarchical clustering utilizing the K-means clustering algorithm. Standard metrics evaluated the model's performance. Fine-tuning the BERT-hierarchical model with a learning rate of 0.00001 gave the best results, achieving 93% accuracy, 91% precision, and 93% recall. Additionally, a web application was created to facilitate model testing, offering functions for data creation, editing, and deletion. This study shows the BERT-hierarchical model's effectiveness in classifying unlabeled data, providing a scalable solution for large NLP tasks.

articleTitle: Enhanced Heart Disease Diagnosis in MRI Images Using Swan Adapt Optimized Thresholding Segmentation with U-Net Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The diagnosis of heart disease in MRI images is a critical application within the area of medical imaging. Conventional segmentation algorithms have difficulty in the accurate delineation of normal and sick heart tissues due to problems such as noise sensitivity, inaccuracy in boundaries, and sensitivity to parameters. In this work, we propose a novel strategy of thresholding based on image clusters, which we term SwanAdaptOpti thresholding for the segmentation of MRI images. The proposed system also utilizes Watershed segmentation with markers refined to enhance the segmentation of diseased heart tissues. Indeed, our approach is capable of achieving satisfactory performance in delineating normal and sick heart images, avoiding issues like overfitting, underfitting, and local optima. The overall robustness of our approach is demonstrated by extensive experimentation, which reveals the potential of our approach for the accurate and reliable diagnosis of heart disease from MRI images with an accuracy of 96%.

articleTitle: Mitigating Photon Number Splitting Attacks in Quantum Key Distribution: A Comprehensive Analysis of Security Vulnerabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the last ten years, quantum computing has made substantial progress, presenting a strong challenge to traditional encryption methods that depend on solving discrete algorithmic problems. With the advent of the quantum era, conventional encryption methods are becoming more susceptible to attacks. This paper investigates possible attacks that exploit vulnerabilities in quantum cryptography, specifically investigating weaknesses in quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. The text thoroughly explores advanced attack strategies of photon number splitting highlight the existing vulnerabilities. The goal is to highlight the need for strong safeguards to protect against these threats, which requires continuous research and development to improve the robustness of quantum cryptography algorithms. The experimental investigation includes analyzing crucial parameters, including quantum channel length, loss, QKD protocol, quantum bit error rate (QBER), signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), as well as attack parameters such as probability of photon number splitting (PNS), eavesdropper distance, and detection efficiency. The evaluation includes performance indicators such as secure key rate, quantum bit error rate (QBER) vs distance, vulnerability to photon number splitting (PNS) attacks, and the influence on the pace of key generation.

articleTitle: Efficient Auto Scaling of Pods in Kubernetes: Accelerating Continuous Delivery with KEPTN
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Model deployment in machine learning has become recognised as an emerging field of research in recent years. It can be viewed as a method similar to conventional software development. Organisations can move more quickly and smoothly when development and operations (DevOps) practises like Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) are used. Various software development approaches are available for enterprise applications. Micro-services architecture has become very popular among these accessible software development approaches. Enterprise applications, which are frequently sophisticated and require out-of-the-box scalability and low latency, integrate well with the micro-service design. For enterprise applications, microservices in a containerized cloud environment are particularly helpful. It is also extremely important from a software development standpoint in the software business to find and fix errors early on in the development process rather than once they have reached the level of the production environment. Kubernetes is a creative and well-integrated platform solution for running and controlling containerized applications gracefully and effectively. Developers can easily build and maintain clusters with the managed Kubernetes service known as AKS. It makes containerized application deployment and management possible. AKS offers serverless Kubernetes, a continuous integration and delivery experience that is integrated, as well as enterprise-level security and governance. Users of Microsoft Azure will find that AKS offers several appealing features that make it simple to set up, administer, scale, and monitor an AKS cluster.

articleTitle: Enhanced Plant Health Monitoring Using Transfer Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Advancements in and Machine Learning and Deep learning have revolutionized the classification and detection of plant diseases, crucial for maintaining health of plant and productivity. Traditional approaches relying on physical observation are often unreliable and inefficient, leading to significant agricultural losses. This study focuses on utilizing image processing techniques to enhance efficiency and accuracy of detecting crop diseases, particularly in chili, banana, and citrus crops in Karnataka. Various viral diseases severely impact chili crops, necessitating advanced diagnostic techniques like Reverse Transcriptase PCR (RT-PCR). Similarly, banana and citrus crops face significant disease challenges that threaten their yield and quality. Our research utilizes transfer learning models to classify plant leaf diseases. By capturing plant leaf images and applying a series of pre-processing techniques, such as binarization and Gaussian filtering, we ensure high accuracy in disease detection. Pre-trained models, including various versions of MobileNet are utilized to classify disease stages based on leaf image analysis. Experimental evaluations demonstrate the superior performance of our proposed system, highlighting its potential in improving disease monitoring and management practices. This integration of advanced image processing, deep learning, and automated diagnostic systems offers a promising solution to enhance crop health and productivity, thereby safeguarding the economy and food security.

articleTitle: Optimization Techniques: Role and Application in Load Frequency Control Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Electricity stability depends on the Load Frequency Control (LFC) function, which balances power generation and consumption. As energy systems become more complicated and integrate renewable energy sources, the control system struggles to finish the process. Optimization has improved LFC system performance. This review covers classical, heuristic, and current optimization methodologies. This study will cover the concepts, outcomes, problems, and current advances in Liverpool Football Club's quality of life approach that incorporates this technology. Based on a comprehensive evaluation of existing knowledge, this article advises researchers and practitioners on enhancing LFC performance and dependability.

articleTitle: Microe- A Comprehensive Dataset of Facial Micro Expressions for Building Responsible Software Systems with Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Micro expressions are facial expressions that occur for a short period of time, usually less than a second. These expressions usually go unnoticed but represent the true expression that is felt by the person because they are involuntary. There have been recent attempts to make datasets that contain micro expressions in an attempt to carry out accurate Facial Emotion Recognition. However, many of these datasets have had various limitations, ranging from low diversity of the dataset, which introduced bias into the emotion detection models, low quality images, a limited number of images that resulted into low accuracy of the model, etc. The study introduces a dataset called Microe dataset, which contains images that were collected from various sources to ensure a high diversity and more features that are going to be discussed in sections below. Experiments were also carried out to evaluate this dataset and the results that were acquired have been included in this paper.

articleTitle: Air Filtration System in Plant Building Wall
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the context of modern building design, ensuring high indoor air quality (IAQ) is crucial for occupant health and comfort. This abstract presents a detailed exploration of an innovative air filtration system that is embedded within the walls of a planned building. The system integrates advanced filtration technologies to effectively remove particulate matter(PM) and airborne pollutants from indoor air. The design of this air filtration system centres around the utilization of both HEPA (High-Efficiency Particulate Air) filters and activated carbon filters. HEPA filters are used for its ability to capture particles as small as 0.3 microns (size of particulate matter) with high efficiency, thereby significantly reducing allergens, dust, and other fine particles that can degrade IAQ. Activated carbon filters complement this by adsorbing gases, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), and odours, ensuring a comprehensive purification process. Integration into the building's walls is a strategic choice aimed at optimizing space utilization while maintaining a seamless aesthetic. By embedding the filtration system within the ventilation infrastructure of the walls, the design minimizes the visible footprint of air handling units and ducts, contributing to the architectural appeal of the space. Moreover, the system incorporates smart sensors and intelligent controls to monitor IAQ parameters in real-time. These sensors continuously assess air quality metrics such as particulate levels, VOC concentrations, humidity, and temperature. Based on these measurements, the system autonomously adjusts filtration levels to maintain optimal IAQ conditions throughout different spaces within the building. The implementation of this advanced air filtration system represents a significant advancement in building technology, offering tangible benefits such as improved occupant health, enhanced productivity, and greater overall comfort. By effectively removing airborne contaminants, the system supports a healthier indoor environment, which is increasingly recognized as essential for both residential and commercial buildings. In conclusion, the integration of an air filtration system into the walls of a building not only addresses IAQ concerns comprehensively but also demonstrates a commitment to sustainable and occupant-centric building practices. This abstract underscore the importance of innovative HV AC (Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning) solutions in modern building design, highlighting the potential for improved indoor environments through thoughtful integration of technology and architecture.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network based Real-Time Risk Management: Mitigating Business Threats with Instant Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Real-time risk management is an essential key to businesses to anticipate risks before causing significant damage and maintaining the sustainability of their operations. This study demonstrates the Cascaded CNN with Self Attention Model (CCSAM) as a new technique for real-time analytics on business risk detection and handling. This approach involves collecting a wide range of data points from a number of business activities, cleaning them with very complex preparation steps in preprocessing and feature engineering to make them suitable for the models. The CCSAM combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) at different levels for hierarchical feature extraction and the effectiveness of the self-attention mechanisms in channel-specific attention. Using a comprehensive model design and evaluation, the CCSAM far outperformed the others in correctly predicting and then managing in real-time business risks with 97% accuracy. The capability of the new model is to handle complex data structures and analyze them in dynamic business ecosystem provide an opportunity for proactive risk management at an unprecedented scale.

Author Keywords: Cascaded CNN with Self Attention Model

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Cardiac Emergency Response: Designing a Cost-Effective Automatic CPR Device with Mechanical Resuscitator for Enhanced Patient Survival
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: An increasing number of people are currently suffering from cardiovascular ailments, neurological problems, and nephrological conditions. Some individuals may experience cardiac arrest, in which case their heart stops suddenly, throughout their treatment. Under such conditions, technicians or support personnel physically deliver ventilation support with an Ambu bag and do cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR). For many individuals, however, manual CPR is futile. It is vital to guarantee that a sufficient number of paramedical personnel are accessible to administer manual CPR within a 5-to 10-minute timeframe throughout emergencies. This emphasizes how important it is to have more paramedical personnel on hand who are trained to administer CPR when needed in emergency situations. The patient needs to recover from cardiac arrest in 10 minutes or less. It requires more than just manual CPR to improve the patient's condition. Therefore, the creation of a transportable, reasonably priced CPR and breathing apparatus that aids in reversing cardiac arrest is the suggested remedy. The Patient receives chest compression and ventilation automatically via this gadget. The device should provide efficient CPR and ventilation at a pace of 100–120 beats per minute, allowing the chest to fully recoil 2 inches (5 cm), and maintaining a compression-to-ventilation ratio of 30:2, in accordance with the guidelines set forth by the American Heart Association. An automatic alignment mechanism will be used to determine the piston's location on the chest, ensuring precise chest compression for patients suffering from cardiac arrest. Furthermore, the gadget in concern needs to be lightweight and simple to move from one place to another.

articleTitle: Optimizing Smart Home Systems: Utilizing Blockchain and Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The evolution of smart home systems into the Internet of Things (IoT) era has revolutionized the traditional home, offering greater convenience and automation. However, with these benefits come significant security concerns, particularly around data privacy and centralized vulnerabilities. Current smart home models rely heavily on centralized servers, exposing them to single points of failure and potential breaches that undermine user trust and system reliability. In addition, interoperability challenges between devices and opaque data management further complicate these issues. To address these challenges, this study proposes a novel smart home architecture that integrates blockchain and edge computing technologies. Blockchain provides a decentralized approach to data management, ensuring transparency, security, and user control over personal data. By distributing data across nodes and employing advanced cryptographic techniques, blockchain enhances resilience against cyber-attacks and unauthorized access. The proposed methodology includes the design of a robust smart home gateway using advanced micro-controller units and enhanced Wi-Fi modules. This gateway orchestrates device communication and user interaction, enhancing system flexibility and scalability. Experimental evaluations confirm the effectiveness of the proposed system, demonstrating reduced storage overhead for blockchain nodes and optimized communication protocols. The results highlight the feasibility and benefits of decentralized, edge-enabled smart home solutions in improving user experience and system reliability.

articleTitle: Assessing the Impact of COVID-19 on Inflation Dynamics in India: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research work aims to study COVID-19's impact on the Indian economic system. The Consumer Price Index of India for different commodities from January 2013 to March 2023 is used for the dataset. The paper implements modern tools like Deep Learning (DL) and Machine Learning (ML) methods to analyse the impact COVID-19 had on the inflation rate in the economic state of India. This paper uses Linear regression, K-nearest neighbors, random RandomForest Regression, Gradient Boosting Regressor, and one deep learning LSTM model to analyse the Consumer Price Index dataset and the Unemployment Rate dataset from multiple open-source databases. During the study, comprehensive evaluation was done to calculate the model's performance with parameters like r2_score, Mean Square Error (MSE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and (MAE) mean absolute error to forecast the CPI, and Inflation rate using the best performing model which was found to be the RandomForest Regression with the r2_score of 0.990665. : We could see a sharp increase in both the inflation rate and consumer price index in 2020 at around 6.62% as expected and by using the best-performing model with an r2_score of 0.99 the forecasting is visualized. This paper analyses and forecasts the inflation rate and CPI of India by implementing Machine learning methods adding new information to the already existing COVID data analysis.

articleTitle: A Federated Learning Paradigm for Early Alzheimer's Detection using MRI Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a progressive neurovascular disorder that results in loss of cognitive function and memory impairment. Detection of this infection earlier can help reduce the threat of this infection to a minimum, by providing required intervention and management. In this contribution, we present a novel model of Hybrid Xception-GhostNet Classification (HXGC) in combination with federated learning for classifying the progression of Alzheimer's disease (AD) across MRI images in the Alzheimer's MRI Preprocessed Dataset (AMP Dataset). The HXGC architecture, which combines the excellent feature extraction of Xception with the lightweight GhostNet, exhibits strong and lightweight features. Collaborative model training using federated learning across multiple healthcare institutions and kept patient data privacy The HXGC model was trained locally on each center's portion of the dataset, and these locally trained models were then combined into a global model using federated averaging on the central server. The HXGC model achieved a top accuracy of 97.5% on the training set, 97.0% on the validation set, and 97.5% on the test set, which significantly exceeded other models in both accuracy rates and time cost. At a glance, the study demonstrates the potential of advanced neural network architectures and federated learning for early detection and diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: AI Based Smart Assistant System for Alzheimer Person
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Alzheimer Disease is a progressive disorder that affects memory and other significant mental actions. This gives an immense challenge to the care takers and patients and gets worsen over time. This work is proposed in a way to support Alzheimer patients in carrying out their routine activities independently and improve their quality of life. The proposed system integrates machine learning algorithms with mobile application for assisting the patients and supporting the care takers as well. The first part includes the AI algorithms such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Support Vector Classifier (SVC) and Light Gradient-Boosting Machine (LightGBM) employed in predicting their routing activities and the results are compared to elevate the best algorithm. The second part consists of support system in which the mobile application plays a role in various tasks such as location tracking, personalized reminders, scheduling the medication and anomaly detection in human behavior. The study aims to present a support system in assisting the Alzheimer's patients with routine activities and scheduling their significant actions. This paves a way for improvising the patient safety and eases the burdens of care givers.

articleTitle: Multimodal Knowledge Graph Completion Using CLIP-Enhanced Hyper-Node Relational Graph Attention Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Knowledge graph (KG) completion is a critical task in Artificial Intelligence (AI) focused on deducing absent connections between entities. The diverse nature of data, encompassing text, images, and numerical information, introduces considerable difficulties in precisely forecasting these missing links. Multi-modal KGs are necessary to fully capture the diverse and rich information associated with entities, enhancing applications in search, recommendation, and AI. This study presents a new framework for completing multi-modal knowledge graphs that integrates textual, visual, and numerical data. Pre-trained Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) embeddings are leveraged for textual and visual information and a dense layer is utilized for numerical data, creating a unified entity representation through a low-rank multi-modal fusion approach. The proposed model employs a Hyper-node Relational Graph Attention Network (HRGAT) to effectively aggregate and process multi-modal information. The research shows that this new approach performs significantly better than current models in certain metrics, such as Mean Rank (MR), particularly excelling in lowering the mean rank of head entities, showcasing the enhanced capability and accuracy of the method proposed in completing multi-modal KGs.

articleTitle: A Boosting-Based Machine Learning Approach for Intrusion Detection in Vehicle Address Verification Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) are susceptible to cyberattacks due to their reliance on vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication. This research proposes a Gradient Boosting-based intrusion detection system to safeguard AV networks. By employing advanced machine learning techniques, including Adaboost, Decision Trees, and Random Forests, the system effectively identifies various cyberattacks. Evaluated on standard datasets, the proposed IDS achieves a remarkable accuracy of 99.49%, surpassing existing models. The combination of feature selection and ensemble learning enhances the system's detection rate while maintaining computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Data Aggregation in Internet of Things (DAIT) with Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Data plays a crucial role in the field of computation. The aggregation of data facilitates the processing of data in order to obtain refined information, which can then be utilized for performing analysis and computation, leading to valuable outcomes. Numerous techniques exist for data aggregation in WSN, and currently this study investigates the aggregation of data in the domain of the Internet of Things. This investigation involves exploring various computation methods such as cloud, fog and edge computing. The combination of wireless sensor networks (WSNs) and the Internet of Things (IoT) has become increasingly popular, because it provides real-time application solutions by facilitating communication between physical objects and sensor nodes in an integrated technology environment. Data aggregation with edge computing, by decentralizing data processing and bringing it closer to data sources, offers a promising solution. This study investigates the implementation of data aggregation in WSN and IoT for any applications using Edge computing, aiming to enhance data processing efficiency and reduce latency thereby extending the operational lifespan of the network.

articleTitle: An Efficient CNN-Based System for Classifying Pepper Bell Plant Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The study presents an efficient Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based system designed to classify the health condition of pepper bell plants, specifically distinguishing between healthy leaves and those affected by bacterial spot. The proposed model leverages a robust dataset comprising 5000 images, which are evenly divided into training and testing sets. The CNN model was trained over 15 epochs using a batch size of 64 and the Adam optimizer. The Results section of the paper provides a detailed analysis of the model's performance, showcasing tables and graphs that illustrate the training and validation accuracies and losses over each epoch. Additionally, it includes an in-depth examination of the confusion matrix, offering insights into the precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy metrics. The proposed CNN model achieved a high accuracy rate of 98%, underscoring its effectiveness and reliability in differentiating between healthy and diseased leaves. This automated system represents a significant advancement for large-scale agricultural applications, reducing the dependency on manual visual inspections by experts and enabling timely intervention and disease management. By automating the disease detection process, this model supports the broader adoption of precision agriculture techniques, which are essential for optimizing crop health and productivity. The paper concludes by discussing the implications of these findings for future research and the potential for integrating AI-based solutions into agricultural practices to enhance disease management and crop yield.

articleTitle: Efficient Waste Classification in Recycling Industries
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Efficient waste management is a pressing matter in an age of rising environmental concerns. The main purpose of this research is to design a proper waste classification system capable of distinguishing biodegradable waste from non-biodegradable waste. In addition, the suggested system employs advanced technologies and natural mechanisms to accurately classify garbage thus ensuring that right disposal methods are used during recycling initiatives. It serves as a means to separate compostable objects from those that cannot be broken down naturally and require specific ways of disposal making it possible for the environment to be sustained in its status quo. Hence, its implementation could weaken the effect that garbage has on the planet offering a purer and safer environment. Furthermore, further studies need to be conducted so as to improve the system for use in large-scale scenarios and wide range of waste types. This study is another significant step towards sustainable waste disposal and greener future.

articleTitle: Employing Black Box Mechanism for Investigation and Analysis of Road Accidents
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A novel system for accident analysis is presented, focusing on the utilization of sensors to gather acceleration, gyroscope, and GPS location data for analyzing vehicle orientation during accidents. The collected data is utilized to plot a detailed 3D model using Three.js, offering insights into the dynamics of the accident. Additionally, the system provides the facility for users to show the location. Key objectives of the proposed system include monitoring and collecting vehicle parameters, conducting post-accident analysis, and providing feedback to manufacturers for enhancing vehicle design and integrity. Machine learning techniques, such as using autoencoders, are employed to find anomalies in acceleration values. Plotly is used to provide comprehensive graphs for data visualization. Initial findings demonstrate successful data collection and transmission, highlighting the system's potential for enhancing accident analysis and vehicle monitoring capabilities. Existing systems often lack comprehensive data collection, hindering detailed accident analysis. Additionally, challenges with real-time data transmission and integration with cloud platforms limit their effectiveness in providing timely insights and collaborative analysis.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Quality with GAN Super Resolution Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The present study presents a novel approach to enhance the quality of celebrity photos by utilizing an innovative framework known as Profile SR-GAN. The aim is to increase the resolution of low-quality celebrity photos, so they appear significantly better. In this work, Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) has been applied as it is highly efficient at generating images. Two key performance metrics have been used, PSNR and SSIM, to evaluate the effectiveness of our approach. In comparison to the noise in the original low-quality photographs, PSNR enables us to determine how clear the high-resolution images are. SSIM analyzes brightness, contrast, and general structure to assist us compare the original and upgraded photos. The effectiveness of GAN model has been demonstrated in enhancing the image resolution through our detailed study. This research study has gained a greater knowledge of this technique's effectiveness and its potential uses in many contexts.

articleTitle: Smart Healthcare Systems: IoT and AI for Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Fast food consumption and changes in lifestyle are associated with an increase in heart related problems. This study looks at how cloud computing, the Internet of Things and machine learning can be combined for CVD risk prediction and real-time monitoring. The IoT-ML-Cloud paradigm aims to increment the precision of Cardio Vascular Disease prediction by merging these technologies. The system comprises three main modules: Prediction, Data collection and User engagement. Utilizing Arduino and ESP32 modules. An Android application facilitates patient data input and real-time monitoring and predictions using ML models deployed on the Microsoft Azure cloud. Bluetooth technology utilised to facilitates real-time data transfer to the cloud. This paper proposes Bi-LSTM algorithm with an accuracy of 96.55% for the heart disease prediction. Along with highlighting significant discoveries from numerous ML algorithms in the diagnosis of Cardio Vascular Disease, it also highlights the significance of cloud computing and data mining for large-scale medical data analysis.

articleTitle: Design, Technology Development and Simulation Verification of Mars Sensor Exploration Balloon
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The exploration of Mars is a key endeavor in understanding the mysteries of our universe and the origins of life. Traditional probes have faced limitations in terms of endurance, coverage, and cost-effectiveness. In response, balloon-based exploration has emerged as a promising solution, offering extended flight durations and extensive detection ranges. This study presents a comprehensive study of the design, technology development, and simulation verification of a Mars sensor exploration balloon. Based on atmospheric data sources and gravity field models, the design process prioritizes factors such as observation range, stability, and payload capacity. Material selection, buoyant gas selection, and ventilation system design are carefully considered to ensure optimal performance in the harsh Martian environment. Simulation procedures cover various deployment scenarios, including land-based and space-based missions, with emphasis on aerodynamic simulation and structural reliability verification. The proposed pumpkin-shaped pressurized balloon design with reinforced tendons is found to be the most suitable for conventional Mars exploration missions. In addition, the study addresses balloon storage, folding, and deployment methods that are critical to mission success. Through rigorous testing and optimization, this research advances the development of Mars exploration balloons to improve future planetary exploration efforts.

articleTitle: Systematic Analysis of Historical Analogies and Challenges: Lung Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Cancer is a fatal condition that usually comes on by the aggregation of several diseases and inherited illnesses. Wherever in the human body, cancerous cells can develop and cause deadly growths. Cancer, referred to as a tumor, needs to be immediately and precisely identified in its earliest phases in order to decide what can be effective for its treatment. Even while each method has its own distinct problems, some of the main reasons for death include challenging histories, poor diagnosis, and subpar treatments. The goal of the study is to evaluate, classify, examine, and discuss recent developments in the detection of cancer in lung using different learning techniques. The main objective of this work is to study and compare the different modalities like machine learning using unsupervised, supervised, as well as deep learning algorithms that can help in lung cancer detection and therapy. The findings are compared using standard datasets for metrics including precision, specificity, sensitivity, and accuracy. Several novel strategies are clustered under one cluster. Last but not least, challenges are also emphasized for prospective future work.

articleTitle: Programmable Pseudorandom Pattern Generator Based on LFSR
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The testing of Integrated Circuits (ICs) is a critical process to ensure their reliability and functionality. Pseudo-random pattern generation has emerged as an effective approach to enhance IC testing, providing improved fault coverage, reduced test time, and the ability to detect hard-to-reach faults. Testing using Linear Feedback Shift Registers (LFSRs) holds paramount importance in numerous fields, encompassing digital design, communication systems, cryptography etc. The utilization of LFSRs for testing and validation purposes is driven by their efficacy in generating pseudo-random sequences that appear random but are entirely deterministic. Pseudorandom patterns can reduce test time significantly, as they can efficiently exercise the IC without the need for exhaustive test vectors. LFSRs finds extensive use in verification, acting as test pattern generators to assess circuit functionality under varying input conditions. LFSR testing finds application in Built-In Self-Test (BIST) structures. This minimizes the need for external test equipment and streamlines the testing process by detecting faults and verifying overall design performance. This aims to design and implement an n-bit programmable Pseudo Random Pattern Generator (PRPG). The circuit can generate pseudorandom patterns based on any user defined polynomials as well as structure of LFSR. The circuit can thus generate patterns for any polynomial degree n and for any structure of LFSR namely, Fibonacci, Galois, Complete or reseeding structures. The proposed circuit is designed using Verilog HDL and the implementation is carried out on Xilinx Vivado 2022.2 software. The performance parameters obtained from the synthesis resource and power utilization report of 8-bit, 16-bit and 32-bit LFSR structures are kept under comparison.

articleTitle: Translation Tool for Alternative Communicators using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Accessibility and integration are essential in today's world, but people with visual, hearing, and speech impairments often face significant communication barriers. Historically, creating accessible formats like Braille for the blind or transcribing sign language for the deaf has been time-consuming and bureaucratic. Individuals with disabilities have had to deal with long wait times and a heavy reliance on external resources to access information in their preferred formats. The proposed system offers a comprehensive solution by introducing a device that instantly converts various forms of input into accessible formats, bridging communication gaps between individuals with visual, auditory, and speech impairments. This device can convert typed text into Braille, audio, or text for those who are blind, deaf, or mute. It can also translate sign language gestures into text, Braille, or audio, enhancing communication. The most important innovation of the proposed system is its ability to handle multiple input and output formats. Users no longer need to navigate the bureaucracy of transcribing documents. They can enter text, speak into the device, or use sign language gestures to receive instant translations. This includes converting text to audio, sign language to text, sign language to Braille, and audio to Braille. This revolutionary process leads to greater freedom and access to information for individuals with visual, auditory, and speech impairments, promoting inclusivity and ensuring equal access to technology for all.

articleTitle: Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches for Healthcare Predictive Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Healthcare prediction has been essential to life-saving measures in recent years. Intelligent technologies that evaluate complex data linkages and convert them into actionable insights for prediction purposes are rapidly emerging in the healthcare industry. Artificial intelligence (AI) is the main force behind this revolutionary process, with a focus on deep learning and machine learning systems. By utilizing a variety of data sources, including clinical data and medical imaging, these technologies are essential for both detecting and forecasting illnesses. When AI -driven predictive analytics are used in healthcare, they may simulate human perception and, in certain situations, even identify illnesses that may be invisible to the human eye. This results in significant therapeutic support. One cannot overestimate the importance of predictive analytics in healthcare as it directly affects how accurately diseases are predicted. While incorrect forecasts might put patients in danger, precise and timely forecasts have the power to save lives. Thus, the creation of trustworthy and effective techniques for predictive analysis in healthcare is essential. With an emphasis on healthcare prediction, this article aims to provide an extensive overview of state-of-the-art machine learning and deep learning techniques. Furthermore, the goal is to recognize and tackle the innate difficulties linked to implementing these strategies in the healthcare industry.

articleTitle: An Automated Face Mask Detection Using Ensemble Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic and other infectious diseases are spreading quickly, which has brought attention to how essential face masks are in stopping the spread of respiratory disorders. To ensure compliance with mask-wearing rules, automatic face mask detection devices are becoming increasingly important. The application of Automated Convolutional Neural Networks (ACNN) in conjunction with Internet of Things (IoT) devices for an Automated Face Mask Detection is the main emphasis of this research. The suggested method correctly detects people wearing or not wearing face masks in real-time video and picture data by leveraging ACNN, a deep-learning architecture created for image segmentation. A wide range of labeled photos of people wearing and not wearing masks are used to train the FCNN. The model is ideal for real-world applications in public areas, healthcare facilities, and educational institutions due to its high accuracy and efficiency. Real-time monitoring and notifications are made possible by the integration of IoT devices, which improves the operation of the system. In order to collect images and videos data, IoT sensors and cameras are positioned strategically in specific regions. A central processing unit (CPU) that executes the trained FCNN model is connected to these devices. Using email, SMS, or a mobile app, the system instantly notifies the appropriate authorities or persons when it finds someone not donning a face mask.

articleTitle: Analysis of Bipolar Student Performance Prediction using a Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the present era, educational services have become affected by various pandemic situations, like COVID-19 delays due to rainfall, which lead the students' mindset to get mentally affected. Due to the rise of continuous problems in education services, some students are affected by the nature of improper educational services due to Bipolar Disease (BD.). Educational institutional data analysis using deep learning analysis has become the most supporting application for improving students' academic performance. In educational institutions, including colleges and universities, predicting students' success is one of the more crucial topics since it helps in the development of effective processes. In this work, the Authors proposed a new hybrid model, an Extended support vector machine for bipolar disorder in machine learning, to predict the academic performance of bipolar-diseased students. This hybrid model combines support vector machine (SVM) and Convolution Neural Networks(CNN).

articleTitle: Secure Authentication and Authorization of IoT Devices in Smart Home Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Continuous growth and implementation of the popular Internet of Things (loT) in smart home systems devices have innovated and automated its usage, significantly integrating it. The development of the internet has produced both pros and cons. Indeed, this has led to security challenges that need solutions. Here, the author considers how IoT devices, digital certificates,API keys, and authorization technologies can safeguard smart home network technologies' authentication and user access processes. The proposed study relies on evidence-based techniques that involve data collection, pre-processing, feature extraction, model development, and evaluation of performance outputs to address research problems such as class imbalances and feature extraction. This study contributes to the security trend in smart home technologies by analyzing the appropriate use of digital certificates, API keys, and access controls. The delivery of smart home technologies, security enhancements, and trust in those systems will become possible.

articleTitle: Banking Fraud Detection Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: As technology grows rapidly, new innovations have emerged in our generation. Unfortunately, the rate of fraudulent activities has also increased, and as a result great deal of innocent individuals are in misery. Prior to the internet revolutionizing the world, banks employed traditional methods, including manual reviews, data analytics, transaction monitoring in reporting suspicious activities. However, as technology advances, bank fraud cases continue to rise. Banks must use caution when looking for banking system fraud. This project aims to adapt to these technological changes, detect abnormal behaviors in the dataset, and improve the overall performance of the trained model to protect against evolving malpractices. Combining Machine learning algorithms such as logistic regression and random forest results in improve the performance of these systems which gives significant result in detecting the fraudulent activities. Implementing these technologies will improve overall security, speed up response time, and improve accuracy by recognizing suspicious activity. In conclusion, using AI technologies, specifically machine learning helps banks stay one step ahead of fraudsters, by recognizing the need of early detection of malpractice, the study can prevent such tragedies from happening in the future.

articleTitle: Role of Artificial Intelligence in Promoting Sustainable Development Goals with a Focus on Inclusive Education
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) revolutionizes education, particularly in promoting inclusive learning and achieving Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). By personalizing learning experiences, automating administrative tasks, and providing data-driven insights, AI can enhance educational outcomes for students from diverse backgrounds. This technology addresses the global teacher shortage, facilitates access to education in remote areas, and supports policymakers in identifying and addressing educational disparities. While AI offers immense potential, responsible implementation, including ethical considerations and data privacy, is essential to maximize its benefits and mitigate risks. .

articleTitle: Advancing Multiple Sclerosis Diagnosis: A CNN Approach for Personalized Therapy
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex autoimmune disease-causing damage to nerve coverings and disrupting communication between the brain and the body. Timely and accurate detection of individual responses to treatment is crucial for effective personalized MS therapy. Traditional models like logistic regression and decision trees offer some predictive accuracy, yet the variability in symptoms and treatment responses poses challenges.
