This research study suggests an innovative MS diagnosis approach, integrating machine learning (ML) techniques, specifically ensemble learning methods (random forest, bagging, stacking), and convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The complexity of MS and diverse patient responses necessitate sophisticated techniques. Ensemble learning enhances predictive capacity by capturing intricate relationships within heterogeneous data, including magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and clinical records. CNNs, specialized in image analysis, contribute to spatial feature extraction from MRI scans, improving sensitivity to subtle MS-related changes.

articleTitle: Internet of Medical Things (IoMT): Opportunities and Security Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The IoMT is nothing but a technology phase breakthrough in the healthcare industry that uses wearables, and other low-level digital data collection devices for better patient care and operational efficiency. Through this research, we seek to bring together the opportunities and security threats related to IoMT with a special focus on machine learning algorithms as a predictive tool for health assessment. Empirical experiments were conducted to determine the performance of four machine learning techniques (Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest Neighbors, and Deep Learning Neural Network) using different set of data covering medical sensor data and patient's health records. The prediction results show that the DNN-based model had higher accuracy than other algorithms, its deep learning producing the right outcomes of 0. 88, precision of 0. 89, recall of 0. With more than eighty-seventy-five percent recall rate and F1-score of 0. 88. The comparison will enlighten the advantages and shortcomings of various algorithms in using the IoMT data to predict the health outcomes, showing the prospect of the DNN as one of the better algorithms in the space. Along with this, this study brings to the foreground the significance of focusing on strong cybersecurity measures to ensure that patients' data remains protected and IoMT ecosystems are free from flaws.

articleTitle: Optimal Divisible Load Scheduling for Load Balancing in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Cloud computing is a significant technological advancement that finds application in different research domains, facilitating on-demand access to resources. Throughout this process, the cloud encounters many challenges related to fault tolerance, availability, scalability, and overhead reduction. across these challenges, load balancing across multiple nodes emerges as a significant concern. Ensuring equitable distribution of loads across several nodes is a crucial prerequisite for enhancing resource utilization and optimizing task response time. This research introduces a unique approach to address the aforementioned challenges by proposing a DLS methodology that use a divisible load scheduling algorithm. The algorithm exhibits dynamic behavior as it operates on data stored in two distinct centers and processes multiple requests. The experimental findings demonstrate that the suggested methodology exhibits strong performance, as shown by favourable values of several performance criteria such as throughput, reaction time, migration time, and resource utilization, when compared to conventional techniques.

articleTitle: Detection of Cracks Using LeNet-5 with Mish Activation with a Comparison to the Performance of Swin Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The growing danger of cracks on roads and bridges has increased the research focus on enhancing the transportation infrastructure. The introduction of Deep Learning (DL) has made it possible to precisely locate cracks on the roadways. This study intends to design and develop a LeNet 5 model to identify the cracks present in bridges and roadways. The proposed model considers concrete crack images, the automated bridge crack detection dataset and asphalt crack data collection as a classification dataset. The proposed advanced LeNet-5 model together with the considered dataset offers better crack detection results. The proposed model considers both the accuracy and time factors while generating the outcome.

articleTitle: Analysing Depression in Social Media Data Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the present digital era, a significant volume of text data has started to emerge post-COVID with the increase in the number of people who have started using social media. The text thus generated encapsules a hidden layer of emotion with in it. This emotion hidden in the textual data conveys a lot of understanding of the people who are responsible for the creation of the text and helps to know the person better. However, extracting the emotions from the text data is quiet a challenging task as it involves a series of pre-processing pipelines and also the application of machine learning techniques to the text involved in the research for the purpose of extracting the emotion from it. The primary objective of this research work focusses on extracting depression based emotional text using some of the machine learning techniques. It also gives a comparative analysis between the machine learning techniques in terms of accuracy. This work has utilized machine learning techniques such as Naïve Bayes and Random Forest to find the emotion particularly depressions in the Kaggle data set, particularly, text-based information taken into account for the analysis. Finally, this work concludes that the performance of machine learning algorithms based on its efficiency. This information can then enable appropriate counselling interventions, preventing the person under depression from escalating into suicidal thoughts or to other mental health issues.

articleTitle: Robust Design of Floor Cleaning Robot with Smart Power Handling Abilities Based on Solar Assisted Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study presents the design and implementation of a floor cleaning robot equipped with smart power handling abilities and powered by solar-assisted renewable energy sources. The robot integrates advanced technologies, including sensors, navigation systems, and cleaning mechanisms, to autonomously navigate indoor environments, detect and remove dirt and debris from floor surfaces, and optimize energy consumption. Key components of the robot include a durable chassis with omnidirectional wheels for maneuverability, a comprehensive array of sensors for obstacle detection and floor analysis, and a multifunctional cleaning mechanism comprising brushes, vacuum systems, and microfiber mops. Solar panels mounted on the robot's surface harness renewable solar energy, supplementing a rechargeable lithium-ion battery pack with a smart power management system to ensure continuous operation. Additionally, the robot features wireless connectivity for remote control and monitoring, a user-friendly interface for intuitive operation, and safety mechanisms to protect both the robot and its surroundings. Through its innovative design and sustainable energy approach, the proposed floor cleaning robot offers efficient cleaning performance while minimizing environmental impact, enhancing user convenience, and contributing to the advancement of autonomous cleaning technologies.

articleTitle: Analysis of Machine Learning Model of Gynaecological Cancer Diagnosis Using Multilayer Perceptron Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Women's health is affected with ovarian cancer, a fatal gynaecological cancer. It has become more essential to comprehend the biological and neoplastic development of ovarian cancer so as to treat patients. The fifth most common form of cancer among women globally is cancer of the ovary, which must only be identified in its most advanced stages since it has no warning symptoms. The incidence of this disease rises due to age. The epithelial type of ovarian cancer is one of several classifications of ovarian cancer. The most common cancerous ovarian tumor can be brought on by it. Women of any age may be affected by this medical condition, however women over the age of 50 are more likely to develop it. The early identification of ovarian cancer can be done using a variety of classification strategies. The categorization of cancer diseases requires using data mining as a major proportion. By reviewing numerous data mining methods, several ways were suggested for developing a classification model in an explosive field like medical, having the goal of obtaining a model with the highest classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Blockchain Approaches for Healthcare: A Review and Outlook
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Nowadays, the application of information technology worldwide is accelerating the digital transformation of the healthcare sector. Incorporating blockchain technology into healthcare provides better and more innovative solutions for healthcare providers to enhance the patient's care. By establishing a shared ledger that is cooperatively maintained and impenetrable to tampering, blockchain (BC) technology offers a novel approach to record historical data and ensure the reliability and security of data stored in distributed networks. Nevertheless, new issues relating to privacy and security arise with the integration of the blockchain into the healthcare industry. Hence, this research review concentrates on offering a thorough literature assessment of the chosen papers to emphasize the research subjects that are currently being investigated in blockchain-based healthcare systems and highlight their limitations and potential directions for strengthening the digital security of healthcare data. By analyzing current trends and implications, this research aims to provide a concise overview of existing approaches, and how BC is being utilized to enhance data security, interpretability, and transparency in the healthcare system. The research analyzes 25 literature papers on BC technology for the healthcare domain. Further, the evaluation based on the metrics utilized and year-wise analysis of the selected publications is carried out in this research. Finally, the research also provides an overview of blockchain-related healthcare mechanisms that provide solutions for various applications.

articleTitle: Future of Entertainment: Integrating Generative AI into Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television Using the Variational Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) is derived from the application of AI to produce works of original art including music, films, and images. Moreover, tailored Ads that are more suitable to specific viewers are produced using generative AI. But it is crucial to think about the moral complications of utilizing generative AI in streaming video. There are some issues that include data security, privacy, and the possibility of manipulating or misusing AI -generated information. So, we developed an effective Ad generation model using deep learning to tackle the existing challenges. Initially, the data is taken from the benchmark sources and given into the FAST process. Here, the Variational Autoencoder (VAE) model is used for the FAST process to generate Ads. The model offers the effectual outcome after completing the process. Then, the effectiveness of the developed model is compared with several existing models to showcase the superiority over other models accurately.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Farming: An Analysis of IoT-based Smart Agriculture Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research explores the integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technologies in agriculture, highlighting their potential to enhance efficiency, reduce resource wastage, and increase crop yield. Through a comprehensive analysis of IoT - based Smart Agriculture Monitoring Systems, the study demonstrates significant advancements in water usage, crop health monitoring, and predictive analytics. Key findings include a 30% reduction in water consumption and decreased reliance on chemical inputs, leading to improved soil health and minimized environmental impacts. The research also examines challenges such as sensor accuracy, data management, and the technological literacy required for effective system implementation. Despite these challenges, the study emphasizes the transformative potential of IoT technologies in fostering sustainable, efficient, and profitable farming practices. The paper concludes with strategic recommendations for stakeholders and suggests future research directions to further enhance the efficacy and accessibility of IoT solutions in agriculture.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Based Frameworks for Handwritten Signature Verification
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Handwritten signature verification is pivotal in biometrics, security, and finance and can be applied across legal, governmental, and commercial sectors. Recent strides in machine learning techniques have transformed this field, enhancing traditional methods. This research study provides a comprehensive overview of the existing frameworks for automatic handwritten signature verification systems. Further, comparative analysis of selected studies has been provided with particular attention paid to preprocessing strategies, feature extraction techniques, and verification models used in the creation of these systems. Various databases used in the literature are evaluated based on some parameters in order to determine the most suitable framework for a particular dataset. The paper also outlines the future directions for developing an advanced verification system that can work well irrespective of the language and style of signatures. Thus, it provides insights to the researchers, which inspire further innovation and advancements in this domain.

articleTitle: Mitigating Cyberbullying in Social Media: A Deep Contextual Learning Approach for Severity Level Classification in Textual Data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research introduces a novel approach that integrates Deep Contextual Learning (DCL), specifically the DCL-256-32 model with an embedding model to accurately classify offense levels within the textual data. The DCL-256-32 model employs a SoftMax function to assign probabilities to distinct severity classes, ranging from critical to negligible. The proposed model incorporates two endpoints: an embedding model for generating semantic representations of input text and a set of pre-trained DCL-256-32 models for predicting offense levels. By averaging these predictions and associating them with humanreadable labels, this study proposes a robust and scalable framework for real-time text analysis. The proposed model demonstrates high performance compared to existing methods, contributing to the advancement of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and classification. This research study offers a practical solution for enhancing digital safety and combating online harassment.

articleTitle: Trustworthy Deep Learning Techniques for Credit Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Since deep learning may increase prediction accuracy and improves decision-making, its application in credit risk assessment has gained a lot of attention recently. However, using deep learning models in critical domains such as finance calls for a more thorough examination of their reliability, comprehensibility, and ethics. In order to overcome the problem of limited model transparency and interpretability, this study investigates the application of deep learning and Explainable AI (XAI) methodologies for credit risk assessment. With accuracies ranging from 0.249 to 0.819, implementation and assessment of classic machine learning models was performed first, such as Logistic Regression, Quadratic Discriminant Analysis, Extra Trees Classifier, Gaussian Naive Bayes, Dummy Classifier, and Decision Tree Classifier. After that, deep learning models with accuracies ranging from 0.667 to 0.777, including LSTMs, MLPs, and Autoencoders, were investigated. In order to improve performance and resilience even more, a combination of LSTMs, MLPs, and Autoencoders was used to create a hybrid model that outperformed both conventional and lone deep learning models, achieving an accuracy of 0.78. XAI approaches, notably LIME and SHAP, were employed to promote trust and offer insights into the ensemble model's decision-making process. The usefulness of the suggested explainable ensemble approach for credit risk assessment is demonstrated by evaluation on the “Default of Credit Card Clients” dataset, which contains 30,000 data points and 23 features.

articleTitle: Character Recognition from EEG Signals - Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Electroencephalography signals (EEG) provide a window into human brain activity and cognitive states, enabling the development of brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) for communication and control. This research study presents a comprehensive overview of state-of-the-art algorithms for decoding EEG signals to recognize characters, words, emotions, and other mental states. Key techniques reviewed include deep learning models like convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), autoencoders, as well as classical machine learning methods such as support vector machines (SVMs), linear discriminant analysis (LDA), and k-nearest neighbors (KNN). The survey analyzes core algorithms, implementations, advantages, and limitations across various recognition targets spanning English letters, Chinese characters, facial emotions, personality types, and more. Important aspects covered include EEG feature extraction approaches, classification models, fusion strategies, and factors influencing performance like the number of channels, trials, and subjects. Recognition accuracies achieved by current systems range from 70-99% for characters and emotions, though most works are limited to lab settings. This study highlights trends, open challenges, and future directions to make EEG-based BCIs practical. Key challenges discussed include improving signal reliability and robustness to noise/artifacts, developing personalized subject-specific models, enhancing portability and ergonomics through wearable sensors, boosting information transfer rates, and addressing security vulnerabilities. Promising research avenues encompass sensor fusion, transfer/active learning, brain network modeling, compressed sensing, encryption, and blockchain. Despite remarkable progress, considerable interdisciplinary efforts are needed to realize robust, secure, and user-friendly BCIs that can meaningfully impact assistive technologies and environments. This review comprehensively analyzes the state-of-the-art while identifying limitations and opportunities to inspire further research on developing advanced machine learning solutions to decode EEG for enhanced human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: CancerAI: A Deep Learning Framework for Ovarian Cancer Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Ovarian cancer is the fifth most common cause of death from cancer in women. This is mainly because it is often diagnosed at a late stage, as the earliest symptoms are unclear and inconsistent. Existing diagnostic techniques, such as biomarkers, biopsies, and imaging tests, have notable drawbacks such as reliance on subjective interpretation, inconsistency across different observers, and time-consuming testing procedures. This research study introduces an innovative deep learning framework that employs a convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm to accurately predict and diagnose ovarian cancer, thereby overcoming the existing constraints. The CNN was trained using a dataset of histopathology images. The dataset was partitioned into test and training subsets to enhance the model's performance. The algorithm demonstrated an impressive accuracy rate of 96%, successfully detecting 97.12% of malignant instances and precisely categorizing 95.02% of healthy cells. This method effectively mitigates the challenges related to human expert evaluation, including elevated rates of misclassification and variability across different observers, while also reducing the time required for analysis. The results underscore the capability of this CNN-based technique to offer a more precise, effective, and dependable strategy for forecasting and detecting ovarian cancer. Subsequent investigations will prioritize the integration of new breakthroughs in deep learning to further amplify the efficacy of the suggested approach.

articleTitle: Inference of Missing Attributes in Multilevel Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Social networks exhibit a hierarchical structure where users are grouped at multiple levels based on communities, interests, or behaviors. The attributes associated with users provide additional information for various social network analysis tasks. However, the attributes may be missing for multiple reasons: incomplete data collection, or privacy concerns. Inferring missing attribute values within a hierarchical social network poses a challenge for accurate analysis and modeling. The state-of-the-art algorithm infers the attributes in a single level and less focus is given to infer the attributes at multiple levels. In this paper, the missing attributes are inferred by employing hierarchical clustering followed by CNN and Hierarchical Graph Neural Network. Our method's accuracy of attribute inference is compared with traditional machine learning models, including Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Gaussian Naive Bayes. The results demonstrate that the hierarchical clustering with the CNN approach consistently outperforms traditional machine learning models in terms of attribute inference accuracy.

articleTitle: Progressive Growing of Generative Adversarial Network for Multi-Scale Masked Fusion Network in Precise 3D Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Image segmentation is a vital computer vision technique, simplifying image representation and aiding object recognition. In medical imaging, generating 3D volumetric images involves a complex process integrating image acquisition, segmentation, and volumetric reconstruction. This work proposes a novel and comprehensive methodology, addressing challenges associated with spatial and temporal dependencies in 3D medical image synthesis. The proposed method unfolds in three stages. Firstly, a multi-label segmentation strategy is employed to meticulously delineate anatomical or pathological structures within 3D medical images, resulting in detailed 3D masks. These masks serve as foundational elements for subsequent image synthesis. Secondly, a conditional medical image generation model utilizes these masks as input conditions to produce synthetic images aligning precisely with specified labels. This ensures the portrayal of anatomical and pathological features consistent with the input segmentation. The crux of the proposed methodology lies in the third stage, involving the sequential and autoregressive generation of 3D mask sequences. This intricate process captures spatial dependencies and intricate patterns within the 3D volumetric space. Evaluation against state-of-the-art methods, including Vid2Vid, 3D-a-WGAN, and DDPM, uses metrics such as Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) and Frechet Inception Distance (FID). Results indicate the proposed method's superiority, particularly in terms of anatomical fidelity and perceptual quality. The work contributes significantly to advancing medical image synthesis, with potential applications in pathology detection, treatment planning, and quantitative analysis.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Deeply Embedded Online Multi-Product Recommendation of Commercial Banks Based on Behavior Data Trajectory
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study presents an innovative approach to online multi-product recommendation for commercial banks based on unsupervised deep learning and user behavior data trajectories. The model first captures and analyzes user behavior data trajectories, using filtering techniques and Markov modeling to understand and predict user behavior patterns. Then, the model proposes an unsupervised deep learning algorithm, DSRET, which integrates expert trust and similarity computations to provide real-time product recommendations. The proposed algorithm is evaluated using real data from ZA Bank, which demonstrates its superior performance in terms of recommendation accuracy and computational efficiency compared to existing methods. The results show that the designed approach achieves an average RMSE value of 0.768, highlighting its effectiveness in providing accurate recommendations while ensuring fast computation. This study contributes to the advancement of online recommendation systems for commercial banks and lays the foundation for future research aimed at further optimizing and extending the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Current Trends and Challenges of Cloud Computing and Emerging Technological Utilization in Technical Education
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study explores the impact of cloud computing on engineering education in India, focusing onhow it enhances educational outcomes. This study examines the potentialof strategic cloud implementation in higher education to accelerate development and competitiveness. The study analyzes the current state of technical education in India and identifies areas where cloud integration can drive positive changes. Key research questions are formulated to guide the exploration of creating intelligent cloud applications for effective technical education.

articleTitle: Efficient IoT Fire Safety and Bluetooth Enabled Notification Alert System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Bluetooth-enabled alerts are used in modern fire safety systems to improve responsiveness, as they have evolved with IoT integration. This novel method guarantees prompt detection and notifications, facilitating prompt action for enhanced safety protocols in urgent circumstances. There are several products in market for fire detection which are higher in cost and lower in features and few cannot support wireless communication. Fire accidents are unforeseen events that can result in significant damage, injury, or loss of life. There are several modules are available in market, by using them an effective product is made, which supports for fire and smoke detection. In this project several modules used like flame, smoke sensors. 5v I-channel relay used for automatic switching, (LM2596) modules are used for dc bulk transfer, 1-channel relay module is used for specified switching at particular time. Bluetooth headset and a mobile is used for automatic calling purpose when fire or gas accidents takes place. By utilizing all modules and devices, developed an automatic fire detection system coupled with an automatic calling methodology using a Bluetooth headset and a mobile. By using wireless communication technologies like Bluetooth, microwave communication, the proposed method accurately communicates with user by making a call. Developed methodology is accurate at communicating with user. After conducting several experiments on sensor modules, single channel power relay module the accuracy, speed of the methodology was determined.

articleTitle: Implementing an Effortless Shopping Experience: Smart Trolley and Billing System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The retail landscape has witnessed a significant surge in technological advancements, with the shopping trolley system playing a pivotal role in enhancing the overall customer experience. Traditional shopping methods often lead to challenges such as budget concerns, long checkout lines, and inadequate product information. According to recent statistical reports, a substantial number of customers encounter difficulties related to financial planning and time inefficiencies during their shopping journeys. As the demand for efficient solutions grow, there is an increasing need to address these issues and revolutionize the shopping experience. To tackle these challenges, this research study introduces a cutting-edge system designed to transform the conventional shopping trolley into a smart, RFID-powered device. The proposed system leverages Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID) technology to enable seamless and accurate tracking of items within the cart. Unlike traditional barcode systems, RFID tags allow for non-line-of-sight scanning at varying distances, offering a more efficient and user-friendly approach. Each product is equipped with a passive RFID tag containing a unique Electronic Product Code, providing essential information such as the product name and price.

articleTitle: A Review and Threat Analysis of Machine Learning in Relation to Fog and Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Traditional centralized cloud computing is having considerable issues due to the rapid proliferation of mobile internet and Internet of Things applications. These issues include data transfer delays, low efficiency in exploiting available spectrum, and connectivity that is inflexible based on machine type. Driven by the need to overcome these challenges, a new technology is prompting a change in the role of centralized cloud computing to edge devices within networks. Driven by the need to overcome these challenges, a revolutionary technology is prompting a change in the role of centralized cloud computing to edge devices within the networks. Edge computing systems have emerged from a variety of sources, with the goal of reducing latency, improving SE (security and efficiency), and enabling wide connectivity among devices. Given the broad growth and advancement of cloud technologies, the existing cloud computing model is insufficient to address the critical needs for providing services to applications such as smart grid, healthcare systems, and augmented reality. These specifications include low latency, mobility support, and context awareness. Fog and edge computing have developed as technologies that meet these requirements while providing great performance and dependability. Machine learning entails detecting many characteristics such as automated procedures, increased decision support, and diagnostic capabilities within operational settings. This study exposes previous research that focuses on diverse applications of machine learning, identifying potential hazards, and developing solutions for the edge paradigm as a whole. It also underlines the outstanding issues and challenges that may remain in the coming decades.

articleTitle: Advancements in Medical Imaging Based on Image Denoising, Data Augmentation, and Classification with Computational Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Nowadays, medical imaging techniques are often not directly suitable for disease classification due to various noise factors and limited image availability. Innovative approaches to image denoising, data augmentation, and classification have been made possible by the fast development of computer technologies, which have had a significant influence on medical imaging. The use of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) for image denoising and the creation of synthetic data to supplement training datasets are the primary focus of this review, which analyzes the development and incorporation of state-of-the-art computational methods. This survey also highlights the critical function of GANs in separating important anatomical features from background noise, greatly improving the accuracy of medical picture analysis. Exploring data augmentation by synthetic picture synthesis also reveals how it helps overcome dataset restrictions to train deep learning models. In addition, the developments in classification approaches, this survey highlights how Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and ensemble learning have revolutionized diagnostic capacities and detection accuracies in security applications. This survey lays out the complex effects of these technology developments on the accuracy and trustworthiness of medical imaging procedures by synthesizing all the latest research findings.

articleTitle: SentinelAI: Next-Gen Accident Detection and Emergency Notification System Integrating Autoencoders and Proximity Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: SentinelAI introduces an advanced accident detection and emergency notification system, utilizing cutting-edge technologies for superior performance. By employing autoencoder-based anomaly detection algorithms, SentinelAI precisely identifies accidents through G-force data from the ADXL377 accelerometer sensor, ensuring rapid and accurate event recognition. The system incorporates proximity analytics using the Haversine formula to calculate real-time distances to nearby hospitals and police stations, facilitating swift emergency response. This proximity assessment optimizes dispatch and minimizes response times, crucial in critical situations. SentinelAI features a robust communication framework, integrating Wi-Fi and GSM modules for efficient information transmission. Upon detecting an accident, the proposed system immediately notifies the nearest emergency services and a predefined insurance company, providing essential location and event details for prompt action. Combining autoencoder-based anomaly detection, proximity analytics, and rapid notification capabilities, SentinelAI represents a significant advancement in accident detection and emergency response systems. By leveraging next-generation technologies, SentinelAI aims to enhance road safety and save lives globally.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Image Based Rainfall with Humidity Prediction by Feature Extraction and Classification Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Climate studies require knowledge of the temperature as well as humidity profiles in atmospheric boundary layer. One benefit of ground-based infrared hyperspectral spectrometer is its ability to measure atmospheric radiances with a moderate vertical resolution and a high temporal resolution. This paper makes use of ground-based infrared hyperspectral measurements to retrieve temperature as well as humidity profiles. Existing inversion methods still have issues with high computational complexity or subpar performance, despite some advancements based on statistical learning or physical models. This research proposes a novel technique for hyperspectral image-based rainfall and air humidity prediction utilizing Deep Learning (DL) model. Input is collected as hyperspectral image, which are processed for noise removal as well as normalization. Then, the image features are extracted using Convolutional Gaussian Vector Multilayer Neural Networks (CGVMNN). This extracted feature has been classified using Transfer Graph Temporal Logistic Neural Network (TGTLNN). the classified output shows region with rainfall and air humidity. the experimental analysis has been carried out for various hyperspectral image dataset in terms of accuracy, average precision, recall, F-1 score, ROC. The proposed technique accuracy 96%, Fl Score of 95%, Average Precision of 94%, Recall of 92%, ROC of 93%.

articleTitle: An In-Depth Method for Liver Tumor Segmentation and Classification using Trans-UNet and Vision Transformer-based Residual Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Liver cancers are considered the deadliest tumors with the highest rate of growth globally. Initial liver tumors are categorized as cholangiocarcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma. A hepatocellular carcinoma is a frequent form of tumor in the liver, which basis for several deaths caused by cancer all over the world. Initial detection of cancers can minimize suffering and boost rates of survival. The implementation of automatic methods that offer accurate segmentation of hepatic cancers is crucial to encourage physicians in the identification of tumors and in preoperative preparation for medical treatment for the liver, which minimizes the risk factors associated with medical operation. The treatment and diagnosis of hepatocellular carcinoma or metastases depend on liver cancer segmentation. Still, effective and automated cancer segmentation is demanding because of vague borders and significant variation within the dimensions, forms, and positions of cancer cells in the liver. Conventional approaches to detecting cancers offer numerous errors during detection, are time-consuming, and require professionals to examine the growth of cancer. In this research work, a liver tumor segmentation and classification framework based on deep learning networks is developed to recognize and cure liver cancer at an early stage. At first, the required images segment and classify the liver tumor are gathered. Then, the segmentation process is carried out via Trans-UNet. The attained segmented images are offered to the liver tumor classification model. This classification is accomplished using the proposed Vision Transformer-based Residual Attention Network (ViT-RAN). The segmentation and classification procedures are helpful to detect the presence of tumors more precisely. The effectiveness of the generated network is verified by validating the outcomes with various deep learning approaches.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Into the Future: Hybrid CNN-RNN for Early Detection of Alzheimer's Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Alzheimer's Disease (AD), which is characterized by cognitive decline and memory loss, affects millions of people worldwide and poses a significant challenge to modern healthcare. Detecting AD at its earliest stages is paramount for initiating timely interventions and optimizing management strategies. In this innovative project, electroencephalogram (EEG) signals in CSV format are utilized as a non-invasive and accessible modality for AD detection. The methodology integrates Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), renowned for their ability to extract spatial and temporal features from multidimensional data, respectively. EEG signals undergo preprocessing and transformation into spectrogram representations, facilitating the extraction of relevant features for deep learning models. The CNN architecture excels in capturing hierarchical spatial patterns indicative of AD-related alterations in brain activity, allowing the model to discern subtle nuances within EEG signals. Moreover, the incorporation of RNNs enhances the model's capability to capture temporal dependencies inherent in EEG data, thereby augmenting sensitivity to early signs of AD. An extensive comparative study between standalone CNN and CNN-RNN hybrid models is required for performance evaluation. Using important criteria including Fl-score, recall, accuracy, and precision. Using deep learning and EEG signals to its full potential, this research project could revolutionize AD diagnosis and care. It offers a non- invasive, cost-effective approach to AD detection, addressing critical diagnostic gaps and paving the way for future advancements in neurology and health care. The ultimate goal of this multidisciplinary endeavor is to change the way AD is identified, treated, and managed in order to improve patient outcomes and quality of life.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality Based Elevated Learning Procedure Design for School Students to Improve Their Education
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study presents a comprehensive methodology for the design and implementation of an Elevated Learning Procedure aimed at enhancing the educational experience of school students through augmented reality (AR) technology. The methodology encompasses several phases, including content development, AR technology selection, prototype development, pilot testing, refinement, and implementation planning. Each phase incorporates evidence-based practices and strategies to ensure the effectiveness and usability of AR learning experiences. Content development involves the design or curation of engaging and interactive educational content aligned with curriculum standards. AR technology selection entails the evaluation and selection of suitable AR platforms based on educational objectives, budget constraints, and technical requirements. Prototype development focuses on the iterative creation and refinement of AR learning experiences based on feedback from educators and students. Pilot testing involves small-scale testing of AR learning experiences in a classroom setting to assess usability, effectiveness, and engagement. Refinement incorporates feedback from pilot testing to improve AR content and ensure cultural sensitivity and accessibility. Finally, implementation planning involves developing a comprehensive plan for integrating AR technology into school curricula and providing teacher training. This methodology offers a structured approach to leverage AR technology effectively in education, ultimately leading to improved learning outcomes for students.

articleTitle: A Smart Pill Container for Improved Medication
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Medication non-adherence is a significant problem in healthcare, leading to the gradual worsening of patient health, increased hospitalizations, and higher costs. Current patient-driven solutions rely heavily on the reliability of patient compliance and self-reporting, which are often inaccurate, leaving real-time monitoring and intervention gaps. The proposed system of a smart pill box, integrated with a Raspberry Pi 4, weight sensors, and a camera, addresses these weaknesses. The weight sensors will detect medication intake and verify dosages by sensing changes in weight, while the camera will capture images of the pills. Using a self-made dataset with over 400 images of each of 10 different tablets, the system will employ deep learning to identify the pills and verify dosages, alerting patients and caregivers to anomalies such as skipped doses. This automated adherence monitoring system reduces reliance on self-reporting and increases tracking accuracy. The expected outcomes of this research include improved medication adherence, reduced medication errors, and enhanced monitoring mechanisms, ultimately leading to better healthcare provision and outcomes for patients. Innovating health technology in this manner promises significant improvements in patient care.

articleTitle: Exploring the Potential of Machine Learning and Deep Learning in ECG Image Analysis for Cardiovascular Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research proposes a novel machine learning approach to detect cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) in electrocardiogram (ECG) images. The goal is to improve diagnostic accuracy and efficiency within the healthcare system. CVDs remain the leading cause of death globally, emphasizing the importance of early and accurate diagnosis for effective treatment. ECG signals provide valuable information for assessing cardiovascular health. The methodology utilizes advanced machine learning algorithms for classification. First, it pre-processes ECG signals to extract relevant features. The results demonstrate the machine learning model's potential as a significant diagnostic tool by showcasing its accuracy in detecting various cardiovascular illnesses from ECG images. Specifically, this research leveraged the power of machine learning to predict four major heart abnormalities: arrhythmias, myocardial infarction (heart attack), heart failure, and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. This investigation explores how different machine learning methods perform when analyzing ECG images to identify cardiovascular diseases. The primary objective is to identify the algorithm that delivers the highest accuracy in classifying ECG images for CVD detection. Decision trees are best suited for working with data organized in tables, where each entry has specific numerical values or categories. Random forests, like decision trees, are primarily designed to handle data in a tabular format with features like numbers or categories. ECG image analysis necessitates techniques adept at recognizing intricate patterns within the pixels of an image. The ultimate goal is to identify the most effective machine learning approach for accurate CVD detection using ECG images, potentially leading to improved healthcare system efficiency and patient outcomes. In the proposed system the algorithm with the highest accuracy for CVD diagnosis using ECG image analysis is the Decision Tree, achieving 59.36% accuracy.
