articleTitle: Advancing Pediatric Healthcare Using Cloud-Powered Electronic Health Records with Random Forest Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Advances in healthcare technology allow Electronic Health Records (EHR) and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to improve pediatric treatment. This research optimizes pediatric patient care using cloud-powered EHR systems and Random Forest Analysis, a powerful machine learning method. On a huge dataset of pediatric patient records kept securely in the cloud, it uses Random Forest Analysis to find hidden patterns, forecast clinical outcomes, and customize treatment regimens. This method improves diagnosis accuracy, therapy personalization, and patient outcomes, according to our results. The flexibility and processing power of cloud infrastructure allow healthcare professionals to effectively examine massive patient data for relevant insights. Flexible cloud-based EHR systems integrate with machine learning algorithms for real-time physician decision assistance. Using Random Forest Analysis, complicated data correlations may be identified, improving forecasts and therapeutic decisions. Through cloud-powered EHR systems and powerful machine learning, pediatric healthcare companies may expedite processes, eliminate diagnostic mistakes, and improve resource allocation. These findings demonstrate the potential of cloud-based technology to improve pediatric healthcare delivery, boosting patient outcomes and care quality. Such novel techniques are needed to fully leverage the advantages of cloud-powered EHR systems using Random Forest Analysis in pediatric healthcare.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Mobile Forensics Tools: Autopsy, Belkasoft X and Magnet Axiom
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this modern era, smartphones have become in-tegral to human existence, influencing almost various aspects of daily life. As smartphones and tablets have become more common, they have also become stores of critical digital data for forensic analyses. Therefore, mobile forensics is essential to the research and analysis of evidence related to criminal activity, legal issues, and cybersecurity problems. The complexity of mobile devices and the vast number of services and applications they offer raise unique difficulties for digital investigators. Successfully extracting and analyzing data from these devices requires spe-cialized tools and methodologies carefully crafted to handle the complexities of mobile operating systems and storage structures. The paper compares three popular forensic tools, i.e., Autopsy, Belkasoft X, and Magnet Axiom, to evaluate their efficiency in analyzing forensic image files. Concentrating on mobile devices operating on Android 10, iOS 13, and iOS 14 systems, the research seeks to provide valuable insights into the strengths and weaknesses of these tools.

articleTitle: Smart Home Automation with IoT Sensor Systems for Energy Conservation using Zigbee and Wifi
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study presents a comprehensive study on smart home automation systems utilizing Internet of Things (IoT) sensor technology to achieve efficient energy conservation. The proposed system integrates ZigBee and WiFi communication protocols for effective and reliable connectivity across various smart devices within a home. Through the deployment of interconnected sensors and intelligent controllers, the system allows real-time monitoring and management of household energy usage, optimizing energy consumption and reducing waste. The combination of ZigBee for low-power, long-range sensor networks and WiFi for high-speed data transmission enables seamless interaction between smart appliances, lighting, heating, and cooling systems. Proposesd approach offers a scalable, cost-effective solution for enhancing home automation with an emphasis on energy conservation and sustainability. Also discussed the implementation, challenges, and future potential of IoT-based smart home systems for improved energy efficiency.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Demand Response Mechanisms for Sustainable Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The integration of renewable energy sources into smart grids is a critical strategy for achieving sustainable energy systems. This necessitates effective management of energy resources, demand, and grid operations to fully exploit the potential of renewables while ensuring grid stability and reliability. Demand response (DR) mechanisms play a key role in optimizing energy use and grid stability within smart grids. This research explores the application of artificial intelligence (AI) for developing advanced DR mechanisms. The proposed approach leverages machine learning techniques to analyze energy consumption patterns and predict future demand. This enables the implementation of intelligent DR programs that incentivize consumers to adjust their energy usage during peak demand periods. By optimizing energy consumption in response to grid conditions, AI-powered DR mechanisms can significantly contribute to the integration of renewable energy sources and the creation of a sustainable energy future. The research investigates the design and implementation of these AI-powered DR mechanisms. In the proposed research, Machine learning algorithms are employed to analyze historical energy consumption data and predict future demand with high accuracy. This enables the development of DR programs that are tailored to anticipated grid conditions. Also, AI algorithms continuously monitor grid conditions and dynamically adjust DR incentives in real-time. This ensures that DR programs effectively address fluctuations in energy demand and supply. The research explores methods to incentivize consumer participation in DR programs. This may involve offering rebates or other benefits to consumers who adjust their energy consumption during peak demand periods. The effectiveness of the proposed AI-powered DR mechanisms will be evaluated through extensive simulations. The simulations will compare the performance of the proposed approach with existing DR methods. Key metrics such as forecast accuracy, energy utilization efficiency, and grid stability will be used to assess the effectiveness of the AI-powered DR mechanisms. The successful development and implementation of AI-powered DR mechanisms have the potential to revolutionize smart grid operations. By optimizing energy consumption and facilitating the integration of renewable energy sources, AI-powered DR can pave the way for a more sustainable and reliable energy future.

articleTitle: Transparent Machine Vision Techniques For Facial Emotion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Emotions are very important when it comes to collective understanding among people. In recent times, emotion recognition has emerged as a crucial facet within the realm of effective computing. Many physiological signals that could be used to notice emotions, getting facial expression images is one of the most natural and cheapest approaches. While humans find recognizing facial expressions for emotion detection effortless, the same task presents a unique challenge for computer algorithms devoid of empathy. Having this question in mind, we want to use machine vision based techniques for getting a better result regarding emotions detection. In this study, facial expression recognition (FER) was classified using the Vision Transformers(ViT), Convulational Neural Networks(CNN), ResNet, VGG16 and VGG19 models. The experimental outcomes show case that our models have the ability of being successfully used in practical settings having been trained on the FER + dataset consisting of 35,887 gray-scale images of the 8 classes, with each image having a resolution of 48×48 pixels. Experimental findings indicate that the Vision Transformers were most effective with an accuracy of 83. Additionally, the CNN model achieved an accuracy of 78 while the VGG19, VGG16 and ResNet achieved accuracy of 72, 71 and 63 respectively. Additionally we applied explainability techniques such as Lime, Integrated gradients and layerwise propagation on each model so as to understand what the model focuses on so as to classify an expression and Lime turned out to be the best XAI technique for our models.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cloud Security: A Hybrid AI Approach for Intrusion Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks and Stochastic Gradient Descent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the rapid expansion of cloud computing, ensuring the security of data and infrastructure has become paramount. One of the most important functions of Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) is to protect cloud environments against online attacks. This research study proposes a hybrid Artificial Intelligence (AI) strategy by combining the techniques of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for intrusion detection in cloud computing environment. The proposed methodology integrates the robust feature extraction capabilities of CNN with the optimization power of SGD for efficient model training. By utilizing a comprehensive dataset comprising network traffic patterns and attack scenarios, the hybrid model is trained to accurately classify normal and malicious activities. Through extensive experimentation and evaluation, the proposed approach demonstrates superior performance in detecting intrusions with high accuracy and low false positive rates. Furthermore, the scalability and effectiveness of the proposed method is validated in real-world cloud environments. The research findings highlight the efficacy of hybrid AI techniques in enhancing intrusion detection capabilities, thereby enhancing cloud security and mitigating potential risks in terms of data integrity and confidentiality.

articleTitle: Adaptive Cloud Load Balancing with Reinforcement Learning: Leveraging Google Cluster Data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study aims to develop an RL-based cloud load balancer leveraging Google cluster data. The primary objective is to optimize cloud resource allocation and load distribution using RL techniques. The dataset includes various metrics that are useful for decision-making in load balancing. Some metrics include CPU utilization, memory usage, resource requests, and system configurations. The proposed methodology includes systematic data collection, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and preprocessing, including handling missing values and feature engineering. This study focuses on designing and training the RL agent using state-of-the-art algorithms like Q-learning and Deep Q Networks, calibrated to the intricacies of cloud load balancing. To replicate real-world dynamics, a simulated cloud environment having servers with different configurations is created and several tasks are assigned. Whenever different tasks are encountered, all the values of metrics are calculated and cumulative reward is considered for decision making by using the RL agent. The research outcomes include enhanced efficiency in load balancing, improved resource utilization, and adaptability to changing demands. This research study aims to significantly contribute to cloud computing, setting new standards of resource management and operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Secured Reliable Routing Protocol to Predict and Prevent Byzantine Attack in MANET
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The emergence of Mobile Adhoc Networks (MANETs), in which multiple nodes join alongside one another to provide the necessary real-time services, has garnered increased attention from academics due to recent advancements in wireless communication. The wireless connectivity and decentralized architecture of MANETs, however, make constructing secure routing a challenging task. As a result, a machine learning-based Secured Reliable Routing Protocol (ML-SRRP) is suggested in this study to predict and prevent Byzantine attacks in MANET. In order to prevent unwanted packets with routing information being sent to fake destinations (in order to prevent routed loops), the nodes that serve as intermediates in a network were initially selected using an authority evaluation method at every single node. The node-specific metrics Number of Hop Count (NHC), Residual Energy Level (REL) and Link Validation were used for this. In order to effectively identify attacks and isolate hacked nodes within the network, an intrusion detection system is necessary. In this research, the Ad-hoc On Demand Distance Vector (AODV) routing MANET protocol is used to introduce the Byzantine attacks. Support Vector Machine (SVM) is used to train and test the system to identify illegally nodes in the network. The simulation results show that the proposed ML-based SRRP outperforms current methods in terms of dependability and throughput. Moreover, there is a reduction in delay, routing overhead, and packet loss ratio. R was used for testing and training with the trace file that was taken from the NS-2 simulation, which was run to carry out Byzantine attacks.

articleTitle: Decoding Seizures: A Multiclass Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Epileptic seizures are neurological disorders caused by sudden, uncontrolled electrical disturbances and activities in the brain, leading to changes in behavior, movements, or feelings, and, in some cases, loss of consciousness. Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals are utilized in the medical field to diagnose epileptic seizures. Accurate and timely detection of these seizures is crucial for the effective management and treatment of patients. The study presents a robust machine learning system to do multiclass classification of epileptic seizures using EEG data. The study uses datasets from Bonn University, which include five different sets representing various brain states of healthy and epileptic individuals. After preprocessing and normalizing the data, the features are extracted using techniques like power spectral density (PSD) and wavelet transforms. Various classification algorithms like Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, Naive Bayes, and Decision Tree were evaluated through extensive hyperparameter tuning and cross-validation. The Random Forest model emerged as the best classifier, achieving a significant accuracy of 89% in classifying the data into five classes, showing its effectiveness in distinguishing between different classes of seizures. This approach shows significant promise for enhancing the accuracy of epilepsy classification and optimizing treatment strategies.

articleTitle: Shallow-Sec: Malware Detection in Real-Time Devices using Feature Weightage and Shallow Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the domain of mobile security, particularly in APK (Android Application Package) malware detection, ensuring robust threat identification is critical for safeguarding user devices and sensitive data. This study addresses the need for a reliable Mobile Intrusion Detection System (MIDS) by harnessing advanced machine learning techniques. We advocate for employing tested models such as Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and XGBClassifier, alongside the top-performing Random Forest (RF) model, which achieved an impressive accuracy of ninety-eight-point six percent. To enhance model performance, we utilize feature selection techniques like Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) and hyperparameter optimization. The datasets chosen for training and evaluation, including real-world malicious and benign APKs, yield accuracies around ninety five percent. Furthermore, diverse APK datasets, including benchmarks and real-time streams, are used for rigorous testing. By leveraging optimized models and features, our study ensures exceptional performance in detecting various forms of APK malware, thus fortifying the reliability and efficacy of MIDS in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Predicting Employee Turnover Through Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Employee turnover presents a critical challenge for organizations, significantly impacting productivity, and financial performance. Traditional methods for predicting employee turnover uses statistical analysis and machine learning models, often fail to capture the complex and multifaceted nature of turnover predictors, resulting in suboptimal accuracy. This study explores the use of genetic algorithms (GAs) to enhance turnover prediction models by optimizing the selection of predictive variables. Furthermore, 2,035 respondents used in the study. The application of GAs to refine the predictor set from an initial 30 variables to an optimized dataset. The results showed that the FMSAX operator outperformed the other crossover operators of GA. The FMSAX operator produces a more optimized result of 73.33% or 69.24% improvements than the original GA using the AX operator achieving a 43.33 % optimization rate, and followed by CAX operator obtained an optimized number of variables by 56.66%. Key predictors identified include co-workers, family-related obligations, salary considerations, contractual factors, pursuit of further studies, workload and stress, inadequate compensation, and retirement or career transition. The model not only predicts turnover more effectively but also adapts to evolving data, making it highly suitable for the dynamic nature of employee turnover. This approach offers organizations a robust tool for understanding turnover causes, predicting future trends, and implementing proactive retention measures, thereby enhancing organizational stability and employee satisfaction.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Lung Cancer Detection Using Various Deep Learning Models: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Early detection of cancer is crucial because abnormal cells uncontrollably split and cause harm to the body. A patient's chances of survival can only be increased by early detection of a malignant tumor. Since the early symptoms of lung or pulmonary cancer may not be evident or obvious. Therefore, it is crucial to create an advanced system for the diagnosis and detection of lung cancer. It will help the medical experts for early classification and detection of nodules. Computed Tomography (CT) allows in-depth scanning of the lungs, it is used in conjunction with deep learning technology to screen for and diagnose lung cancer which helps doctors more accurately detect, classify, and to assess whether the lung cancer exists. This study focuses on two primary deep learning approaches segmentation and feature extraction for lung cancer screening and diagnosis. The empirical analysis of the assessment settings used by the current deep learning models is summarized in this research work. This study provides an extensive overview of automated lung cancer diagnosis utilizing different Deep Learning (DL) techniques.

articleTitle: Real-Time Stress Monitoring using IoT and Machine Learning for Cognitive Wellness
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Stress monitoring and management became some of the most vital requirements for maintaining overall well-being in high-stress environments. This work deals with the challenging issue of real-time stress detection using a fusion of the Internet of Things and machine learning technology implemented on a Raspberry Pi. Using the proposed model, the following physiological signals are collected using a Pulse Sensor for heart rate, a DS18B20 sensor for temperature, a DHT22 sensor for humidity, and a Grove GSR sensor for galvanic skin response (GSR). Based on the collected data, a hybrid model of Support Vector Machines and Random forests was trained, which would ultimately classify stress into different levels. A Snake game dynamics were controlled through a joystick. Using the predicted stress levels, the game difficulty is automatically adjusted, to provide real-time biofeedback for the user's cognitive wellness and stress management. This ensures that the user is calm and focused. The system effectively adapted to the gaming environment based on the stress levels of the player and it will serve as a promising tool to enhance cognitive wellness through game interaction.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Tomato Disease Detection: YOLOv5-Based Automated System for Agricultural Productivity and Food Security
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Global food security and agricultural production are seriously threatened by tomato diseases. This research suggest a deep learning-based automated detection system, the YOLOv5 algorithm, which is well-known for its effectiveness in object identification tasks, to tackle this problem. Our approach uses a dataset with a variety of photos of both healthy and diseased tomato plants to train the YOLOv5 model to correctly detect and categorize different tomato crop illnesses. The trained model demonstrates exceptional performance in detecting common tomato diseases such as early blight, late blight, and bacterial spot, achieving high accuracy and robustness. Additionally, this work showcase the practical applicability of our approach by integrating the trained model into a user-friendly interface accessible via web or mobile applications. This enables farmers and agricultural stakeholders to promptly identify diseased plants in the field, facilitating timely interventions and mitigating crop losses. Our findings underscore the potential of deep learning algorithms such as YOLOv5 in revolutionizing disease management practices in agriculture, offering a promising avenue for enhancing crop yields and food security globally.

articleTitle: Understanding the Ethical Implications of Generative AI: A Multi-Disciplinary Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The capacity of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) to develop material such as writing, graphics, and music is one of its defining characteristics. Generative AI has applications in a broad variety of fields, including but not limited to the following: art, literature, software development, education, product design, healthcare, finance, gaming, entertainment, and many more. From the viewpoint of many disciplines, this research study presents the implications of generative AI, considering the technical, educational, legal, and social aspects of the area. By combining concepts from various domains, this article aims to present a comprehensive understanding of the ethical concerns posed by generative AI. Additionally, the research will provide viable frameworks for resolving these issues.

articleTitle: Detection of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome using Convolution Neural Network based Fuzzy Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is a prevalent endocrine illness that primarily affects women in their reproductive years. It is characterized by hormonal abnormalities, which result in symptoms such as irregular menstrual periods, excessive hair growth, and infertility. Early detection is crucial for effective management and prevention of associated health risks. Our study proposes a comprehensive approach to PCOS detection, utilizing preprocessing and segmentation techniques followed by Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based classification. The preprocessing phase enhances image quality and features through flipping, rotation, zooming, and rescaling, standardizing inputs for analysis. Segmentation techniques isolate regions of interest, employing size-based filtering, contour detection, density analysis, color-based segmentation, edge detection, texture analysis, location-based segmentation, and watershed transformation to delineate structures effectively. Central to the proposed methodology is CNN-based feature extraction and classification, achieving high accuracy in differentiating PCOS-positive and PCOS-negative cases. Integrating diverse techniques enables effective preprocessing and segmentation, while CNNs automate feature extraction, enhancing model generalization. Our approach presents a promising strategy for accurate PCOS detection from medical images, assisting clinicians in early diagnosis and management, thereby improving patient outcomes and quality of care. The analysis of different models including CNN, GoogleNet, ResNet, and GNB revealed that CNN consistently outperforms the other models in terms of accuracy, recall, F1 score, and precision. The analysis reveals CNN's consistent superiority in accuracy, recall, F1 score, and precision, making it the most reliable model with an accuracy of approximately 98% and a precision of 97%.

articleTitle: Optimizing Portfolios with Neural Networks and Dynamic Programming: Tackling Regime Switching and Transaction Costs
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Portfolio optimization is a central challenge in quantitative finance, engaging a wide range of stakeholders including individuals and institutions. While multi-period financial models are more intricate than single-period models, they also incur higher computational costs. Transaction costs play a significant role in portfolio optimization. Research examines dynamic programming algorithms for multi-period portfolio optimization without transaction costs in a regime-switching market. Additionally, the integration of dynamic programming with a recurrent neural network is investigated for scenarios involving linear transaction costs. Dynamic programming serves as a foundation for the neural network, facilitating the learning of the no-trade zone. Both algorithms are tested on a stock from the NIFTY50 index, and their performance is evaluated against various allocation strategies.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's Research and Early Diagnosis Through Improved Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Alzheimer's disorder requires early detection for productive treatment. Machine Learning (ML) techniques, especially deep learning models, show promising Alzheimer's detection through brain image analysis. However, the performance of these ML systems mostly depends on image quality, making early detection challenging. This study presents an advanced approach of integrating six AI models like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), EfficientNetB0, VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet and InceptionV3, to improve image segmentation and classification. By using the unique strengths of each model, our method enhances the accuracy and efficiency of Alzheimer diagnosis, enabling earlier and more precise observation. Using a public MRI dataset with images from Alzheimer patients and health controls, conducted experiments and comparative analysis, demonstrating superior performance over existing methods. This approach has the requirement to revolutionize AD diagnosis, leading to better patient outcomes and advancements in treatment and intervention.

articleTitle: Soil Detachment Analysis Using Richards Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Soil erosion poses a significant threat to agricultural productivity. This study investigates the impact of soil detachment on crop growth and fertility. By employing an S-type experimental setup, we analyze soil bulk density and saturation levels under controlled conditions. A sensor-based controller system enhances the experimental process, reducing human error. The findings of this research contribute to a better understanding of soil erosion mechanisms and inform strategies for soil conservation and sustainable agriculture.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an IoT Based Smart Irrigation System to Enhance Agricultural Productivity Using ESP8266 Wi-Fi Enabled Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Innovative solutions in many fields, including agriculture, have been made possible by the widespread use of Internet of Things (IoT) technology. Our goal in this research was to increase crop yields by developing a smart irrigation system that would use the IoT. An ESP8266 Wi-Fi-enabled controller serves as the center of the system, collecting data and making decisions all at once. Important parts include sensors for soil moisture, air temperature and humidity, light intensity, water level, a pump to move water, and the ability to connect to a cloud service for data storage and analysis. Water level, soil moisture, temperature, humidity, and light intensity are some of the environmental characteristics that must be continuously monitored in order for the system to function. The data is sent to the main controller in real-time by the sensors using Wi-Fi. Based on predefined thresholds and algorithms, the system dynamically adjusts irrigation schedules to optimize water usage and enhance crop growth. To evaluate the system's performance, sensor readings from multiple trials were analyzed. Results indicate that the system effectively maintains optimal environmental conditions for plant growth, leading to improved agricultural productivity. The integration with a cloud platform enables remote monitoring and control, facilitating efficient water resource management and decision-making for farmers.

articleTitle: Mushroom Classification Using CNN and Gradient Boosting Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study suggests a new method to differentiate three commonly found species of mushrooms namely Button, Oyster, and Shiitake widely available in India, using CNN and GB models. With the help of the carefully selected dataset of around 9 thousand images of high resolution integrated methodology has yielded an astounding average accuracy of 93. 18%. CNN provided a very efficient features extraction for the complex visual patterns, while GB naturally dealt with additional features achieving accurate classification models. Using performance evaluation, a high precision, recall, and F1 score was achieved on all the mushroom classes meaning that the models were able to perform well in differentiating between different classes especially those which are unique from each other. Comparative analysis placed models as being more advantageous in comparison to the current techniques illustrated in Figure 3. Apart from their efficiency, these models can be easily implemented on a large scale and work in an autonomous manner, which has a vast impact on agriculture, food services, and medicine. Thus, the feature proves the effectiveness of CNNs and GB in precise classification of mushrooms for their further application in a variety of spheres. Further works could look at other, potentially larger data sets and at the integration of machine explicable AI methodologies to relate the facets of the models even more accurately and transparently. All in all, the study paves way for embracing an era that can potentially bring ‘mushroom perfect’ in classification for the varieties of mushrooms so that India can have new vistas for mushroom farming, culinary world and healthcare sector.

articleTitle: Comparing the Effectiveness of GAN-based Methods for Enhancing EuroSat Satellite Imagery Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Addressing the challenge of limited data in remote sensing, this research investigates the application of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to augment the EuroSat dataset. Four GAN variants (Info-GAN, C-GAN, CDC-GAN, and AC- GAN) were employed to expand a reduced EuroSat dataset by 50%. The augmented datasets were subsequently used to train Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for image classification. Comprehensive evaluation metrics (accuracy, recall, precision, Fl-score, AUC, IS, and FID) were employed to assess the performance of the generated images and the trained models. Results indicate that CDC-GAN exhibited the highest classification accuracy and MCC, while AC-GAN excelled in ROC-AUC, precision, and recall. This study underscores the potential of GAN s as a valuable tool for enhancing remote sensing image datasets and improving classification performance.

articleTitle: Efficient MIMO Antenna Design for 5G Deployment Using Compact Planar Monopole Antenna Elements
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research work introduces an innovative method for designing Efficient MIMO antenna for 5G deployment. Compact Microstrip Line Inspired Monopole antennas designed at 4.7GHz is used as antenna elements for designing simple two port MIMO antenna. The modest radiator size of 11.65 × 3.06 mm2 of the microstrip line monopole antenna element allows for its easy integration into small form factor devices due to its compact design. This feature highlights its adaptability and agility in meeting the strict space restrictions inherent in contemporary wireless devices by facilitating seamless deployment across a variety of communication platforms. The antenna element design feature an inverted T-shaped structure is implemented on an FR-4 substrate, occupying a total area of (8 × 9.65) + (29.125 × 13.65) mm2 which radiates at 4.8GHz with a return loss of 31.54 dB and has a peak gain of 3.46dBi that exhibits an impedance bandwidth from 4.14GHz to 5.96GHz. MIMO antenna is designed using antenna elements, which are positioned orthogonally with a spacing of 7mm (< 0.1251) between them, promising polarization diversity. The Proposed efficient MIMO antenna exhibits very promising MIMO parameters viz, ECC <0.0003, CCL <0.025 bits/s/Hz and a peak gain of 4.9dBi with a promising efficiency >98%. Ansys HFSS 3D electromagnetic simulation software is used to design and simulate the Antenna.

Author Keywords: Efficient Multi Input Multi Output antenna

articleTitle: Securing IoT-SDN Models: A Comprehensive Review of Deep Learning Approaches and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Rapid Advancements of Internet of things (IoT) devices and the integration of Software-Defined Networking (SDN) have introduced complex security challenges that demand innovative solutions. This survey paper presents a critical analysis of recent advancements in deep learning (DL) models aimed at enhancing the security of IoT-SDN environments. By reviewing a series of research literature, the primary threats faced by the network, including unauthorized data access, service disruptions, and privacy breaches are analysed. This research study highlights several DL techniques, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), and Deep Belief Networks (DBNs), which have been effectively applied to detect and mitigate such threats. This study assesses various models based on their technique, utilized datasets, evaluation metrics with numerical values, and presents a comparative analysis to describe their merits and limitations. The research findings suggest that while DL models offer significant improvements in detecting complex attack patterns compared to traditional methods, challenges related to model interpretability, resource constraints, and adaptive threat landscapes persist. This research study also discusses about future research directions by highlighting the need for scalable, efficient, and dynamic DL-based security solutions for the evolving IoT-SDN scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Constructing a Network Security Event Knowledge Network based on Multi-Source Data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the increasing severity of network security issues, it becomes crucial to construct a network security event knowledge network with comprehensive, accurate, and real-time information support. In response to the challenges in the current field of network security, this study proposes a method for constructing a network security event knowledge network based on multi-source data, aiming to provide comprehensive, accurate, and real-time information support for network security management departments. By investigating the development of knowledge networks and the characteristics of network security events, we have identified the process of constructing a multi-source data network security event knowledge network and its potential applications in the field of network security. In the construction process, we first build a knowledge network model, confirming the event-centric network security event knowledge network, defining each event as an 11-tuple, and categorizing the relationships between events into two types. Then, through LDA topic analysis, we classify 8897 pre-processed news data into 4 categories. Subsequently, we utilize the large language model YAYI-UIE for entity name recognition to obtain the elements in news events. Then, based on the SBERT model's sentence embedding and cosine similarity calculation, we complete the calculation of event similarity, determining the threshold for relationship determination as 0.9 through expert scoring. Finally, based on graph neural networks, entity relationships are fused, and the constructed knowledge network is stored in neo4j, successfully building a Chinese network security event knowledge network with 12 classes of nodes and a total of 16581 nodes and 41448 relationships. Through visual storage and analysis of the constructed knowledge network, we have demonstrated the feasibility and effectiveness of this method. This knowledge network can delve into the intrinsic connections and characteristics among events, providing comprehensive, accurate, and real-time information support for network security-related departments, achieving situational prediction, risk assessment, and rapid decision-making, thereby reducing the adverse effects of network security events. Our research provides new ideas and methods for the construction of the network security event knowledge networks.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Enhancing Manufacturing Efficiency and Quality Control with Industrial IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The application of the IIoT system has appeared as a relatively innovative method to optimize manufacturing effectiveness in the last several years. Therefore, this study presents a new framework that incorporates IIoT services for the enhancement of manufacturing processes and quality assurance. The key components include the use of real-time data capture, analysing and decision supporting systems with the goal of enhancing production operations, reducing excessive time and decline in product quality. It also showed that the effectiveness in manufacturing and the establishment of quality control proved to be much effective in comparison to conventional procedures. The above approach is capable of enriching techniques in smart manufacturing and can be implemented at scale across the industries.

articleTitle: Privacy Protection and Data Security Enhancement (PPDSE) Model in Student Management Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The implementation of a Privacy Protection and Data Security Enhancement (PPDSE) model within Student Management Information Systems (SMIS) is critical for protecting sensitive information in educational institutions. This study presents a novel approach that integrates advanced cryptographic techniques to enhance data security in SMIS. The model uses the Paillier encryption algorithm to ensure homomorphic encryption, which allows secure data operations without exposing the underlying information. The designed SMIS architecture, based on J2EE and. NET technologies, is carefully crafted to optimize performance and security. Experiments were conducted using four real-world datasets from the UCI public machine learning repository, each meticulously annotated to ensure data accuracy. Computational and communication overheads were measured over a range of data sizes. The results show that the computational overhead ranged from 0.08 seconds for 256 data points to 1.013 seconds for 2048 data points. Similarly, the communication overhead increased from 6,231 KB to 50,233 KB for the same data sizes.

articleTitle: Optimizing Machine Learning Algorithms for Heart Disease Prediction in Healthcare: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The healthcare business faces significant challenges in successfully maintaining and evaluating large amounts of patient data. Data analytics has emerged as a viable tool for issue resolution and decision-making as a result of technological advancements in healthcare. This automated procedure improves the resilience of healthcare systems by collecting and analyzing data to provide more effective and cost-effective treatments. One critical use of technology, primarily machine learning, involves the identification and diagnosis of diseases, notably heart disease, which contributes significantly to global mortality. This research study analyzes how machine learning methods (NB, RF, SVM, and LR) can predict the existence of heart disease. Given that nearly 90% of cardiac diseases are avoidable, using machine learning for prediction is critical. This research study assesses the performance of different algorithms using performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, area under the curve (AUC), and F1-Score. The experimental results reveal Random Forest (RF) as the most reliable predictor of heart disease with an accuracy of 83.52% compared to other supervised machine learning algorithms. The Random Forest classifier achieves F1-Score, AUC, and accuracy values of 84.21 %, 88.24%, and 88.89%, respectively. This study highlights the potential of ML, notably the Random Forest algorithm, in improving the predictive capacity of healthcare systems for more effective heart disease prevention and treatment.

articleTitle: Integration of loT for Precision Livestock Monitoring Through Geofencing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Livestock management is integral to modern agriculture, ensuring the welfare, health, and productivity of animals. Traditional methods of monitoring often rely on manual checks and physical boundaries, which can be labor-intensive, time-consuming, and susceptible to human error. The integration of loT (Internet of Things) technology has emerged as a transformative solution, particularly through the implementation of geofencing systems. Geofencing involves the creation of virtual boundaries within a geographical area using GPS (Global Positioning System) or similar location-based technologies. These virtual boundaries are defined by specific GPS coordinates or digital mapping, allowing precise delineation of zones such as grazing areas, feeding zones, or restricted areas. When animals equipped with GPS-enabled collars or tags move within or cross these boundaries, the geofencing system detects their location in real-time and triggers notifications or automated actions. By deploying geofencing systems in livestock management, farmers and ranchers gain several advantages. They can remotely monitor the movements and behaviors of their animals, ensuring they remain within designated areas and promptly addressing any deviations. This real-time monitoring capability not only enhances animal welfare via minimizing the risk of straying or loss but also improves operational efficiency by optimizing resource allocation, such as grazing and feeding schedules. Furthermore, geofencing facilitates data-driven decision-making in agriculture. By collecting and analyzing location-based data, farmers can gain insights into animal behavior patterns, habitat preferences, and overall herd dynamics. This information enables informed management practices, supporting better health management, breeding strategies, and sustainable land use. In conclusion, loT-driven geofencing technology represents a significant advancement in precision livestock monitoring. It empowers farmers with real-time visibility and control over their livestock, leading to improved productivity, sustainability, and animal welfare in modern agricultural practices.

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring and Managing of Edge Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study introduces a new method for extracting insights, making predictions, and managing industrial IoT and edge devices using the reliable OPC-UA (Open Platform Communication Unified Architecture) protocol. It emphasizes the significance of this approach in tackling the difficulties encountered by industries, research institutions, and individual researchers in monitoring real-time data, identifying patterns, and overseeing remote devices. Through the utilization of the OPC-UA protocol, the proposed solution provides a cost-effective and effective way to accomplish these goals.

articleTitle: A Novel Wireless Secure Body Area Network Layer Protocol for Secured Patient Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: An emerging innovation known as Wireless Body Area Network (WBAN) allows for distant monitoring and information collection of patients' medical records. Even though these technologies might transform daily life, there are still serious security risks associated with them. While multiple approaches were suggested for use in WBAN settings, most information is still merely transmitted across devices with limited computing capabilities. To guarantee the authenticity and confidentiality of the transmitted data, this research developed a framework called Wireless Secure Body Area Network Layer (WSBANL) incorporates a technique called Enhanced Elliptic Curve (EEC) centered on Digital Signature (DS). A major priority when designing the WSBANL framework is to provide a secure means of communication that is optimized for use in heterogeneous WBAN systems. Users get up-to-date information for effective assessment of healthcare parameters according to the WSBANL framework, which guarantees the safe recording of the patient's medical conditions through an authorized distant monitoring platform. By combining WBAN's Physical-Layer (PL), MAC-Layer (ML) and Network-Layer (NL), the WSBANL framework has the potential to enhance upon the conventional network architecture framework stacking through the development of a cooperatively optimized methodology. Using the Destination Sequenced Distance Vector (DSDV) framework, the NL chooses the best route for the data packets to navigate for them to arrive at their destination. The EEC offers an assortment of DS, which doubles the degree of protection, enhances security and enables quick estimation while reducing computational resources and storage spaces. and consumption of bandwidth. Through EEC, the patient's medical records may only be accessed and commands provided by authorized medical evaluators. Results from evaluating the proposed WSBANL framework to the current BC, ADC and EAES-SI frameworks in terms of Security Ratio, Energy Consumption Ratio, Encryption Time and Decryption Time reveal that the proposed WSBANL framework offers the highest level of security.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer Classification and Localization Model using DTCWT and ANN-BPN
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Early and accurate lung cancer detection is crucial for improved patient outcomes. This research proposes a hybrid framework combining traditional image processing techniques and machine learning for enhanced lung cancer diagnosis. By leveraging CT images, the system employs DTCWT and GLCM for feature extraction, followed by ANN-BPN for classification. Fuzzy clustering is utilized for malignant tissue localization. The proposed approach demonstrates superior performance in terms of accuracy, precision, and F1-score compared to conventional methods. This hybrid model offers a promising tool for assisting radiologists in lung cancer diagnosis.

Author Keywords: Dual tree complex wavelet transform level Co-Occurrence Matrix

articleTitle: PDF Fusion: Revolutionizing Document Management with Chat Interfaces and Voice Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: “PDF Fusion” introduces an innovative system that integrates PDF handling, chat interfaces, and voice recognition technologies to revolutionize document management. Recent techniques in document management include advanced OCR (Optical Character Recognition) for text extraction, natural language processing for context understanding, and AI-driven summarization tools. Despite these advancements, challenges such as information overload, complex document structures, and limited interactivity persist. Our proposed system addresses these challenges by offering an intuitive and efficient platform for interacting with multiple PDF files. Key features include multiple file management, voice recognition, PDF summaries, and links to relevant Wikipedia and YouTube content in response to user queries. The objective is to enhance productivity and user experience through seamless navigation, comprehensive search capabilities, and interactive communication via chat interfaces and voice commands. Rigorous empirical evaluations and user testing demonstrate the practical usability and effectiveness of our integrated approach. By bridging the gap between traditional document management systems and modern interactive platforms, “PDF Fusion” significantly advances human-computer interaction, contributing valuable insights into optimizing digital document workflows and improving accessibility and usability across various domains.

articleTitle: Securing Roadside Sensor Networks for Smart Driving Collaboration using ECDSA
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Smart transportation systems rely heavily on integrating Internet of Things (IoT) devices, especially roadside sensor networks, to significantly improve road safety, traffic control, and the overall quality of the driving journey. Sensor networks facilitate instantaneous data gathering, processing, and distribution, bolstering smart driving functionalities such as optimizing traffic flow, preventing collisions, and facilitating autonomous vehicle navigation. The proposed project addresses the urgent need for secure communication in smart driving environments through the implementation of a Vehicular Ad-hoc Network (VANET). By establishing data exchange between Roadside Units (RSUs) and vehicles, this study enhances connectivity via dynamic connections and optimized routing protocols. Integration of the Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (ECDSA) ensures data validity and reliability, contributing to a reliable and secure communication framework. This approach fosters a safer and more collaborative driving environment, addressing critical connectivity and security concerns. Establishing robust data exchange between Roadside Units (RSUs) and vehicles enhances connectivity through dynamic connections and optimized routing protocols.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enabled Energy Trading in Microgrids for Sustainable Computing Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research investigates Blockchain-enabled energy trading within microgrids to enhance sustainable computing infrastructure. A novel algorithm, GridCoin, is proposed and evaluated against existing methodologies including Optimal Power Flow (OPF), Microgrid Energy Management System (MEMS), and Hierarchical Control Algorithms (HCA). The study employs simulation metrics such as Transaction Throughput, Energy Trading Efficiency, and Transaction Latency to compare the performance of these algorithms. GridCoin demonstrates superior capabilities in optimizing energy trading operations, achieving higher transaction throughput, improved efficiency in energy utilization, and reduced transaction latency. These results highlight the potential of Blockchain technology to revolutionize energy markets by providing secure, transparent, and decentralized transaction mechanisms. Future research directions include enhancing optimization techniques, integrating renewable energy sources, addressing scalability and security challenges, conducting real-world deployments, and analyzing economic and policy implications. This study contributes to advancing sustainable computing infrastructure through innovative Blockchain-based solutions.

articleTitle: Recognition of Deep Fake Voice Acoustic using Ensemble Bagging Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: As artificial speech generates technological evolution; fake voice information has become an increasingly prevalent avenue for fraud. Numerous investigations have been carried out into machine learning techniques, signal processing techniques, and the Automatic Speaker Verification System to address such issues. Since there are increasing methods to create fake information, techniques must be developed to determine when audio recordings employed as electronic proof are corrupted. Such recordings contain the potential to be manipulated. Hence, this research work identified the data regarding audio systems as either fake or real by i) extracting features from audio file metadata using oversampling techniques and ii) Developing an Ensemble Bagging Model appropriate for analyzing input audio signal followed by classification of fake (fraudulent) and real (authentic) audio. Our experimental results reveal that the ensemble bagging model attained an accuracy of 99.5%, precision of 99%, 99.6% recall, and 99.9% Fl-measure in the prediction of the audio system compared with traditional approaches.

articleTitle: An Efficient Ensemble Ranking Model for IoT-based Crop-Precision-Prediction(CPP) in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In recent years, agriculture has undergone substantial technical transformation using Internet of Things and Artificial Intelligence, to realize smoothly production scenarios. In this work, a new disease identification application by machine learning is proposed for IoT microcontrollers and plant diseases, which has a high degree of accuracy reaching to 91.45%. In this research we also review the most common traditional and innovative technique used to promote and sustain the agricultural growth, focusing on the Smart Farming systems based on IoT. This research aims to compare several traditional to modern methods, detailing the evolution of technologies and their benefic impact on agricultural productivity. Alongside this in-depth review, the research also engages in a comparative analysis of different approaches to smart farming, with a particular focus on building and evaluating small pilot systems. This assessment is crucial in determining the most strategic approach to developing and enhancing these systems, enabling researchers to achieve a certain degree of systemic optimization. Integrating IoT is one of the main benefits of this study, with the following information further highlighting the main application in agricultural sector: In the field of agriculture, the integration of Internet of Things such as sensors can reduce the need for manual labor and maximize efficiency in farms. For instance, IoT devices can smartly perform planting processes and monitor soil information in real time. Then, the collected information can be distributed to related devices for decision-making and resource management. This could lead to improved agricultural productivity. Furthermore, the study also describes the effectiveness of the new machine learning application as it reached a 98.45 per cent accuracy in detecting more than four types of plant diseases which could be useful in agriculture for helping to prevent the spread of disease.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in IoT Network Using SDN Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: IoT is revolutionizing digitization, transforming the way we interact with our environment, manage resources, and access information. Today, the Internet of Things has grown so broad that the development of its security should also be taken into concern along with it. As the use of IoT technologies surges across different sectors, a vast number of devices become internet-connected. This interconnectedness, however, creates a growing vulnerability. Malicious actors can exploit these weaknesses, posing a significant threat to our technology. So, the security of these IoT devices becomes very important. In this study, we propose a framework to provide security to IoT networks. To ensure that an IoT network is free from attacks, continuous monitoring of the network is required. This can be achieved using Software Defined Networking (SDN).Using Mininet, an open-source network emulator, we implement a SDN prototype to emulate an IoT network. By applying threat modelling, all possible threats in the network are identified.

articleTitle: Optimizing Bayesian Belief Network Analysis for Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study investigates the extension of Bayesian Belief Network (BBN) analysis tailored for autonomous vehicles (AVs), specifically targeting the optimization of lane change decision making in structured road environments. Structured roads, characterized by clear lane markings and predictable traffic patterns, provide a controlled environment for AV operations. However, efficient and safe lane changes remain critical to improving traffic flow and overall driving safety. To address this challenge, advanced BBN models are used that integrate real-time data and communication technologies to improve decision accuracy. The methodology involves constructing BBNs to model lane-changing behavior based on historical driving data, using rigorous statistical analysis to understand driver responses under different conditions. Results show significant improvements in lane change efficiency, highlighting implications for AV operations in complex urban environments.

articleTitle: Molecular Design for Drug Discovery with the Use of Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study describes how Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) are used to improve drug discovery molecular design. The goal is to maximize the discovery of potential drug candidates by making use of GANs' ability to produce a wide variety of chemical structures. The goal is to use better molecular design methods to speed up and improve the medication development process. The purpose of using GANs is to make it easier to build new molecular structures with certain features, such more potency and selectivity. This technology has the potential to bypass the drawbacks of conventional drug discovery techniques and speed up the process of exploring chemical space. It demonstrates that GANs have the potential to revolutionize drug development through computational simulations and validation tests. One potential way to find new treatments and solve medical problems that have so far gone unsolved is to include GANs into molecular design processes. Results from Drug Design Data Resource, Kaggle datasets shows that the molecular formula with id Activity-Based Learning (ABL) minimum value starts with 0.055 and maximum of 10, from the sample of 10 compounds the minimum affinity value is 0.075 and maximum of 3.42. In another data surveyed the drug discovery values show the minimum of the molecular weight is 356.3 and maximum is 471.5.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Lesion Detection Through Synergistic Analysis of Independent Components and Uncorrelated Discriminant Features
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The growing incidence of blindness, specifically linked to diabetic retinopathy (DR), highlights the need for expandable retina screening programs. The purpose of this work is to determine the distinction between normal and infected retina images by applying Independent Component Analysis (ICA). Although several processing methods help in DR detection, accuracy is still a problem. The accuracy of current techniques, such as multi-scale amplitude modulation and frequency modulation (AM-FM), to differentiate normal and diseased retinal images is restricted. The proposed method seeks to improve the identification of normal retina histories, haemorrhages, exudates, neovascularization, microaneurysms and blood vessel patterns. Optic Nerve Head (ONH) identification uses established parameters from AM and FM-based extraction of features to check illness traits, relying on edge data without disguising. Type 2 diabetes, which is typified by elevated blood sugar levels, causes damage to the arteries and diabetic retinopathy (DR), an important cause of permanent loss of vision that is frequently undiagnosed till severe. In the initial phases of diabetic retinopathy (DR), non-proliferative alterations that damage the walls of retina blood vessels develop to proliferation retinal degeneration, which is marked by aberrant formation of neovascularization. A lesion diagnosis is still difficult, despite its importance in the early identification of DR. For disease identification, the intricacy of retinal anatomy necessitates the use of many images and certain segmentation algorithms. Microaneurysms, haemorrhages, exudates and neovascularization are examples of lesions markers and identifying anomalies requires accurate segment. In conclusion, precise and affordable retinal scanning devices are necessary to deal with the increasing incidence of blindness, especially that caused by DR. To improve DR identification, this investigation suggests utilizing ICA and UDA.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Agriculture Improvement Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Crop diseases have become more dangerous for farmers, reducing agriculture growth globally. Improving crop disease detection based on affected regions is very important. The proposed approach combines image processing and deep learning (DL) algorithms to develop automated systems. Including domain-specific knowledge, such as crop physiology and agronomy, can further improve the performance of these models. In this paper, a Hybrid Learning Approach (HLA) is developed to find the crop diseases and combines the data on crop-specific fertilizers with DL methods. VGG19, the pre-trained model, accurately finds patterns in crop images. Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) is the model that detects and finds abnormal crop images based on the diseased patterns. The next step depends on identifying the disease and recommending the best fertilizer treatments by improving domain knowledge on types of crop diseases and nutrition-the crop dataset collected from actual crop disease images available in Kaggle. Finally, the results show that the proposed algorithm achieves high accuracy based on the obtained performance on disease detection rate.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Deep Learning Approach for Indian Fruit Classification Using EfficientNetV2B2
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research aims to build a system that automatically categorizes good and bad fruits, for the top six popular Indian varieties of Fruits using deep learning. By adapting pre-trained deep learning models (transfer learning), We have achieved high accuracy (over 99%) in distinguishing fruit quality, with the EfficientNetv2b2 model performing best. The research demonstrates that deep learning could be used to fruit quality assessment in agriculture and the food industry. The framework is developed based on the Pooling and Convolutional layers of the MobileNetv2, ResNet50, DenseNet, and Efficient-Netv2b2 pre-trained CNNs are used for feature extraction, and newly mentioned output and connection layers are applied to classification. Test results show that EfficientNetv2b2 achieves high accuracy (training accuracy - 99.82% and test accuracy - 98.90%) on four pre-trained networks, considering sample size and testing risk. Our goal in this paper is to show how effective transfer learning is and also overcome the limitations of current Fruit Classification Models.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Driven Low-Resolution Thermal Image Reconstruction for Enhanced CWSI Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The timely detection of drought stress in chili plants is a prerequisite for the healthy life of the crop and maximum production. This study proposes a new method to address the problem with the help of deep learning for the purpose of effectively identifying drought resistance in chili plants and focus on the detail analysis of plant health. We intend to use deep learning frameworks to design Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models to upscale the low-resolution thermal images of chili plants to their high-resolution images. CWSI is computed based on the generated images, further employed to evaluate drought stress in chili plants. A real-world dataset of chili plants under various water stress circumstances will be gathered in order to accomplish this. The Crop Water Stress Index(CWSI) can be computed using the high-resolution thermal images generated via the CNN models. Compared to conventional visual inspection techniques, CWSI offers a more objective and accurate assessment by providing a quantitative measure of a plant's water stress level. Our method seeks to greatly increase the accuracy of drought resistance evaluation in chili plants by enhancing the integrity and visual clarity of low-resolution thermal images. Improved accuracy and effectiveness in agricultural monitoring and resource management strategies will follow from this. Ultimately, it could empower farmers to make data-driven decisions about irrigation techniques, maximizing water use effectiveness and guaranteeing the productivity and long-term health of their chili crops.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fall Detection and Alert System for the Elderly Using Yolov8 and Cloud-Based Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: As people age, the frequency and impact of falls among the elderly continue to escalate, presenting significant health and mobility risks. Efficient detection and immediate response are crucial in reducing the severity of injuries and potentially life-threatening complications associated with such falls. This research study introduces a real-time alert system for the elderly by utlilizing the cutting-edge capabilities of YOLO v8, the latest iteration in the You Only Look Once series of models known for its high speed and accuracy in object detection tasks. The system is designed to operate with inputs from a variety of sources, including direct video feeds, RTSP streams from existing CCTV infrastructure, static images, and data from wearable sensors. This multi-source approach ensures that the system is adaptable for use in a wide range of environments, from personal residences to care facilities, providing continuous monitoring with enhanced accuracy. Upon the detection of a fall, the system immediately activates an alert protocol via Amazon Web Services (AWS) Simple Notification Service (SNS), ensuring that caregivers or family members are promptly notified to respond swiftly to the incident. This data-driven approach not only enhances the accuracy and responsiveness of the system over time but also aids caregivers and healthcare providers in understanding fall patterns and potential risk factors associated with specific environments or individuals, effectively addressing the critical challenges in elderly fall prevention and care.

articleTitle: Enhancing Wireless Network Performance with Deep Learning Based Routing Protocols
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Wireless routing plays a major role in efficiently directing the data packets from the source to destination in a distributed network environment. Since the sensor node are widely distributed often wireless networks struggle to establish an effective routing mechanism due to the challenges such as mobility of nodes, energy constraints, limited bandwidth, and signal interference. Since the nodes in WSN networks are limitedly programmed, the nodes lack to respond efficiently. To overcome these constraints, recently deep learning-based routing mechanisms are introduced to make the network respond appropriately according to the situation. Deep learning helps to program and reprogram the wireless networks based on the network traffic patterns and correlations, topology. Deep learning also plays a major role in providing valuable insights for routing decisions by extracting the relevant features from the network data. This study presents a review on the different deep learning techniques implemented in wireless network routing and how the algorithms have contributed to enhance the wireless networks' mobility, scalability, complexity, energy efficiency, security and its real-time adaptability. Finally, this study compares the accuracy of the existing deep learning algorithms and finally states the advantages, limitations and open issues.

articleTitle: Enhancing IoT Data Security with a Hybrid Cryptographic Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is experiencing rapid growth due to technological advancements, but its security remains a significant challenge. This research proposes a dual approach to enhance IoT security. First, a deep learning-based malware detection system is developed using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks. This system identifies malicious nodes and predicts attack types by analyzing trust values, contextual information, and network data. Second, an Improved Elliptic Curve Cryptography (IECC) algorithm is introduced to secure data transmission between IoT devices. The proposed system demonstrates high accuracy (95%), low error rate (5%), and superior performance compared to existing encryption methods. By combining advanced malware detection with robust encryption, this research offers a comprehensive solution to protect IoT devices and data.

articleTitle: Stacked Atrous Convolutional Based Residual Network-50 with Long Short-Term Memory for Suicide Detection on Balanced Social Media Data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The expression of suicidal thoughts on social media affects language use. Many people who are vulnerable to harm utilize social media forums as a way to talk about their issues or find resources for comparable activities. This research study proposes a Stacked Atrous Convolutional Based Residual Network-50 with Long Short-Term Memory (SARNLSTM) for suicide detection on social media data and the. Dataset balancing, preprocessing, word embedding, and classification are the major phases of the proposed work. The class imbalance problem is initially solved using the K-Nearest neighbor (KNN) approach. After that, the preprocessing is performed using the normalization strategy, stop word removal, and stemming process. Then, the word embedding is done using Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers (BERT). Finally, the suicidal ideation is performed by using SARNLSTM, which learns the features and classifies the suicidal posts, in which the parameter is optimally chosen by the Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA). The outcomes prove that the proposed model works better than the currently available model.

articleTitle: Enhancing Predictive Modeling in High Dimensional Data Using Hybrid Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Healthcare data has become invaluable for patients care enhancement as well as outcomes which have been influenced by the expanding volume and complexity of health informatics. The current research discusses the design of a hybrid feature selection(HFS) methodology which is based on a combination of filter & wrapper methods to detect the necessary variables for predictive modeling using machine learning algorithms. The study takes the data set on Parkinson's disease as a use case. The performance of KNN, Decision Trees, and Random Forest models is assessed based on this data set. Findings reveal that integration of feature selection impacts models' efficacy, where Random Forest performs best among all techniques. KNN helped to lower the total number of errors but to increase sensitivity, while the Decision Trees (DT) applied changes not only to sensitivity but to specificity also. The findings bring feature selection into the limelight making healthcare data analysis more revealing in disease prediction and personalized medicine. The application of filter and wrapper methods by providers makes the data exploring process in a high-dimensional data easier and useful in getting actionable insights for improved patient care. Additional studies on feature selection methods and network architecture evolution should be carried out in order to increase the efficiency of medical data mining and enhance predictive model accuracy.
